body.translated_text: 6.1.1: The <s>Agnīṣomīya</s> (Agni-and-Soma offering) has been explained; it is the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>) for [all] animal offerings. 6.1.2: The <s>ārṣa</s> (ṛṣi-traditional) recitation of <s>mantras</s> [is followed] in the archetype. 6.1.3: In the modified form (<s>uttara tantu</s>), since the modification of meaning is not expressed in the original form, they state the modification of words as inference (<s>ūha</s>). 6.1.4: In the <s>ṛc</s> verses, there is no modification. 6.1.5a: [Changes include:] '<s>yajamānābhyām</s>' to '<s>yajamānebhyaḥ</s>' [dual to plural]; '<s>medhapataye</s>' to '<s>medhapatibhyaḥ</s>'; '<s>medhau</s>' to '<s>medhān</s>'; '<s>ādad</s>' to '<s>ādan</s>'; '<s>ghastu</s>' to '<s>ghasantu</s>'; '<s>aghasad</s>' to '<s>aghasan</s>' or '<s>aghad</s>' to '<s>akṣan</s>.' 6.1.5b: '<s>rabhīyāṃsāv iva</s>' to '<s>rabhīyasa iva</s>'; '<s>agrabhīd</s>' to '<s>agrabhīṣuḥ</s>'; '<s>avīvṛdhata</s>' to '<s>avīvṛdhanta</s>'; '<s>aśyāsuḥ</s>'; '<s>ṛdhyāsuḥ</s>'; '<s>acīkametām</s>' to '<s>acīkamanta</s>' — the word modifications [arise] from differences in meaning. 6.1.6: [The terms] <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), <s>cakṣus</s> (eye), <s>śrotra</s> (ear), <s>prāṇa</s> (breath), <s>asu</s> (life), <s>tvac</s> (skin), <s>nābhi</s> (navel), <s>ūṣman</s> (warmth), <s>jñāti</s> (kinsman), [and] the names <s>śyena</s>, <s>śalā</s>, <s>kaśyapā</s>, <s>kavaṣā</s>, <s>sreka</s>, <s>parṇa</s>, <s>ūvadhya</s>, <s>goha</s>, <s>asnā</s> — [are used] as traditionally taught. 6.1.7: And in cases of doubt, the directive [is followed]. 6.1.8: Remaining items are unprecedented [rules]. 6.1.9: And the <s>āya</s>-nigadas (incoming citations). 6.1.10: 'One by one, twenty-six, twenty-six' — or in summary. 6.1.11: This is the method of counting. 6.1.12: For one-deity and two-deity [offerings], [the procedure is] like that for many. 6.1.13: In paired [offerings], the masculine [form applies] in general. 6.1.14: Or in either [gender]. 6.1.15: The conjunction with the particle '<s>eva</s>' and the vowel '<s>a</s>' [applies to] the deity-name beginning with '<s>svar</s>' in a two-deity [offering]. 6.1.16: He ties [the animal] once when there are different kinds of animals. 6.1.17: And those standing well. 6.1.18: At the beginning and end of the northern course [of the sun], the <s>Aindrāgna</s> (to Indra-and-Agni) is the regular (<s>nirūḷha</s>) animal offering. 6.1.19: Or the annual one. 6.1.20: The optional ones are many. 6.1.21: The animals from the fire-carrying onwards to the heart-spit — excluding the <s>Agnīṣomīya</s> and <s>Savanīya</s>. 6.1.22: And the <s>Āgnāvaiṣṇavī</s> (to Agni-and-Viṣṇu) for one about to perform [the Soma sacrifice]. 6.1.23: And the pronouncement of the blessing. 6.1.24: And except in the <s>Agnīṣomīya</s>, the name is mentioned in the <s>sūktavāka</s> (hymn-recitation). 6.1.25: The hymns prescribed from the <s>prātaranuvāka</s> (morning litany) onwards [are used] in the recitation (<s>śastra</s>) and responsive chant (<s>anuvacana</s>). 6.1.26: One should return to a single [verse] in other cases.

body.translated_text: 6.2.1: At the end of the great night [before dawn], having been invited for the <s>prātaranuvāka</s> (morning litany), standing in front of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> hearth, he mutters the <s>prapada</s> (prostration) [formulas]: 6.2.2: 'I resort to <s>bhūḥ</s> (earth); I resort to <s>bhuvaḥ</s> (atmosphere); I resort to <s>svaḥ</s> (heaven); I resort to <s>bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ</s>; I resort to <s>Oṃ</s>; I resort to speech, to the <s>ṛc</s>; I resort to mind, to the <s>yajus</s>; I resort to <s>sāman</s>, to <s>prāṇa</s> (breath); I resort to sight and hearing. Homage to the gods; homage to the deities; homage to the great god; homage to the <s>Gandharvas</s> and <s>Apsarases</s>; homage to the serpents and divine beings; homage to what has been; homage to what will be; homage to the ancestors; and reciprocal homage to you.' 6.2.3: He worships the directions according to their [respective] forms.

body.translated_text: 6.3.1: 'In this eastern direction of mine, <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun) and <s>Candra</s> (the Moon) are the lords. May <s>Sūrya</s> and <s>Candra</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Sūrya</s> and <s>Candra</s> with their deities' — [thus he worships] the east. 6.3.2: 'In this southern direction of mine, <s>Yama</s> and <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death) are the lords. May <s>Yama</s> and <s>Mṛtyu</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Yama</s> and <s>Mṛtyu</s> with their deities' — [thus] the south. 6.3.3: 'In this western direction of mine, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are the lords. May <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> with their deities' — [thus] the west. 6.3.4: 'In this northern direction of mine, <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s> are the lords. May <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Soma</s> and <s>Rudra</s> with their deities' — [thus] turning leftward, the north. 6.3.5: 'In this upward direction of mine, <s>Bṛhaspati</s> and <s>Indra</s> are the lords. May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> and <s>Indra</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Bṛhaspati</s> and <s>Indra</s> with their deities' — [thus] facing forward, the upward [direction]. 6.3.6: 'In this atmosphere of mine, <s>Vāyu</s> (Wind) and <s>Vṛṣṭi</s> (Rain) are the lords. May <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Vṛṣṭi</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Vṛṣṭi</s> with their deities' — [thus] the atmosphere. 6.3.7: 'On this earth of mine, <s>Agni</s> and <s>Anna</s> (Food) are the lords. May <s>Agni</s> and <s>Anna</s> protect me from this direction. May whoever attacks us from there go to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Anna</s> with their deities' — [thus] the earth. 6.3.8: '<s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> [sāmans] are my thighs; <s>Vāmadevya</s> is my self; <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> is my foundation. <s>Bhūḥ</s> am I; <s>bhuvaḥ</s> am I; <s>svaḥ</s> am I. I am a stone; I am a stone-splitter' — having muttered 'the Protector (<s>Sutrāmāṇa</s>),' turning rightward, at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [he offers]: '<s>Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā</s>; to <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>; to <s>Uṣas</s> (Dawn), <s>svāhā</s>; to the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>svāhā</s>; to the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>svāhā</s>; to <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>; may the great <s>savanas</s> (pressings), being pleased, approve of the ghee, <s>svāhā</s>' — having offered with the <s>sruva</s> (small ladle), turning leftward, he sits at the front door of the <s>havirdhāna</s> (soma-cart shed). 6.3.9: When told 'for the gods, the morning chant,' making the <s>hiṃkāra</s> sound, with the middle voice he recites the <s>prātaranuvāka</s> (morning litany). 6.3.10: Combining three <s>padas</s> (feet) of the <s>paṅkti</s> [meter] verses, he should conclude; with the [remaining] two he should introduce. 6.3.11: Having recited the <s>Āpas</s> (Waters) [hymn] and the <s>Revatī</s> [verse], [he continues with] the <s>Āgneya</s> (to Agni) <s>Gāyatra</s> <s>kratu</s> (rite).

body.translated_text:
6.4.1a: [The <s>Ājya</s> recitation of the <s>Hotṛ</s> at the morning pressing:] 'Approaching the sacrifice' (<s>uparayanto adhvaram</s>); '<s>Agni</s>, I [praise] the <s>purohita</s> (one placed in front)'; 'We choose <s>Agni</s> as messenger'; 'Like a horse, you' — ten [verses]; 'Accept the most widely spread [offering]'; 'With the song of <s>Gotama</s>, [I praise] you.'
6.4.1b: '<s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the <s>purohita</s>'; 'Your messenger'; 'O <s>Agni</s>, graciously [accept]'; 'Praising you'; '<s>Agni</s>, with a hymn of praise (<s>stoma</s>)'; 'Approaching [for worship]'; 'These [hymns] of the inspired one'; 'With the kindling-stick, <s>Agni</s>.'
6.4.1c: 'May they kindle <s>Agni</s>'; 'Forth for <s>Agni</s> the voice'; 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, of the sacrifices' — twenty-six [verses in all].
6.4.2: Then the <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s> [section].
6.4.3: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>' — one [verse]; '<s>Hotṛ</s>, you were born'; 'For you indeed are capable' — nine [verses]; 'O <s>Agni</s>, when will your regular [sacrificer come]?' — five [verses].
6.4.4: Then the <s>Traiṣṭubha</s> [section].
6.4.5: 'Of him who' — five [verses]; 'He who among mortals' — three [hymns]; 'Forth for the god' — five <s>sūktas</s> (hymns); 'O <s>Agni</s>, greatly' — and seven [verses]; 'We have come to the great one.'
6.4.6: Then the <s>Bārhata</s> [section].
6.4.7: 'These indeed'; 'Forth for the mighty one'; '<s>Agni</s>, the resplendent' — twelve [verses]; 'Friends, you' — eight; 'It was seen' — four; 'When kindled indeed' — three; 'This <s>Agni</s> of good heroism.'
6.4.8: Then the <s>Auṣṇīha</s> [section].
6.4.9: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, by the inspired ones'; 'Praise, come'; 'O widely [praised].'
6.4.10: Then the <s>Jāgata</s> [section].
6.4.11: 'Seated on the altar (<s>vediṣad</s>)' — seven; 'Come, O <s>Hotṛ</s>'; 'Increase through sacrifice'; 'The guardian of the people.'
6.4.12: Then the <s>Pāṅkta</s> [section].
6.4.13: '<s>Agni</s>, that one I think.'

body.translated_text:
6.5.1: Then the <s>Uṣasya</s> (Dawn) [hymn collection], in <s>Gāyatrī</s> [meter].
6.5.2: 'Who [illumines] your dawn?' — three [verses]; 'The beautiful bright one beams forth.'
6.5.3: Then the <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s> [section].
6.5.4: 'O Dawn, with auspicious [lights].'
6.5.5: Then the <s>Traiṣṭubha</s> [section].
6.5.6: 'She has shone forth' — four [hymns].
6.5.7: Then the <s>Bārhata</s> [section].
6.5.8: 'She was indeed seen'; 'With the good one.'
6.5.9: Then the <s>Auṣṇīha</s> [section].
6.5.10: 'O Dawn, that brilliant [light]' — three [verses].
6.5.11: Then the <s>Jāgata</s> [section].
6.5.12: 'These indeed' — four [verses].
6.5.13: Then the <s>Pāṅkta</s> [section].
6.5.14: 'For the great, us.'

body.translated_text:
6.6.1: Then the <s>Āśvina</s> (<s>Aśvin</s>-related hymns), in <s>Gāyatrī</s> [meter].
6.6.2: 'O <s>Aśvins</s>, you two worshipful ones, seeking' — three [verses]; 'Yoked in the morning' — four; '<s>Aśvins</s>, with the horse-possessing one' — three; 'This, O Dawn'; 'Cow-rich dawns' — two; 'From far as if near' — thirty-six; 'Rise up'; 'Come to my offering.'
6.6.3: Then the <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s> [section].
6.6.4: 'Come to us with all protections'; 'If today you stand afar' — [these two] <s>sūktas</s>.
6.6.5: Then the <s>Traiṣṭubha</s> [section].
6.6.6a: 'It shines forth' — [these two] <s>sūktas</s>; 'To the two <s>Nāsatyas</s>' — three [hymns]; '<s>Vasu</s>, <s>Rudra</s>' — three [verses]; 'Your kingdoms' — [these] <s>sūktas</s>.
6.6.6: 'Like pressing-stones'; 'The cow of the ancient one'; 'Who indeed may hear?' — [these] <s>sūktas</s>; 'I praise the men' — [the] <s>sūkta</s>, omitting the five-footed [verse]; 'Your chariot, pressing together the two worlds' — five <s>sūktas</s>.
6.6.7: Then the <s>Bārhata</s> [section].
6.6.8: 'These for you, O heavenly ones'; 'This for you, the sweetest' — the first, third, and fifth [verses].
6.6.9: Then the <s>Auṣṇīha</s> [section].
6.6.10: 'Your chariot indeed' — five [verses].
6.6.11: Then the <s>Jāgata</s> [section].
6.6.12: 'Three times for us today'; 'Praise the heavenly one'; 'The milch-cow and [her] calf.'
6.6.13: Then the <s>Pāṅkta</s> [section].
6.6.14: 'Toward the most beloved' — thus.
6.6.17: Having enclosed with the last [verse], releasing the voice, or by the meter immediately following — of the <s>pratipat</s> (opening verse) and the <s>samārohiṇī</s> (ascending) [verses], of this collection, [there are] three hundred and sixty.
6.6.18: Or above a hundred, as one desires.
6.6.19: The <s>Pāṅkta</s> [verses] should not be omitted.
6.6.20: The time of the concluding [verse] is when they offer the <s>upāṃśu</s> (low-voiced offering) before the [offering of the] morning cake (<s>purodāśa</s>).
6.6.21: Restraint of speech [is maintained] from the <s>antaryāma</s> [offering onward].

body.text:
ŚŚS_6.7.1: apa.iṣya.hotar.ity.uktaḥ.pra.devatra.iti.dvādaśīm.parihāpya /

ŚŚS_6.7.6: āpo.na.devīr.iti.hotṛ.camase.avanīyamānāsu /
ŚŚS_6.7.7: ā.dhenava.ity.āyatīṣu.sarvām.uktvā.praṇavena.avasyati /
ŚŚS_6.7.8: adhvaryava.eṣīr.apā.ity.adhvaryum.pṛcchati /
ŚŚS_6.7.9: uta.iva.namnamur.iti.pratyāha /
ŚŚS_6.7.10a: pratyukto.nigadam.tāsv.adhvaryav.ādhāva.indrāya.somam.ūrjasvantam.mahdumantam.tṛṣṭivanim.vasumate.rudravata.ādityavata.ṛbhumate.vibhumate.vājavate.bṛhaspatimate.viśva.devyāvate /
ŚŚS_6.7.10b: yasya.pītvā.mada.indro.vṛtrāṇi.jaṅghanat.|.pra.sa.janyāni.tāriṣaḥ.|.ambaya.ity.adhyardhām.anūcya.|.uotthāya.adhvaryum.anvāvṛtya.uttarām.adhyardhām.anūcya.|.upottamām.ca.sūktasya.|.uttamayā.paridhāya.|.paryāvṛtya.upaviśati /
body.translated_text:
6.7.1: Addressed as 'O <s>Hotṛ</s>, recite!' (<s>apa iṣya</s>), [he recites] 'Forth to the gods' — omitting the twelfth [verse].
6.7.2: Having recited nine, [he recites] the eleventh when the oblation is being offered into the waters.
6.7.3: [He recites] the tenth when [the waters] are turned back.
6.7.4: 'Toward what the waters [are]' — when [the waters] are being seen.
6.7.5: 'With the others' — when [the waters are] flowing together.
6.7.6: 'O divine waters' — when [the waters are] being poured into the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s cup.
6.7.7: 'Come, O milch-cows' — when [the waters are] approaching; having recited the whole [hymn], he concludes with the <s>praṇava</s> (<s>Oṃ</s>).
6.7.8: 'O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, these waters' — he asks the <s>Adhvaryu</s>.
6.7.9: 'Indeed, they have bowed down' — he replies.
6.7.10a: Having been answered, [he recites] the <s>nigada</s> (recitation formula) with them: 'O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, hasten; [pour] <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s>, full of nourishment, full of honey, refreshing, possessing the <s>Vasus</s>, possessing the <s>Rudras</s>, possessing the <s>Ādityas</s>, possessing the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, possessing the <s>Vibhus</s>, possessing the <s>Vājas</s>, possessing <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, possessing all divine [powers].'
6.7.10b: 'Having drunk which in exhilaration, <s>Indra</s> slew <s>Vṛtra</s>; forth from him [were born] the peoples' — having recited one and a half [verses] of '<s>Ambayaḥ</s> (O mothers)'; standing up, following the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, having recited the latter one and a half [verses]; and the last [verse] of the <s>sūkta</s> up to the penultimate [line]; having concluded with the last [verse]; turning around, he sits down.

body.translated_text:
6.8.1: 'Protect my <s>prāṇa</s> (in-breath), enliven my <s>prāṇa</s>; <s>svāhā</s>, O auspicious one, for the sun' — he breathes along (<s>anuprāṇiti</s>) with [this mantra] when the <s>upāṃśu</s> (low-voiced offering) is being offered.
6.8.2: 'Protect my <s>apāna</s> (out-breath), enliven my <s>apāna</s>; <s>svāhā</s>, O auspicious one, for the sun' — he breathes along with [this mantra] for the <s>antaryāma</s> (inner offering).
6.8.4: The <s>Brahman</s> (priest) and the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> sit down to the south.
6.8.5: They are addressed: 'O <s>Brahman</s>, we shall chant; O <s>Praśāstṛ</s> (director).'
6.8.6: Having murmured: 'May the <s>ṛcs</s> (verses) [grant] long life; may you not depart; [you are] body-protectors; praised by the <s>Sāman</s> (chant); by the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.'
6.8.6: Having murmured: 'May the <s>ṛcs</s> [grant] long life; may you not depart; [you are] body-protectors; praised by the <s>Sāman</s>; by the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>.'
6.8.7: '<s>Oṃ</s>, it has been praised' — thus [he responds].
6.8.8: [This is] the authorization for all chants (<s>stotra</s>s).
6.8.9: 'Lead me from non-being to being; lead me from darkness to light; lead me from the finite to the infinite; lead me from death to immortality' — thus the sacrificer [recites] while approaching the <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants].
6.8.10: 'You are the eagle; fly! The <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter follows you; I take hold of you; carry me safely across; [to] the success of this sacrifice' — when the outer <s>Pavamāna</s> has been chanted.
6.8.11: 'You are the well-winged one; fly! The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter [follows you]' — at the midday [pressing].
6.8.12: 'You are the companion; fly! The <s>Jagatī</s> meter [follows you]' — at the <s>Ārbhava</s> (third pressing).
6.8.13: The concluding portion is the same [for all].
6.8.14: 'The gods are invited — for the share of this <s>Soma</s> <s>Pavamāna</s>, the clear-seeing one; may the gods invite me — for the share of this <s>Soma</s> <s>Pavamāna</s>, the clear-seeing one. With my mind I partake of you; with my speech I partake of you; with my <s>prāṇa</s> I partake of you; with my sight I partake of you; with my hearing I partake of you' — the <s>Hotṛ</s> [recites this] when the outer <s>Pavamāna</s> has been chanted.

body.translated_text:
6.9.1: The <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day) offering is dedicated to <s>Agni</s>.
6.9.2: Or to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> [jointly].
6.9.3: Or with an <s>Aikādaśina</s> (eleven-victim [animal sacrifice]).
6.9.6: In [rites with] single sacrificial posts, in the <s>Aikādaśinas</s>, the encircling rope revolves three times each separately.
6.9.7: At the eleventh [post], between the encircling [rope] and the <s>pragātha</s> [verse], he recites 'yān vo nara' (Those of you, O men) and the remainder of the hymn.
6.9.8: With the last [verse], he consecrates the bed-covering.
6.9.9: On the previous day, when [the posts are] raised but not yet encircled, he should bind [them] with the first [rope].
6.9.10: Or for the purpose of continuity, he should wait with just a half-verse.
6.9.11: [The rope] should follow [the posts] of the same kind.
6.9.12: In the order of the last [first]...

body.translated_text:
6.10.1: [The mantras] for the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to Agni): 'agne naya' (O Agni, lead) — three [verses], 'bhuvo yajñasya' (Of the sacrifice), 'pra vaḥ' (Forth to you), 'śukrāya' (To the bright one), 'pra kārava' (Forth, doers).
6.10.2: For the <s>Sārasvata</s> (offering to Sarasvatī): 'ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatād ā' (To us from high heaven, from the mountain), 'sarasvatīm devayantaḥ' (Seeking divine favor, Sarasvatī), 'sarasvaty abhi naḥ' (O Sarasvatī, toward us), 'pāvīravī' (The thunderous one), 'kanyā' (The maiden), 'pra kṣodaṣā' (Forth the impetuous one), 'imā juhvānā' (Offering these).
6.10.3: For the <s>Saumya</s> (offering to Soma): 'tvam soma pra cikitaḥ' (Thou, O Soma, hast perceived), 'tvam imā oṣadhīḥ' (Thou these plants), 'somo dhenum' (Soma, the cow), 'yā te dhāmāni divya' (Those divine abodes of thine), 'ṣāḍham' (The conquering), 'yutsu' (In battles), 'yā te dhāmāni havir' (Those oblation-abodes of thine), 'eṣā' (This one).
6.10.4: For the <s>Pauṣṇa</s> (offering to Pūṣan): 'pūṣā imā āśāḥ' (Pūṣan, these directions), 'prapathe pathām' (On the crossroads of paths), 'pathaḥ patha' (Path by path), 'śukraṃ te' (Thy bright [offering]), 'yās te pūṣan' (Those of thine, O Pūṣan), 'pūṣā subandhuḥ' (Pūṣan of good kinship).
6.10.5: 'ā daivyā' (Come, divine ones)...

body.translated_text:
6.11.1: 'indrā nu pūṣaṇā' (O Indra and Pūṣan now) — for the <s>Aindrā-Pauṣṇa</s> (offering to Indra and Pūṣan).
6.11.2: 'somā pūṣaṇā' (O Soma and Pūṣan) — for the <s>Saumā-Pauṣṇa</s> (offering to Soma and Pūṣan).
6.11.3: 'sam vāṃ karmaṇā' (Together with your deed) — for the <s>Aindrā-Vaiṣṇava</s> (offering to Indra and Viṣṇu).
6.11.4: 'nāsatyābhyām' (To the two Nāsatyas) — for the <s>Āśvina</s> (offering to the Aśvins).
6.11.5: 'viṣṇor nu kam' (Of Viṣṇu indeed) — for the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> (offering to Viṣṇu).
6.11.6: 'rātrī' (Night) — for [the offering to] <s>Rātrī</s> (Night).
6.11.7: 'bhūrim dve' (The two great ones) — for the <s>Dyāvā-Pṛthivīya</s> (offering to Heaven and Earth).
6.11.8: 'janīyanta' (They were born) — three [verses]. 'sa vāvṛdhe' (He grew), 'divyam suparṇam' (The celestial eagle). 'yasya vrataṃ paśavo yanti sarve' (Whose ordinance all creatures follow), 'yasya vratam upatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ' (Whose ordinance the waters serve), 'yasya vrate puṣṭipatiḥ niviṣṭaḥ' (In whose ordinance the lord of nourishment is established) — 'tam sarasvantam avase huve' (Him, the Sarasvat, I invoke for aid)...

body.translated_text:
6.12.1: Having reverenced the <s>dhiṣṇyas</s> (subsidiary fire-hearths), they process to the <s>sadas</s> (assembly hall).
6.12.2: Standing in front of the <s>havirdhāna</s> (oblation-shed), looking at each one [of the hearths].
6.12.3: [Reciting:] 'saṃrāḍ asi' (Thou art the sovereign), 'kṛśāno' (O fire), 'raudreṇa anīkena pāhi mā' (Protect me with [thy] fierce vanguard), 'agne pipṛhi mā' (O Agni, bring me across), 'namas te astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ' (Homage to thee, do not harm me) — [reverencing] the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.
6.12.4: [The one] beginning with 'raudra' (fierce) [is recited when there is] a concluding result.
6.12.5: Or without a concluding result.
6.12.6: 'apijo 'si duvasvān' (Thou art unimpaired, [full of] worship) — [reverencing the fire] churned and carried forth.
6.12.7: 'pariṣadyo 'si pavamāna' (Thou art the assembly-seated one, O purifying one) — [reverencing] the <s>Āstava</s> (praise-fire).
6.12.8: 'pratakvā 'si nabhasvān' (Thou art the forward-going, cloud-born one) — [reverencing] the <s>Cātvāla</s> (pit-fire).
6.12.9: 'kavyo 'si havyasūdana' (Thou art the poetic one, preparer of oblations) — [reverencing] the <s>Śāmitra</s> (slaughter-fire).

ŚŚS_6.13.13: āditya.upasthānam.rātri.paryāyeṣv.āśvine.ca.na.vidyate.na.vidyate /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 6.13.1: 'O fires, you are <s>Sagaras</s> (ocean-born); you are <s>Sagaras</s>! By the name <s>Sagara</s>, with the fierce (<s>Raudra</s>) aspect — protect me, O fires; gratify me. Homage be to you; do not harm me' — [thus addressing] all [the fires].
ŚŚS 6.13.2: 'You are the lord of the path; may there be safety for us today — place us on the path going to the gods' — having attended upon <s>Āditya</s> (the sun), those beginning with the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest], going northward, passing around the <s>Acchāvāka</s> [priest], enter the <s>Sadas</s> (assembly hall) through the eastern door.
ŚŚS 6.13.3: Muttering 'O All-Gods, follow me in entering! O <s>Indra</s>, go to the threefold shelter; O <s>Indra</s>, we are in awe of the wondrous lord of the assembly' — they go past all the fire-hearths (<s>dhiṣṇyas</s>), to the front and to the north.
ŚŚS 6.13.4: The one with the southern fire-hearth — the southern fire-hearth [occupant] goes first, and sits down behind his own fire-hearth.
ŚŚS 6.13.5: Having gone to the north of the <s>Sadas</s>, the <s>Brahman</s> priest, entering the <s>Sadas</s> through the western door, having gone to the south of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [seat], sits in his proper seat.
ŚŚS 6.13.6: They do not exit through the western door while the pressing (<s>savana</s>) has not been concluded.
ŚŚS 6.13.7: Between the fire-hearths of the <s>Hotṛ</s> and the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> is the passage for those without fire-hearths when [the session] has not concluded.
ŚŚS 6.13.8: To the north of their own fire-hearths — for those who have fire-hearths.
ŚŚS 6.13.9: Going northward past the western half of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [fire-place].
ŚŚS 6.13.10: Or to the south of the <s>Mārjālīya</s> [shed].
ŚŚS 6.13.11: And they return without turning around.
ŚŚS 6.13.13: The attendance upon <s>Āditya</s> is not found in the night-rounds (<s>rātri-paryāya</s>) and in the <s>Āśvina</s> [pressing]; it is not found.

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 7.1.1: Having entered [the <s>Sadas</s>], they perform [the offerings] with the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cakes) of the pressing (<s>savanīya</s>).
ŚŚS 7.1.2: [The verse] 'Possessing grain...' is the invitatory verse (<s>puronuvākyā</s>).
ŚŚS 7.1.3: 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Indra</s>, possessor of bay horses' — the direction (<s>praiṣa</s>) according to each pressing, as traditionally handed down.
ŚŚS 7.1.4: He extends [the chant] according to each pressing.
ŚŚS 7.1.5: Having lifted up [the offering], he offers with that very [formula]: 'The <s>Hotṛ</s> has worshipped' [and] 'O <s>Hotṛ</s>, worship!'
ŚŚS 7.1.6: 'O <s>Agni</s>, accept our oblation' — this is the invitatory verse for the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s>.
ŚŚS 7.1.7: 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Agni</s> [lord] of the rice-cakes' — the directions according to each pressing.
ŚŚS 7.1.8: 'O <s>Agni</s>, proclaim the oblation!' — and [this is] the offering verse (<s>yājyā</s>).

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 7.2.1: The <s>Aindravāyava</s>, <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, and <s>Āśvina</s> [cups] are the two-deity [offerings].
ŚŚS 7.2.2: 'O <s>Vāyu</s>, come near, O conspicuous one!' [and] 'O <s>Indra</s>-<s>Vāyu</s>, these...' — these are the invitatory verses of the <s>Aindravāyava</s> [cup].
ŚŚS 7.2.3: 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Vāyu</s>!' [and] 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Indra</s>-<s>Vāyu</s>!' — these are the directions.
ŚŚS 7.2.4: 'Drink the foremost share' [and] 'With a hundred...' — these are the offering verses.
ŚŚS 7.2.5: 'This [oblation is] yours, O <s>Mitra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s>' — this is the invitatory verse of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [cup].
ŚŚS 7.2.6: 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Mitra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s>!' — this is the direction.
ŚŚS 7.2.7: 'Praised by <s>Jamadagni</s>' — this is the offering verse.
ŚŚS 7.2.8: 'The morning-yoked one' — this is the invitatory verse of the <s>Āśvina</s> [cup].
ŚŚS 7.2.9: 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship the <s>Aśvins</s>!' — this is the direction.

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.3.1: etu.vasuḥ.purūvasur.ity.aindravāyavam.pratigṛhya.urau.dakṣiṇe.nidhāya.anapidhānam.anavekṣaṇam.ca.dvidevatyānām.ā.śeṣasya.avanayanāt /
ŚŚS_7.3.2: etu.vasur.vidad.vasur.iti.maitrāvaruṇam.pratigṛhya.dakṣiṇena.aindravāyavam.hṛtvā.dakṣiṇataḥ.paścān.nidadhāti /
ŚŚS_7.3.3: aitu.vasuḥ.samyad.vasur.ity.āśvinam.pratigṛhya.dakṣiṇena.pūrvau.hṛtvā.uttarataḥ.paścān.nidadhāti /
ŚŚS_7.3.4: somasya.agne.vīhi.ity.anuvaṣaṭ.kāraḥ.sarvāsu.soma.yājyāsu.dvidevatya.ṛtu.yājān.parhāpya.āditya.graha.sāvitra.grahau.pātnīvatam.ca /
ŚŚS_7.3.5: upāṃśu.vā.pātnīvatasya /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 7.3.1: 'Here is wealth, abundantly wealthy one!' — having received the <s>Aindravāyava</s> [cup], having placed it on the broad right [thigh], without covering and without looking at [it] — [this applies to] the two-deity [cups] until the pouring of the remainder.
ŚŚS 7.3.2: 'Here is wealth, wealth-finding one!' — having received the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [cup], having carried it to the right of the <s>Aindravāyava</s>, he places it to the south behind.
ŚŚS 7.3.3: 'Let wealth come, wealth-meeting one!' — having received the <s>Āśvina</s> [cup], having carried it to the right of the two previous ones, he places it behind to the north.
ŚŚS 7.3.4: 'O <s>Agni</s>, proclaim the <s>Soma</s>!' — this is the <s>anuvaṣaṭ</s> response call in all <s>Soma</s> offering verses, excluding the two-deity and seasonal (<s>ṛtu-yāja</s>) [offerings], the <s>Āditya-graha</s> and <s>Sāvitra-graha</s> [cups].

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 7.4.1: 'When they are being drawn up...' — when told [to recite], [he recites] 'May the bay horses bring you!' — the hymn of the drawing-up.
ŚŚS 7.4.2: 'May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Indra</s>!' — 'Of the morning pressing' — this is the direction.
ŚŚS 7.4.3: He offers with 'This is your honied <s>Soma</s>.'
ŚŚS 7.4.4: 'O you of man's vision, I, of man's vision, look upon you' — having looked upon the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s cup — 'O you who bestow vitality, I, who bestow vitality, receive you' — having received [it], he touches it to his chest — and [likewise] the two-deity [cups].
ŚŚS 7.4.5: Of those that are drawn up again, the assistant priests (<s>hotrakās</s>) offer.
ŚŚS 7.4.6: 'O <s>Mitra</s>, we...' — [this is for] the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest].
ŚŚS 7.4.7: 'O <s>Indra</s>, you the bull...' — [this is for] the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> [priest].

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 7.5.1: 'Here is wealth, abundantly wealthy one!' — having received the <s>Aindravāyava</s> [cup] from the <s>Adhvaryu</s>: 'Invoked are <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Indra</s>-<s>Vāyu</s>, together with breath, together with splendor. I, being invoked by them, [am endowed] with breath and with splendor' — having consumed [it], and having received [it] again with the receiving-<s>mantra</s>, he consumes again with the consuming-<s>mantra</s>.
ŚŚS 7.5.2: 'Here is wealth, wealth-finding one!' — having received the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [cup].
ŚŚS 7.5.3: 'Invoked are <s>Mitra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s>, together with sight, together with splendor. I, being invoked by them, [am endowed] with sight and with splendor' — having consumed [it].
ŚŚS 7.5.4: Having carried the <s>Āśvina</s> [cup] clockwise around the head, having looked at [it], having received...

body.translated_text:
7.6.1: The <s>Acchāvāka</s> (assistant priest), when told "sit down," sits in front of the <s>sadas</s> (assembly hall), north of the channel, receives the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake), and when told "O <s>Acchāvāka</s>, speak," he recites the three [verses beginning] "<s>Acchā vo Agnim avase</s>" (Toward <s>Agni</s> for your aid).
7.6.2: [It is recited] as a <s>nigada</s> (addressed formula) with <s>praṇavas</s>.
7.6.3: [He addresses:] "O <s>Yajamāna</s>, <s>Hotṛ</s>, <s>Adhvaryu</s>, <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Potṛ</s>, <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>, and <s>Upavaktṛ</s> — seek nourishment, conquer sustenance. May your kinswomen yield to you, may your non-kinswomen [yield], may your rivals — you have conquered those who are oppressed, you have conquered those who are fearless. May <s>Indra</s> hear you, may <s>Agni</s> listen to you. Having gone forth, proclaim the <s>Soma</s> for <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>. Call forth to us the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, O <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>."
7.6.4: [For] the invocation, the <s>Adhvaryu</s> says: "This <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> desires [invitation] — or the <s>Acchāvāka</s>. O <s>Hotṛ</s>, invite him."
7.6.5: The <s>Hotṛ</s> invites him.
7.6.6: [The one being invited recites:] "The recognizer has returned. The pressing <s>yajamāna</s> has grasped this well-praised [offering]. And the helper and the assistant have taken their stand. And our cattle have been invited. And he has been invited" — when being invited.
7.6.7: [He recites] from "And our cattle have been invited" when not being invited.
7.6.8: The uninvited <s>Acchāvāka</s>, [saying] "turn back," should run after [the reciter] for as much of the hymn as he can.
7.6.9: Or the <s>Hotṛ</s> may invite back the approaching <s>Acchāvāka</s>.

ŚŚS_7.7.9: ūrdhvam.ca.upāsanebhyaḥ /
body.translated_text:
7.7.1: When told "For the one being drawn up," the <s>Acchāvāka</s> recites the <s>sūtra</s> (formula) "<s>Praty asmai pipīṣata</s>" (Swell for him).
7.7.2: He offers with [the verse] "<s>Prātar yāvabhiḥ</s>" (With the morning barley-drinks).
7.7.3: Having partaken [of the <s>Soma</s>], having given the replenished <s>camasa</s> (cup) to the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, turning to the right, entering the <s>sadas</s> by the rear door, sitting behind his own <s>dhiṣṇya</s> (fire-seat), he eats the <s>puroḍāśa</s>.
7.7.4: If [the <s>Hotṛ</s>] has gone out first, he should perform the <s>Acchāvāka</s>'s [duty]: having exited by his own established passage, having performed the outdoor duty of the <s>Acchāvāka</s>, he performs his own duty.
7.7.5: But the <s>Hotṛ</s> [remains] at his own <s>dhiṣṇya</s>.
7.7.6: There is an option among the <s>Hotraka</s> (assistant <s>Hotṛ</s>) priests regarding the <s>yājyās</s> (offering verses).
7.7.7: At the morning pressing, those who recite offer [either verse by verse] or by half-verses.
7.7.8: Here they observe the <s>vrata</s> (observance).
7.7.9: And [also] after the <s>upāsanas</s> (seatings).

body.translated_text:
7.8.1: Then they proceed with the seasonal (<s>ṛtu</s>) cups.
7.8.2: The <s>Hotṛ</s> directs [the <s>Adhvaryu</s>] with the <s>ṛtupraiṣas</s> (seasonal directions) beginning "May the <s>Hotṛ</s> offer to <s>Indra</s> from the <s>Hotra</s>" without refusal.
7.8.3: He offers accordingly.
7.8.4: That by which he directs is the <s>yājyā</s> (offering verse); having excerpted [it], "The <s>Hotṛ</s> has offered; such-and-such deity, offer [the rest]."
7.8.5: Or [the verse] of <s>Maidhātithi</s>: "O <s>Indra</s>, drink the <s>Soma</s> with the season."
7.8.6: Whichever [priest] is heard at the end of the <s>praiṣa</s> (direction), he is the one who offers.
7.8.7: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> says: "O <s>Hotṛ</s>, offer this."
7.8.8: And the householder (<s>gṛhapati</s>) [also says so].
7.8.9: He offers for those two.
7.8.10: They partake [of <s>Soma</s>] as the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> is pronounced.
7.8.11: The <s>Hotṛ</s> [partakes] twice at the end.
7.8.12: He should just slightly smell [it] there, and in the two-deity [offerings].

body.translated_text:
7.9.1: About to recite the <s>Ājya</s> (ghee-recitation), having murmured "Father <s>Mātariśvan</s>, unbroken, <s>Uśij</s> of the path, the one who goes beyond — <s>Soma Nīthavin</s> shall lead the courses; <s>Bṛhaspati</s> shall recite the <s>uktha</s>-delights," [he pronounces] the call "<s>Śoṃsāvaḥ</s>" at the beginning of the <s>śastra</s> (recitation) at the morning pressing. Having called thus, [he recites] the <s>upāṃśu</s> (soft) and silent recitation.
7.9.2: Having concluded with "<s>Agni</s> is light, light is <s>Agni</s>," having concluded with "<s>Indra</s> is light, light is <s>Indra</s>," having concluded with "<s>Sūrya</s> is light, light is <s>Sūrya</s>," thereafter he recites the <s>puroruc</s> (pre-shine verses).
7.9.3: [He recites:] "<s>Agni</s>, kindled by the gods; <s>Agni</s>, kindled by <s>Manu</s>; charioteer of rites; unhurried <s>Hotṛ</s>; swift bearer of oblations; may the divine one convey [oblations] to the gods; may <s>Agni</s> the god offer to the gods; he, <s>Jātavedas</s>, performs the rites; forth for the god" — this is the <s>Ājya</s>.
7.9.4: The first half-verse of that is the <s>puroruc</s> (pre-shine) recitation.
7.9.5: And [the same applies] for the <s>Marutvatīya</s> and <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [recitations].
7.9.6: Having recited the rest of the hymn, having called, having enclosed with the last [verse], he murmurs the <s>ukthavīrya</s> (power of the <s>uktha</s>): "Splendor, radiance, dawn, heaven, light — for fame the <s>uktha</s> has been recited for you."
7.9.7: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> says "<s>Ukthaśāḥ</s>" (reciter of the <s>uktha</s>) in all offering-verses of the <s>śastra</s>.
7.9.8: He offers with "<s>Agna Indraś ca</s>" (O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>).

ŚŚS_7.10.13: indra.ukthebhir.bhiandiṣṭho.vājānām.ca.vāja.patiḥ.|.harivān.sutānām.sakhā.|.indrā.yāhi.citra.bhāno.iti.tisraḥ /
ŚŚS_7.10.14: viśvān.devān.havāmahe.asmin.yajñe.sajoṣasaḥ.|.ta.imam.yajñam.āgaman.devāso.devyo.dhiyā.|.ye.yajñasya.tanū.kṛto.viśva.ā.soma.pītaye.|.omāsaś.carṣaṇīdhṛta.iti.tisraḥ /
ŚŚS_7.10.15: vācām.aham.devīm.vācam.asmin.yajñe.supeśasam.|.sarasvatīm.havāmahe.|.pāvakā.naḥ.sarasvatī.iti.tisṛṇām.uttamayā.paridhāya.uktha.vīryam.japati.vācam.me.jinva.|.prāṇam.me.tṛmpa.|.cakṣur.me.pāhi.|.śrotram.me.ava.|.varṇam.me.yaccha.|.tanvam.me.pāhi.|.yaśo.me.dhehi.|.ghoṣāya.tvā.uktham.avāci.iti /
ŚŚS_7.10.16: viśvebhiḥ.somyam.madhv.iti.yajati /
body.translated_text:
7.10.1: When the <s>Ājya</s> [recitation] is concluded, they chant the <s>stotra</s>.
7.10.2: "This is [the turn] for the <s>śastras</s> (recitations) that have <s>stotras</s> (chants)" — he announces. After the last <s>pratihāra</s> (response), having called, they recite.
7.10.3: In the <s>prauga</s> (introductory section), they intersperse verses between the <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> triplets — those are called <s>puroruc</s> (pre-shine verses).
7.10.4: The call [comes] before those.
7.10.5: And [before] the <s>paridhānīyā</s> (concluding verse).
7.10.6: The <s>Vaiśvadevī</s> [verse] has six <s>pādas</s> (quarters).
7.10.7: In that, having concluded with every two [<s>pādas</s>], he prolongs with [the next] two.
7.10.8: In the <s>Sārasvatī</s> [verse], there is an option: he may recite or not. But the call is obligatory.
7.10.9: [He recites:] "<s>Vāyu</s>, going foremost, delighting in the sacrifice, going together with the mind to the sacrifice, auspicious with the <s>Niyuts</s>, with the auspicious ones" — having recited once, of the three [verses beginning] "<s>Vāyav ā yāhi darśata</s>" (O <s>Vāyu</s>, come, visible one), [he recites] the first three times.
7.10.10: [Then:] "With golden paths, the two divine lords for victory; <s>Vāyu</s> and <s>Indra</s>, of good sacrifices; <s>Indra</s>-<s>Vāyu</s>, these" — three [verses].
7.10.11: [Then:] "Of the two seers, in the ancestral [homes], with skill, in the house of skill; destroying demons, to the seat; I invoke <s>Mitra</s>" — three [verses].
7.10.12: [Then:] "O divine <s>Adhvaryus</s>, come with the chariot of sun-skin; anoint the sacrifice with sweetness; O <s>Aśvins</s>, [bring] nourishing offerings" — three [verses].
7.10.13: [Then:] "<s>Indra</s>, most delighting with <s>ukthas</s>, lord of prizes among prizes; golden, friend of the pressed [<s>Soma</s>]; O <s>Indra</s>, come, of brilliant light" — three [verses].
7.10.14: "We invoke all the gods, united in this sacrifice; may the gods come to this sacrifice with divine intention; those who are the fashioners of the sacrifice" — [the <s>Vaiśvadevī</s> verses].

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.11.1: tṛcāḥ.stotriya.anurūpāḥ.pragāthān.parihāpya /
ŚŚS_7.11.2: ā.no.mitā.varuṇā.no.gantam.iti.stotriya.anurūpau.maitrāvaruṇasya /
ŚŚS_7.11.3: pra.vo.mitrāya.ity.uktha.mukham /
ŚŚS_7.11.4: pra.mitrayor.iti.navānām.uttamayā.paridhāya.upa.naḥ.sutamā.gatam.iti.yajati /
body.translated_text:
7.11.1: The <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> (counterpart) [verses] are in triplets, omitting the <s>pragāthas</s> (strophic pairs).
7.11.2: "<s>Ā no Mitrā Varuṇā</s>" (Come to us, <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>) and "<s>No gantam</s>" (Come to us) are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest].
7.11.3: "<s>Pra vo Mitrāya</s>" (Forth for <s>Mitra</s>) is the <s>ukthamukha</s> (opening of the <s>uktha</s>).
7.11.4: "<s>Pra Mitrayoḥ</s>" — of the nine [verses], having enclosed with the last, he offers with "<s>Upa naḥ sutam ā gatam</s>" (Come to our pressed [<s>Soma</s>]).

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.12.1: ā.yāhi.suṣuma.iti.brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ.stotriya.anurūpau /
ŚŚS_7.12.2: śeṣaḥ.sūktasya.uktha.mukham.uttame.parihāpya /
ŚŚS_7.12.3: indra.tvā.vṛṣabham /
ŚŚS_7.12.4: ud.ghed.abhi.iti.tisṛṇām.uttamayā.paridhāya.indra.kratuvidam.iti.yajati /
ŚŚS_7.13.1: indra.agnī.ā.gatam.sutam.ity.acchāvākasya.stotriya.anurūpau /
ŚŚS_7.13.2: śeṣaḥ.sūktasya.uktha.mukham /
ŚŚS_7.13.3: iha.indra.agnī.upa.hvaya.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_7.13.4: iyam.vāmasya.manmana.iti.navānām.uttamayā.paridhāya.indra.agnī.ā.gatam.sutam.iti.yajati /
body.translated_text:
7.12.1: "<s>Ā yāhi suṣuma</s>" (Come, O beautiful one) — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> [priest].
7.12.2: The rest of the hymn is the <s>ukthamukha</s> (opening of the <s>uktha</s>), omitting the last [verse].
7.12.3: [Then:] "<s>Indra tvā vṛṣabham</s>" (O <s>Indra</s>, you the bull).
7.12.4: Of the three [verses beginning] "<s>Ud ghed abhi</s>," having enclosed with the last, he offers with "<s>Indra kratuvidam</s>" (O <s>Indra</s>, knower of skill).
7.13.1: "<s>Indra Agnī ā gatam sutam</s>" (O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come to the pressed [<s>Soma</s>]) — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> of the <s>Acchāvāka</s>.
7.13.2: The rest of the hymn is the <s>ukthamukha</s>.
7.13.3: "<s>Iha Indra Agnī upa hvaye</s>" (Here I invoke <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>) — five [verses].
7.13.4: Of the nine [verses beginning] "<s>Iyam vāmasya manmanā</s>," having enclosed with the last, he offers with "<s>Indra Agnī ā gatam sutam</s>" (O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, come to the pressed [<s>Soma</s>]).

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.14.1: mitram.vayam.indram.id.gāthina.indra.agna.iti.stotriyā.bṛhat.pṛṣṭhasya /
ŚŚS_7.14.2: rāthantaram.acchāvākaḥ.stotriyam.anurūpam.kurute /
ŚŚS_7.14.3: anurūpam.uktha.mukham /
ŚŚS_7.14.4: catur.āhāvā.hotrakāḥ /
ŚŚS_7.14.5: hotā.ca.atirikta.uktheṣu /
ŚŚS_7.14.6: stotriya.anurūpābhyām.yac.ca.anantaram.anurūpāt.paridhānīyāyai.ca /
ŚŚS_7.14.7: anurūpād.anantaraḥ.pragāthas.tasmād.ūrdhvam.pañcamam.madhyaṃdine /
ŚŚS_7.14.8: uktha.mukhāt.sarveṣām.rātrau /
ŚŚS_7.14.9: yadā.adhvaryur.āha.praśāstaḥ.prasuhi.ity.om.sarpata.iti.praśāsta.āha /
ŚŚS_7.14.10: dakṣiṇa.āvṛto.aparayā.dvārā.nihsarpanty.uttareṇa.udumbarīm.dakṣiṇena.brahmā /
ŚŚS_7.14.11: agreṇa.śālām.udañcaḥ /
ŚŚS_7.14.12: mādhyaṃdināya.savanāya.yathā.nihsṛptam.prasṛpya.yathā.āsanam.upaviśanti /
body.translated_text:
7.14.1: 'mitraṃ vayam' (Mitra, we), 'indram id gāthinaḥ' (Indra indeed, the singers), 'indrāgna' (O Indra and Agni) — these are the <s>stotriya</s> (hymn) verses for the <s>Bṛhat-pṛṣṭha</s> (great-backed [chant]).
7.14.2: The <s>Acchāvāka</s> priest makes the <s>Rāthantara</s> [chant] the <s>stotriya</s> and the corresponding (<s>anurūpa</s>) [verse].
7.14.3: The <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding verse) is the opening of the <s>uktha</s> (recitation).
7.14.4: The <s>hotraka</s> (assistant invoker) priests have four invocations each.
7.14.5: And the <s>hotṛ</s> [has additional recitations] in the extra <s>uktha</s> sections.
7.14.6: [The recitation consists of] the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> [verses], and whatever follows the <s>anurūpa</s> up to the <s>paridhānīyā</s> (concluding verse).
7.14.7: The <s>pragātha</s> (paired verse) next after the <s>anurūpa</s>, from which [point] the fifth [recitation takes place] at midday.
7.14.8: [Starting] from the <s>uktha-mukha</s> (opening of recitation) for all [priests] at the night [pressing].
7.14.9: When the <s>adhvaryu</s> says 'praśāstaḥ prasuhi' (O director, urge forth), the director says 'om sarpata' (Oṃ, proceed).
7.14.10: Turning to the right, they process out through the rear door, going south...

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.15.1: ādau.mādhyaṃdinasya.savanasya.rājānam.abhiṣuṇvanti /
ŚŚS_7.15.2: grāvastut.pūrvayā.dvārā.havir.dhāne.prapadya.uttarasya.havir.dhānasya.dakṣiṇam.cakram.agreṇa.dakṣiṇā.tiṣṭhan.soma.upanahanena.mukham.pariveṣṭya.grāva.ghoṣam.śrutvā.asampreṣito.abhiṣṭauty.asaṃtanvann.ardharcaśo.anavānam.vā /

ŚŚS_7.15.5: dvitīyām.abhiṣṭutya.arbudasya.dve /
ŚŚS_7.15.6: tṛtīyām.abhiṣṭutya.arbudasya.ekām /
ŚŚS_7.15.7: mṛjanti.tvā.daśa.kṣipa.etam.u.tyam.daśa.kṣipa.etam.mṛjanti.marjyam.iti.mṛṣṭavatīr.abhiṣṭutya /
ŚŚS_7.15.8: ā.kalaśā.anūṣatā.kalaśeṣu.dhāvati.pari.pra.soma.te.rasa.iti.kalaśavatīr.abhiṣṭutya /
ŚŚS_7.15.9: āpyāyitavatī.prabhṛty.evam.vihṛto.dvitīyo.api.savaḥ.|.ṣaṣṭhī.prabhṛtayaḥ.pañca.arbudasya /
ŚŚS_7.15.10: evam.vihṛtas.tṛtīyo.api.savaḥ.|.tisro.arbudasya.ekādaśī.prabhṛtayaḥ /
ŚŚS_7.15.11: yasmin.save.bṛhat.śabdam.kuryur.bṛhad.vadantī.iti.tatra /
ŚŚS_7.15.12: ṣaṣṭhīm.prathame /
ŚŚS_7.15.13: vitate.pavitre.pavitram.ta.iti.dve.vi.yat.pavitram.ity.ekā /
ŚŚS_7.15.14: prāsya.dhārāḥ.pra.dhārā.asya.pra.te.dhārā.iti.prakṣarantīṣu.dhārāsu /
ŚŚS_7.15.15: graheṣu.gṛhyamāṇeṣu.yāḥ.kāmayeta.pāvamānīm /
ŚŚS_7.15.16: indrāya.indo.marutvata.iti.tisro.niyacchati /
ŚŚS_7.15.17: uttame.grahe.gṛhīte.arbudasya.uttamayā.paridhāya.ādāya.uṣṇīṣam.utsṛjyate /
ŚŚS_7.15.18: satra.ahīnānām.tv.antye.ahani /
ŚŚS_7.15.19: arbudam.vā.śuddham.abhiṣṭuyāt /
body.translated_text:
7.15.1: At the beginning of the midday pressing, they press the king [Soma].
7.15.2: The <s>Grāvastut</s> (stone-praiser) priest, having entered the <s>havirdhāna</s> (oblation-shed) through the front door, standing to the south in front of the southern wheel of the northern oblation-shed, having wrapped his face with a Soma-cloth, upon hearing the sound of the pressing stones, praises without being directed, [reciting] either by half-verses without interruption.
7.15.3: [The mantras are:] 'abhi tvā deva savitaḥ' (Unto thee, O divine Savitṛ), 'yuñjate manaḥ' (They yoke the mind), 'uta yuñjate dhiyaḥ' (And they yoke the thoughts), 'ā tū na indra kṣumantam' (Come to us, O Indra, with nourishment), 'ā no bhara' (Bring to us), 'dakṣiṇena' (With the right hand), 'upa kramasva' (Step forth), 'ā bhara' (Bring).
7.15.4: Having praised with the first of the three swelling verses — 'ā pyāyasva sametu te' (Swell up, may they come together for thee) — [then] two [verses] of <s>Arbuda</s>.
7.15.5: Having praised with the second — two [more verses] of <s>Arbuda</s>.
7.15.6: Having praised with the third...

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.16.1: mādhyaṃdine.stute.pavamānena.dadhi.gharmeṇa.caranti.yadi.pravargyavān /
ŚŚS_7.16.2: hotar.vadasva.ity.ukta.uttiṣṭhata.ava.paśyata.iti.prathamām.abhiṣṭauti /
ŚŚS_7.16.3: śrātam.havir.ity.ukte.dvitīyām.sūktasya /
ŚŚS_7.16.4: dadhi.gharmasya.yaja.ity.uktas.tṛtīyayā.yajati /
ŚŚS_7.16.5: anavānam.eka.ekām.sapraṇavām.abhiṣṭauti /
ŚŚS_7.16.6: tathā.yajati /
ŚŚS_7.16.7: dadhi.gharmasya.agne.vīhi.ity.anuvaṣaṭ.kāraḥ /
ŚŚS_7.16.8: mayi.tyad.indriyam.bṛhan.mayi.dakṣo.mayi.kratuḥ.|.gharmas.triśug.virocata.ākūtyā.manasā.saha.|.virājā.jyotiṣā.saha.tasya.doham.aśīmahi.|.iti.bhakṣa.mantraḥ /
ŚŚS_7.16.9: paśu.puroḷāśena.caritvā.ataḥ.puroḷāśaiḥ.savanīyaiś.caranti /
body.translated_text:
7.16.1: When the midday [pressing] has been praised with the <s>Pavamāna</s> [chant], they perform the <s>dadhi-gharma</s> (hot curdled milk offering) if [the sacrifice] includes the <s>Pravargya</s>.
7.16.2: When told 'O <s>hotṛ</s>, speak,' he praises with the first [verse]: 'uttiṣṭhata ava paśyata' (Arise, look down).
7.16.3: When [the adhvaryu] says 'śrātaṃ haviḥ' (The oblation is cooked), [he recites] the second [verse] of the hymn.
7.16.4: When told 'dadhi-gharmasya yaja' (Sacrifice with the hot curdled milk), he offers with the third [verse].
7.16.5: He praises each one singly, without interruption, with the <s>praṇava</s> (oṃ).
7.16.6: Similarly he offers.
7.16.7: 'dadhi-gharmasya agne vīhi' (O Agni, convey the hot curdled milk) — the <s>anuvaṣaṭkāra</s> (subsidiary exclamation).
7.16.8: [The partaking formula:] 'mayi tyad indriyam bṛhan mayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ | gharmas triśug virocat ākūtyā manasā saha | virājā jyotiṣā saha tasya doham aśīmahi' (May that great power of Indra [be] in me, may skill [be] in me, may resolve [be] in me; may the <s>gharma</s> shine with the threefold syllable, together with intention and mind, together with sovereign splendor and light — may we partake of its milking) — this is the partaking mantra.

body.text:
ŚŚS_7.17.1: mādhyandinasya.savanasya.iti.puronuvākyā /
ŚŚS_7.17.2: mādhyaṃdine.savana.iti.sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
ŚŚS_7.17.3: asāvi.devam.ity.unnīyamāna.sūktam /

ŚŚS_7.17.6: dvitīyā.maitrāvaruṇasya /
ŚŚS_7.17.7: tṛtīyā.brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ /
ŚŚS_7.17.8: arvān.ehi.iti.potuḥ /

ŚŚS_7.17.11: āpūrṇo.asya.ity.āgnīdhrasya /
ŚŚS_7.17.12: na.dvidevatya.ṛtu.yājā.uttarayoḥ.savanayoḥ /
ŚŚS_7.17.13: na.bahiṣ.karma.acchāvākasya /
ŚŚS_7.17.14: samānam.anyat.prātaḥ.savanena /
ŚŚS_7.17.15: iḷām.upahūya.prasthitān.bhakṣayitvā /
ŚŚS_7.17.16: eṣa.dakṣiṇā.kālaḥ /
ŚŚS_7.17.17: dvādaśam.śatam.gavām.dadyāt /
ŚŚS_7.17.18: ekaviṃśati.prabhṛti.vā.yathā.upapādam /
body.translated_text:
7.17.1: 'mādhyandinasya savanasya' (Of the midday pressing) — this is the <s>puronuvākyā</s> (invitatory verse).
7.17.2: 'mādhyaṃdine savane' (At the midday pressing) — [the verse] for the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s>.
7.17.3: 'asāvi devam' (This has been pressed for the god) — the hymn [recited] while [the Soma juice] is being drawn off.
7.17.4: 'hotā yakṣad indram mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya' (May the <s>hotṛ</s> worship Indra at the midday pressing) — this is the directive (<s>praiṣa</s>).
7.17.5: 'pibā somam abhi yam ugra' (Drink the Soma, O mighty one, which) — thus he offers.
7.17.6: The second [cup belongs] to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> priest.
7.17.7: The third to the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> priest.
7.17.8: 'arvān ehi' (Come hither) — [the cup] of the <s>Potṛ</s> priest.
7.17.9: 'tava ayam soma' (This thy Soma) — [the cup] of the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s> priest.
7.17.10: 'indrāya somāḥ pradivo vidānāḥ' (The Soma [juices] offered to Indra from the beginning of the day) — [the cup] of the <s>Acchāvāka</s> priest.
7.17.11: 'āpūrṇo asya' (This is filled) — [the cup] of the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> priest.
7.17.12: [There are] no dual-deity seasonal offerings at the two latter pressings.
7.17.13: Nor...

body.text:

ŚŚS_7.18.4: yamāya.tvā.mahyam.varuṇo.dadātu.so.amṛtatvam.aśīya.|.hayo.dātra.edhi.mayo.mahyam.pratigṛhṇata.ity.eka.śapham /
ŚŚS_7.18.5: prajāpataye.tvā.mahyam.varuṇo.dadātu.so.amṛtatvam.aśīya.|.prāṇo.dātra.edhi.mayo.mahyam.pratigṛhṇata.ity.anyat /

7.18.1: [Reciting:] 'agnaye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya | āyur dātra edhi mayo mahyam pratigṛhṇata' (To Agni [I dedicate] thee; may Varuṇa give [thee] to me; may I attain immortality; O gift, be a lifespan; be joy to me; accept!) — he receives the gold.
7.18.2: [Reciting:] 'rudrāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya | gaur dātra edhi mayo mahyam pratigṛhṇat' (To Rudra [I dedicate] thee; may Varuṇa give [thee] to me; may I attain immortality; O gift, be a cow; be joy to me; accept!) — he receives the cows.
7.18.3: [Reciting:] 'bṛhaspataye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya | tvag dātra edhi mayo mahyam pratigṛhṇata' (To Bṛhaspati [I dedicate] thee; may Varuṇa give [thee] to me; may I attain immortality; O gift, be a garment; be joy to me; accept!) — he receives the garment.
7.18.4: [Reciting:] 'yamāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya | hayo dātra edhi mayo mahyam pratigṛhṇata' (To Yama [I dedicate] thee; may Varuṇa give [thee] to me; may I attain immortality; O gift, be a horse; be joy to me; accept!) — he receives the single-hoofed animal.
7.18.5: [Reciting:] 'prajāpataye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so 'mṛtatvam aśīya | prāṇo dātra edhi mayo mahyam pratigṛhṇata' (To Prajāpati [I dedicate] thee; may Varuṇa give [thee] to me; may I attain immortality; O gift, be breath; be joy to me; accept!) — he receives...

body.translated_text:
(7.27.1) The <s>Gāyatrī</s> has three feet (<s>pādas</s>).
(7.27.2) [Then] <s>Uṣṇih</s>.
(7.27.3) [Then] <s>Pura-uṣṇih</s>.
(7.27.4) [Then] <s>Kakubh</s>.
(7.27.5) The first <s>Virāj</s>.
(7.27.6) The latter <s>Virāj</s> has four feet.
(7.27.7) [Then] <s>Bṛhatī</s>.
(7.27.8) [Then] <s>Satobṛhatī</s>.
(7.27.9) [Then] <s>Jagatī</s>.
(7.27.10) [Then] <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>.
(7.27.11) And <s>Triṣṭubh</s>.
(7.27.12) Five [syllables per foot] for <s>Paṅkti</s>.
(7.27.13) Six and seven [syllables per foot] for the <s>Aticchandas</s> (hyper-meters).
(7.27.14) '<s>Sa hi śardho na mārutam</s>' — eight [syllables].
(7.27.15) Two [feet] for the <s>Dvipadā</s>.
(7.27.16) Those [feet] have eight syllables each, generally.
(7.27.17) Twelve syllables for the <s>Jagatī</s> [per foot].
(7.27.18) The third [foot] belongs to both <s>Uṣṇih</s> and <s>Bṛhatī</s>.
(7.27.19) And the first and third [feet] of <s>Satobṛhatī</s>.
(7.27.20) The middle [foot] of <s>Kakubh</s>.
(7.27.21) The first [foot] of <s>Pura-uṣṇih</s>.
(7.27.22) Eleven syllables for <s>Triṣṭubh</s> and <s>Virāj</s> [per foot].
(7.27.27) The latter [<s>Virāj</s>] has ten syllables. That they also call '<s>Akṣara-paṅkti</s>' (syllable-row). With five [feet] of five syllables each — [that is] <s>Pada-paṅkti</s> (foot-row). Six [feet] of eight syllables also [belong to] <s>Jagatī</s>. When deficient by one or two [syllables] — [that is] <s>Nicṛt</s> (diminished).
(7.27.28) When in excess — [that is] <s>Bhurik</s> (augmented).
(7.27.29) Having completed [the count], the verses of the secondary [<s>stotra</s>] are made complete with a foot-portion, accomplished by a foot-portion of that [meter].
(7.27.30) <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Uṣṇih</s>, <s>Anuṣṭubh</s>, <s>Bṛhatī</s>, <s>Paṅkti</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, <s>Jagatī</s> — this is the sequential order of meters, beginning with twenty-four syllables [and increasing by four].

body.translated_text:
(8.1.1) As for the midday [pressing], so [the priests] proceed after midday.
(8.1.2) At the beginning of the third pressing, they proceed with the <s>Āditya-graha</s> (cup for the <s>Ādityas</s>).
(8.1.3) '<s>Ādityebhyaḥ</s>' (For the <s>Ādityas</s>) — [thus] it is called.
(8.1.4) '<s>Ādityānām avasā</s>' (With the help of the <s>Ādityas</s>) — this is the invitatory verse (<s>puronuvākyā</s>).
(8.1.5) '<s>Hotā yakṣad ādityān</s>' (May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship the <s>Ādityas</s>) — this is the directive (<s>praiṣa</s>).
(8.1.6) '<s>Ādityāso aditiḥ</s>' (The <s>Ādityas</s> and <s>Aditi</s>) — with this he offers.
(8.1.7) He does not look at the oblation nor partake of it.
(8.1.8) And [likewise] at the <s>Sāvitra-graha</s> (cup for <s>Savitṛ</s>).
(8.1.9) When the <s>Ārbhava</s> (hymn to the <s>Ṛbhus</s>) <s>Pavamāna</s> (<s>Soma</s>-purification chant) has been sung, having performed the ritual from <s>Manotā</s> up to <s>Iḷā</s>, thereafter they proceed with the <s>savanīya</s> (pressing-day) sacrificial cakes.

ŚŚS_8.2.13: iḷām.upahūya.prasthitān.bhakṣayitvā.puroḷāśasya.parivāpa.miśrasya.nārāśaṃsānām.sannānām.yathā.camasam.dakṣiṇatas.trīṃs.trīn.piṇḍān.upāsyanty.atra.pitaro.mādayadhvam.yathā.bhāgam.pitara.āvṛṣāyadhvam.iti.pṇḍe.piṇḍe /
body.translated_text:
(8.2.1) '<s>Dhānāḥ savane</s>' (Grains at the pressing) in the third [pressing] — this is the invitatory verse.
(8.2.2) '<s>Agne tṛtīye savane</s>' (O <s>Agni</s>, at the third pressing) — this belongs to <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (the oblation for making the sacrifice successful).
(8.2.3) '<s>Iha upa yata</s>' (Come here) — this is the hymn [recited] while the [<s>Soma</s>] is being drawn up.
(8.2.4) '<s>Hotā yakṣad Indram tṛtīyasya savanasya</s>' (May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship <s>Indra</s> of the third pressing) — this is the directive.
(8.2.5) '<s>Indra Ṛbhubhir vājavad-bhiḥ</s>' (O <s>Indra</s>, with the prize-winning <s>Ṛbhus</s>) — with this he offers.
(8.2.6) '<s>Indrā Varuṇā sutapāu</s>' (<s>Indra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, drinkers of the pressed [<s>Soma</s>]) — [this belongs to] the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest].
(8.2.7) '<s>Indraś ca Somam</s>' (<s>Indra</s> and <s>Soma</s>) — [this belongs to] the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>.
(8.2.8) '<s>Ā vo vahantu</s>' (May they bring to you) — [this belongs to] the <s>Potṛ</s>.
(8.2.9) '<s>Amā iva naḥ</s>' (Like at home for us) — [this belongs to] the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>.
(8.2.10) '<s>Indrā Viṣṇū pibatam</s>' (<s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, drink!) — [this belongs to] the <s>Acchāvāka</s>.
(8.2.11) '<s>Imam stomam</s>' (This praise) — [this belongs to] the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>.
(8.2.12) The rest is the same as the morning pressing.
(8.2.13) Having invoked <s>Iḷā</s>, having partaken of the [<s>Soma</s>] that has been drawn forth, [they offer] three balls each, from the south side, in order of the cups, of the sacrificial cake mixed with <s>parivāpa</s> (parched grain) [and] of the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> offerings [that have been] cooked — [saying] at each ball: 'Here, O Fathers, delight yourselves' [and] 'O Fathers, refresh yourselves according to your share.'

body.translated_text:
(8.3.1) '<s>Devāya Savitre</s>' (For the divine <s>Savitṛ</s>) — [thus] it is called.
(8.3.2) '<s>Abhūd deva</s>' (The god has become) — this is the invitatory verse.
(8.3.3) '<s>Hotā yakṣad devam Savitāram</s>' (May the <s>Hotṛ</s> worship the divine <s>Savitṛ</s>) — this is the directive.
(8.3.4) '<s>Damūnā devaḥ Savitā vareṇyo dadhad ratnam dakṣapitṛbhya āyuni | pibāt Somam amadann enam iṣṭayaḥ parijmā cid ramate asya dharmaṇi</s>' (The bountiful divine <s>Savitṛ</s>, the desirable, placing the jewel for the sons of <s>Dakṣa</s> in life; may he drink <s>Soma</s>; the offerings have gladdened him; even the all-pervading one rejoices in his ordinance) — with this he offers.
(8.3.5) '<s>Adhvaryo śośoṃsāvaḥ</s>' (O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, let us recite together) — this is the call (<s>āhāva</s>) at the beginning of the <s>śastra</s> (recitation) in the third pressing when accompanied by an <s>uktha</s>.
(8.3.6) The interior of the recitation follows the [pattern of the] morning pressing.
(8.3.7) And [likewise] from the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s> onward.
(8.3.8) '<s>Tat Savituḥ vṛṇīmahe</s>' (We choose that of <s>Savitṛ</s>) [and] '<s>Adyā no deva Savitar</s>' (Today, O divine <s>Savitṛ</s>) — these two triplets are the opening and following [verses] of the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [recitation].
(8.3.9) '<s>Abhūd deva</s>' — this is the <s>Sāvitra</s> [section].
(8.3.10) '<s>Ekayā ca daśabhiś ca svabhūte dvābhyām iṣṭaye viṃśatī ca | tisṛbhiś ca vahase triṃśatā ca niyudbhir Vāyav iha tā muñcaḥ</s>' (With one and with ten, O self-existent one; with two for the sacrifice and with twenty; and with three you carry, and with thirty teams — O <s>Vāyu</s>, release them here!).
(8.3.11) '<s>Pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhaḥ</s>' (The heaven and earth, increasers of <s>Ṛta</s>, through sacrifices) — this is the <s>Dyāvāpṛthivīya</s> [section].
(8.3.12) '<s>Madvān</s>' (One who has mead) — [the word] in these [verses is] the response (<s>pratigara</s>).
(8.3.13) '<s>Surūpakṛtnum</s>' (The maker of beautiful forms) — one [verse].
(8.3.14) '<s>Takṣan ratham</s>' (They fashioned the chariot) — this is the <s>Ārbhava</s> [section, dedicated to the <s>Ṛbhus</s>].
(8.3.15) '<s>Ayam Venaḥ</s>' [and] '<s>Yebhyaḥ mātā</s>' [and] '<s>Evā pitre</s>' — these are single-footed (<s>ekapātinī</s>) [verses].
(8.3.16) '<s>Ā no bhadrāḥ</s>' (May auspicious [thoughts] come to us) — [this is recited] at the end of the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>, having left the <s>Nivid</s> (insertion formula).
(8.3.17) The enclosing verse (<s>paridhānīyā</s>) is the last.
(8.3.18) Afterward, [he recites it] twice, by half-verses, [as] the third.
(8.3.19) Having muttered the <s>uktha-vīrya</s> (praise of power), he offers with '<s>Viśve devāḥ śṛṇuta imam</s>' (O All-gods, hear this).

body.translated_text:
(8.4.1) When told '<s>Ghṛtasya yaja</s>' (Offer the ghee), he offers in a low voice with '<s>Ghṛtam mimikṣe</s>' (The ghee has mingled).
(8.4.2) When told '<s>Saumyasya yaja</s>' (Offer the <s>Soma</s>), he offers with '<s>Tvam Soma pitṛbhiḥ</s>' (You, O <s>Soma</s>, with the Fathers).
(8.4.3) When told '<s>Ghṛtasya yaja</s>' (Offer the ghee) — '<s>Uru Viṣṇo vi kramasva uru kṣayāya nas kṛdhi | ghṛta ghṛtayone piba pra pra yajñapatim tira</s>' (Stride widely, O <s>Viṣṇu</s>; make wide room for our dwelling; O ghee, O source of ghee, drink; further and further convey the lord of the sacrifice) — he offers in a low voice.
(8.4.4) There is an option in the circumambulatory [offering].
(8.4.5) The <s>Hotṛ</s>, having observed the <s>Soma</s> [cup], touches the ghee with his fingers.
(8.4.6) '<s>Cakṣuṣpā asi cakṣur me pāhi</s>' (You are the protector of sight; protect my sight) — [saying this,] he wipes his eyes.

ŚŚS_8.5.7: yathā.itam.pratyetya /
body.translated_text:
(8.5.1) When the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> is told '<s>Pātnīvatasya yaja</s>' (Offer the [cup] belonging to the Wives [of the gods]), he offers in a low voice with '<s>Aibhir Agne saratham</s>' (With these, O <s>Agni</s>, in the same chariot).
(8.5.2) Without having partaken, taking the cup, he enters the <s>Sadas</s> (ritual hall) by the front door.
(8.5.3) Having sat down to the north of the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>.
(8.5.4) Or on [his] lap.
(8.5.5) Having said '<s>Neṣṭar upahvayasva</s>' (O <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>, invoke!).
(8.5.6) Having partaken and having sipped water.
(8.5.7) He returns as [he came].

body.translated_text:
(8.6.1) The <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> <s>stotra</s> (chant) [belongs to] the <s>Āgnimāruta</s> [recitation].
(8.6.2) '<s>Vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase</s>' (For <s>Vaiśvānara</s> of broad luster) — this is the <s>Vaiśvānarīya</s> [section].
(8.6.3) '<s>Ā te pitar</s>' (To you, O Father) — one [verse].
(8.6.4) '<s>Pratvakṣasaḥ</s>' (The powerful ones) — this is the <s>Māruta</s> [section, dedicated to the <s>Maruts</s>].
(8.6.5) '<s>Yajñā yajñā vo Agnaye</s>' (Sacrifice upon sacrifice to your <s>Agni</s>) [and] '<s>Devo vo draviṇodāḥ</s>' (The god, giver of wealth to you) — these are the <s>stotriya</s> (chant-verse) and <s>anurūpa</s> (response-verse) couplets of the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.
(8.6.6) '<s>Pra tavyasīm</s>' (Forth, the mightiest) — this is the <s>Jātavedasīya</s> [section].
(8.6.7) '<s>Āpo hi ṣṭhā</s>' (O Waters, you indeed are) — three [verses].
(8.6.8) '<s>Uta no Ahir Budhnyaḥ śṛṇotu</s>' (And may <s>Ahi Budhnya</s> hear us) — one [verse].
(8.6.9) '<s>Devānām patnīḥ</s>' (Wives of the gods) — two [verses].
(8.6.10) '<s>Rākām aham</s>' (I [invoke] <s>Rākā</s>) — two [verses].
(8.6.11) '<s>Avidad dakṣam</s>' (He found power) — three [verses] in <s>Akṣara-paṅkti</s> [meter].
(8.6.12) '<s>Ud īratām</s>' (May they rise up) — three verses for the Fathers (<s>Paitrya</s>).
(8.6.13) '<s>Imam Yama</s>' [and] '<s>Mātalī</s>' [and] '<s>Kavyair Aṅgirobhiḥ</s>' (With the wise <s>Aṅgirases</s>) — these belong to <s>Yama</s> (<s>Yāmya</s>).
(8.6.14) The <s>Svāduṣkilīya</s> [verses] — three.
(8.6.15) '<s>Madvān</s>' (One who has mead) — in these [is] the response.
(8.6.16) '<s>Yayor ojasā</s>' [and] '<s>Viṣṇor nu kam</s>' [and] '<s>Tantum tanvan</s>' (Weaving the thread) — these are single-footed (<s>ekapātinī</s>) [verses].
(8.6.17) Having enclosed with '<s>Evā na Indro maghavā</s>' (Thus to us <s>Indra</s> the bountiful), having muttered the <s>uktha-vīrya</s>, he offers with '<s>Agne Marudbhiḥ śubhayadbhiḥ</s>' (O <s>Agni</s>, with the shining <s>Maruts</s>).

body.translated_text: 8.7.1: The first <s>nivid</s> (insertion formula) belongs to the <s>Marutvatīya</s> [recitation]. 8.7.2: The second to the <s>Niṣkevalya</s>. 8.7.3: The third and following ones to the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> and <s>Āgnimāruta</s>. 8.7.4: The last to the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s> (sixteenfold). 8.7.5: As many hymns as there are, so many are the <s>nivids</s>. 8.7.6: The <s>āhāva</s> (call) [comes] before each hymn. 8.7.7: And a <s>nivid</s> after each <s>nivid</s>. 8.7.8: And after each single-footed [verse]. 8.7.9: And after the concluding verse (<s>paridhānīyā</s>). 8.7.10: In the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>, [the <s>nivid</s> is placed] at the opening and following [verses]. 8.7.11: In the <s>Āgnimāruta</s>, at the <s>stotriya</s> (chant-verse) and <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding verse). 8.7.12: Of the '<s>āpo hi ṣṭhā</s>' [hymns]. 8.7.13: Of [the hymns to] the wives of the gods. 8.7.14: And of <s>Rākā</s>. 8.7.15: Of the syllable-<s>paṅkti</s> [verses]. 8.7.16: Of the ancestral [verses]. 8.7.17: Of the <s>Yama</s>-related [verses]. 8.7.18: And of the <s>Svāduṣkilīya</s> [verses]. 8.7.19: The recitation (<s>śastra</s>) of the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> is interspersed. 8.7.20: At the beginning of the <s>Āgnimāruta</s>, excluding the '<s>āpo hi ṣṭhā</s>' [hymns]. 8.7.21: Having placed the <s>Soma</s> plants in water, having performed the animal rite from the <s>anuyāja</s> (after-offering) to the <s>Śamī</s> [concluding formula], they proceed with the <s>Hāriyojana</s> (yoking of the bay horses).

body.translated_text: 8.8.1: 'Stand firm' — this is the <s>puronuvākyā</s> (invitatory verse). 8.8.2: 'The parched grains of the <s>Somas</s>, O <s>Indra</s>' — this is the directive (<s>praiṣa</s>). 8.8.3: 'I yoke for you' — this is the <s>yājyā</s> (offering verse). 8.8.4: 'The parched grains of the <s>Somas</s>; O <s>Agni</s>, partake' — this is the <s>anuvaṣaṭkāra</s> (subsidiary vaṣaṭ call). 8.8.5: Or 'of <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Agni</s>.' 8.8.6: 'Of [the Soma] shaken in the waters, O divine <s>Soma</s>, yours, [known] by the wise men — of the praised praise, the recited <s>uktha</s>, the offered <s>yajus</s>, whoever is the winner of horses, the winner of cows — of that portion of yours, being invoked, I, the invoked one, partake' — having partaken of the breath-offerings (<s>prāṇabhakṣa</s>), they distribute the parched grains. 8.8.7: The <s>Hotṛ</s> should seek to obtain the most. 8.8.9: 'As indeed then, O <s>Vasus</s>' — having looked at the <s>dhiṣṇya</s> hearths, they come north of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> to the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.

body.translated_text: 8.8.10: '<s>Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā</s>; you, O <s>Agni</s>, who are nearest; you, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing <s>Varuṇa</s>'s [ways]; may that be so, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>' — they offer the expiatory oblations (<s>prāyaścitta āhuti</s>) at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>. 8.8.11: 'Fill up! Do not [diminish]; fill me with offspring and cattle' — having placed parched grains at the edge of the ashes of the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, they place five groups of five pieces.

body.translated_text: 8.9.1: 'You are the expiation of sin committed by oneself; you are the expiation of sin committed by humans; you are the expiation of sin committed by the fathers; you are the expiation of sin committed by the gods. Whatever sin I committed knowingly, whatever unknowingly — you are the expiation of all that.' 8.9.2: Turning leftward, north of the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, [they go] to the <s>Soma</s> plants placed in water, each sitting behind his <s>camasa</s> (cup), placing the strainers (<s>pavitra</s>), and stirring: 'Waters, unite with waters; plants, with [their] essence. May the rich ones mingle with the flowing ones; may the sweet ones mingle with the sweet ones.' 8.9.3: 'We have been summoned together.' 8.9.4: 'Of [the Soma] shaken in the waters, O divine <s>Soma</s>, yours, [known] by the wise — whoever is the winner of horses, the winner of cows — of that portion of yours, being invoked, I, the invoked one, partake' — having partaken of the breath-offerings, [they proceed]. 8.9.5: 'Without shadow; by whose might' — leading [the waters] eastward or northward. 8.9.6: 'Like the ocean' — consecrating with the <s>mantra</s>. 8.9.7: 'May the divine waters be auspicious to us' — touching the chest with the four [verses]. 8.9.8: The same breath-touching and face-wiping [as before]. 8.9.9: Turning rightward, at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>, having tasted curds, as is the procedure for the curd-partaking (<s>dadhībhakṣa</s>). 8.9.10: Having concluded the <s>patnīsaṃyājas</s> (wife's offerings), when the concluding oblations (<s>samiṣṭayajus</s>) have been offered, he goes for the concluding bath (<s>avabhṛtha</s>).

body.translated_text: 8.10.1a: 'May vital power return to me, may my self, wealth, sacred knowledge [return]. May the fires on the hearths (<s>dhiṣṇya</s>) sustain [me] in their proper places, right here.' 8.10.1b: The sacrificer, looking at the <s>dhiṣṇya</s> hearths — or when the <s>anūbandhyā</s> (concluding animal) has been completed — should look at the priests. 8.10.1c: 'Both poets, both young, truth-givers, lords of the law of truth — let us release our friendships.' 8.10.2: 'For the king is broad' — following along. 8.10.3: All join in the concluding note (<s>nidhana</s>) of the <s>sāman</s>. 8.10.4: 'Homage to <s>Varuṇa</s>; I am seized by <s>Varuṇa</s>'s noose' — placing the foot in the water.

body.translated_text: 8.11.1: The <s>Vāruṇī iṣṭi</s> (offering to <s>Varuṇa</s>). 8.11.2: [It is] a modification of the full-moon [sacrifice]. 8.11.3: '<s>Agni</s> in the waters'; 'O <s>Soma</s>, my [offering] in the waters' — or the two water-relating [verses]. 8.11.4: He sacrifices while standing. 8.11.5: 'Up, the highest, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; lower your anger.' 8.11.6: 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, who are nearest; you, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing <s>Varuṇa</s>'s [ways]' — he designates <s>Agni-and-Varuṇa</s>. 8.11.7: He does not recite the <s>nigada</s> (citation). 8.11.8: Or he may recite [it]. 8.11.9: He performs the <s>prayājas</s> (fore-offerings) and <s>anuyājas</s> (after-offerings) without the sacred grass (<s>apabarhiṣas</s>). 8.11.10: From the <s>prayāja</s> onward to the <s>anuyāja</s>. 8.11.11: Or up to the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s>. 8.11.12: Or excluding the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (ghee-portions) and the <s>anuyājas</s>. 8.11.13: 'By which you two [<s>Aśvins</s>] made the woman, by which you touched the <s>surā</s> (liquor), by which you sprinkled the earth, this great earth — whatever glory of yours that was, O <s>Aśvins</s>, sprinkle me with that' — the <s>Hotṛ</s> sprinkles [the sacrificer]. 8.11.14: 'With a propitious eye I approach the houses as a human' — [says] the sacrificer as he returns. 8.11.15: 'Here may <s>Pūṣan</s> of a thousand gifts sit down' — sitting down, he places two kindling sticks on the <s>Āhavanīya</s>: 'You are the kindling stick of the gods' — the first; silently, the second. 8.11.16: The wife [places one] silently on the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.translated_text: 8.12.1: By the <s>prāyaṇīya</s> (opening offering), the <s>udayanīya</s> (closing offering) is explained. 8.12.2: The <s>yājyā</s> and <s>puronuvākyā</s> are reversed, excluding the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s>. 8.12.3: He sacrifices to <s>Pathyā Svasti</s> (auspicious path) as the fourth. 8.12.4: To <s>Savitṛ</s> as the third. 8.12.5: And the <s>Maitrāvaruṇī</s> (to Mitra-and-Varuṇa) and a barren cow (<s>vaśā</s>) as the concluding animal (<s>anūbandhyā</s>). 8.12.6: Or a milk offering (<s>payasyā</s>). 8.12.7: 'Come to you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; that [is] well for you, O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>' — these are the <s>puronuvākyā</s>s (invitatory verses). 8.12.8: 'You two [give] garments; whatever is most abundant; stretch forth the arms' — these are the <s>yājyā</s>s (offering verses). 8.12.10: From the <s>dīkṣaṇīya</s> (consecration offering) onward until the completion of the <s>anūbandhyā</s>, he does not make the wife recite, nor does he strew [the sacred grass]. 8.12.10: Having made [the wife] recite at the <s>anūbandhyā</s>, he strews [sacred grass] in front of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> hearth. 8.12.11a: 'Do not harm the waters; do not [harm] the plants. You are burning pain; may your burning pain reach him whom we hate.' 8.12.11b: 'From station to station, O King <s>Varuṇa</s>, release us from that. Whatever [sin we committed] against the inviolable waters — from that, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, release us.' 8.12.11c: Having worshipped the heart-spit (<s>hṛdayaśūla</s>): 'May the waters and plants be friendly to us' — touching water. 'May they be unfriendly to him who hates us and whom we hate' — they sprinkle to the south. 8.12.12: Or the milk offering (<s>payasyā</s>) from the <s>ājyabhāga</s> onward. 8.12.13: [It is] a modification of the new-moon [sacrifice]. 8.12.14: Without <s>nigada</s> (citation), up to and including the <s>Iḍā</s>.

body.translated_text: 8.13.1: Having concluded [the Soma sacrifice] in the north, having offered a full oblation (<s>pūrṇāhuti</s>) with a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> (to Viṣṇu) verse, he sacrifices with the <s>udavasānīya</s> (concluding offering). 8.13.2: [It is] an <s>Āgneyī iṣṭi</s> (offering to Agni). 8.13.3: [It is] a modification of the full-moon [sacrifice]. 8.13.4: The [verses] for the oblation and the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> are those of the fire re-establishment (<s>punarādheya</s>). 8.13.5: The re-establishment offering (<s>paunarādheyikī iṣṭi</s>) [is performed] with five potsherds. 8.13.6: When [the offering] is completed, he offers the evening <s>Agnihotra</s>.

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.15.1: He restrains his speech from the release [of the direction] for whomever he is directing.
ŚŚS 8.15.2: And from the beginning of the call (<s>āhāva</s>) until the <s>anuvaṣaṭ</s> response.
ŚŚS 8.15.3: During the morning litany (<s>prātaranuvāka</s>), [he acts as] the <s>Brahman</s> [priest].
ŚŚS 8.15.4: And after consuming [the Soma], until the authorization of the <s>stotra</s> (chant).
ŚŚS 8.15.5: And from the authorization onward until the <s>anuvaṣaṭ</s> response.
ŚŚS 8.15.6: Having heard [up to] the end of the supplementary direction (<s>atipraiṣa</s>), from the carrying around of the overnight water (<s>vasatīvarī</s>).
ŚŚS 8.15.7: 'Whatever drop of yours spills' [and] 'A drop has fallen' — the offering of the spilt drops [is performed] before the <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants].
ŚŚS 8.15.8: And when [the Soma] moves forward, he follows along.
ŚŚS 8.15.9: And the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest likewise].
ŚŚS 8.15.10: And in the fire-building (<s>Agnicayana</s>), when the fire is being led forward, he mutters the <s>Apratiratham</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 8.15.11: 'In all directions, from the south, you have worshipped all the gods here. Of the <s>gharma</s> (hot offering) made pure with <s>Svāhā</s>, O <s>Aśvins</s>, drink the sweet one!' — following along after the <s>Mahāvīra</s> [vessel].
ŚŚS 8.15.12: 'O <s>Aśvins</s>, drink the <s>gharma</s>; the one of the <s>Hārdvāna</s> [ritual], by day with daily aids; homage to the <s>Tantrāyin</s>, to heaven and earth!' — when the <s>vaṣaṭ</s> call is made.
ŚŚS 8.15.15: 'The <s>Aśvins</s> have drunk the <s>gharma</s>; heaven and earth have approved; may the gifts be here indeed' — when the <s>anuvaṣaṭ</s> response is made.
ŚŚS 8.15.15: What is not specified [elsewhere] is the same.
ŚŚS 8.15.15: Thus [concludes] the <s>Brahman</s> priest's duties in the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice].

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.16.1a: [The <s>nivid</s> litany:] 'May <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s> drink the <s>Soma</s>. He who is praised by the <s>Maruts</s>; he of the <s>Marut</s> host; he who is strengthened by the <s>Maruts</s>; the friend of the <s>Maruts</s>. Him whom the gods accompanied in overcoming the waters, in overcoming <s>Vṛtra</s>, in slaying <s>Śambara</s>, in the cattle-quest; praising him in the secret place.'
ŚŚS 8.16.1b: 'In the farthest distance, he slew <s>Vṛtra</s>, he released the waters, together with the might of the <s>Maruts</s>, increasing the sacred utterances, unconquerable by [any] force.'
ŚŚS 8.16.1c: 'Making worship for the gods, together with the <s>Maruts</s> as companions — may <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s> hear here, may he drink the <s>Soma</s> here! May the god with divine thought protect this divine invocation. May he protect this <s>brahman</s>, this <s>kṣatra</s>, this pressing sacrificer.'
ŚŚS 8.16.1d: 'The resplendent one, with resplendent aids — may he hear the sacred utterances, may he come with [his] protection.'
ŚŚS 8.16.2: Now the <s>ukthavīrya</s> (praise of prowess).
ŚŚS 8.16.3: 'Form, like-form, counter-form, good-form — hearing auspicious things — O you who are here, a <s>uktha</s> (praise) has been spoken for <s>Indra</s>.'

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.17.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May <s>Indra</s>, the god, drink the <s>Soma</s>. The most heroic of the singly-born; the strongest of the multiply-born; the wielder of the bay horses; the offspring of <s>Pṛśni</s> (the dappled one); the bearer of the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt); the breaker of fortresses.'
ŚŚS 8.17.1: 'The destroyer of citadels; the leader of the waters; the leader of warriors; the slayer from afar, the far-famed; the surpasser, the wondrous one. The god who has willingly been here — may <s>Indra</s>, the god, hear here, may he drink the <s>Soma</s> here! May the god...' — the rest is the same [as before].
ŚŚS 8.17.2: Now the <s>ukthavīrya</s>.
ŚŚS 8.17.3: 'You are the sovereign (<s>samrāj</s>); you are the self-ruler (<s>svarāj</s>); you are the far-ruler (<s>virāj</s>); you are the king; you are the conqueror — may we be the conquerors [over] him whom we hate. Hearing [auspicious things] — a <s>uktha</s> has been spoken...'

ŚŚS 8.18.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May <s>Savitṛ</s>, the divine, be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s>. The golden-handed, the fair-tongued; the fair-armed, the fair-fingered; pressing thrice daily, whose pressings are true; who has impelled the wealth-container; both the beloved ones [I impel] with the impelling; the best of <s>Savitṛ</s>'s impulsions; the milch cow that gives milk; the ox that draws the wagon.'
ŚŚS 8.18.1: 'The swift horse; the victorious chariot-warrior; the wise woman; the young man fit for the assembly. May <s>Savitṛ</s>, the divine, send away disease, send away evil speech — may he hear here, may he be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s> here! May the god...' — the rest is the same.

ŚŚS_8.19.1a: dyāvā.pṛthivī.somasya.matsatām.|.pitā.ca.mātā.ca.|.dhenuś.ca.ṛṣabhaś.ca.|.dhanyā.ca.dhiṣaṇā.ca.|.suretāś.ca.sudughā.ca.|.śambhūś.ca.mayobhūś.ca.|.ūrjasvatī.ca.payasvatī.ca.|.dyāvā.pṛthivī.iha.śrutām.iha.somasya.matsatām /

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.19.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth) be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s>. Father and mother; the cow and the bull; the grain-giving and the supporting; the well-seeded and the well-milking; the beneficent and the delightful; the nourishing and the milky — may <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> hear here, may they be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s> here!'
ŚŚS 8.19.1b: 'May the two divine ones protect this divine invocation with divine thought. May they protect this <s>brahman</s>, this <s>kṣatra</s>, this pressing sacrificer. The two resplendent ones, with resplendent aids — may they hear the sacred utterances, may they come with protection.'

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.20.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, the divine, be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s>. The all-pervading, of good workmanship; skillful-handed in their work; the wealthiest of the wealthy; the most expert of the expert; the most powerful of the powerful. They who fashioned the all-active, all-formed cow; they fashioned the cow, and she became all-formed.'
ŚŚS 8.20.1b: 'They who awoke while delighting [in sleep]; they yoked the two bay horses; they went up to the gods for life. At the year's [end], the skillful ones came to their sacrificial share. May the <s>Ṛbhus</s>, the divine, hear here, may they be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s> here! May the divine gods protect this divine invocation with divine thought.'
ŚŚS 8.20.1c: 'May they protect this <s>brahman</s>, this <s>kṣatra</s>, this pressing sacrificer...'

ŚŚS 8.21.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> (All-Gods) be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s>. All the <s>Vaiśvānaras</s>; the greatly great; the cooked-food ones, the hospitable (?); the swift-going, preparing the drawing [of Soma]. They who have pervaded heaven and earth; the waters and the sun.'
ŚŚS 8.21.1b: 'The sacred power and the ruling power; the sacrificial grass and the altar; the sacrifice and the wide atmosphere. Wind-souled, fire-messengered. You who are three and eleven.'
ŚŚS 8.21.1c: 'And three and thirty; and three and three hundred; and three and three thousand. So many in rising up; so many in settling down; so many wives.'
ŚŚS 8.21.1d: 'So many consorts; so many...'

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.22.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May <s>Agni</s> <s>Vaiśvānara</s> be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s>. The fuel-stick of all the gods; the unquenchable divine light. He who shines for the peoples, for the human ones. Having shone in the former days; the ageless one at the face of the dawns.'
ŚŚS 8.22.1b: 'He who shines upon heaven and earth; upon the wide atmosphere. May he grant shelter with his light for the worthy sacrifice. May <s>Agni</s> <s>Vaiśvānara</s> hear here, may he be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s> here! May the god...' — the rest is the same.

ŚŚS_8.23.1a: maruto.devāḥ.somasya.matsan.|.suṣṭubhaḥ.svarkāḥ.|.arka.stubho.bṛhad.vayasaḥ.|.nabhasyā.varṣanirṇijaḥ.|.tveṣāsaḥ.pṛśni.mātaraḥ.|.śubhrā.hiraṇya.khādayaḥ /

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 8.23.1a: [The <s>nivid</s>:] 'May the <s>Maruts</s>, the divine, be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s>. The well-praising, of good chants; praising with chants, of great stature. The cloud-born, with rain as their adornment; the fierce ones, sons of <s>Pṛśni</s> (the dappled cow); the bright ones with golden ornaments.'
ŚŚS 8.23.1b: 'The mighty ones, of generous gifts; the heroic ones of unconquerable chariots. May the <s>Maruts</s>, the divine, hear here, may they be gladdened by the <s>Soma</s> here! May the divine gods...' — the rest is the same.
