body.translated_text:
11.7.1: "<s>Hotā ajaniṣṭa</s>" (The <s>Hotṛ</s> was born) is the <s>Ājya</s> of the fourth [day].
11.7.2: The <s>Maidhātitha</s> [verses form] the <s>prauga</s>.
11.7.3: The <s>Gārtsamada</s> [verses serve] for the <s>Vāyavya</s> and <s>Aindrāvāyava</s> [recitations]; but the <s>Maidhātitha</s> [verses are recited] first.
11.7.4: [The triplets are:] "<s>Mitram vayam</s>" (We [invoke] <s>Mitra</s>); "<s>Prātar yujā</s>" (Yoked at dawn); "<s>Tvā vahantu</s>" (May they carry you); "<s>Aibhir Agna</s>" (With these, O <s>Agni</s>).
11.7.5: The <s>Sārasvata</s> [elements] of the latter three-day period in the combined [version] are those of the latter <s>Abhiplava</s> [days].
11.7.6: The <s>Marutvatīya</s> is from the single-day [archetype].
11.7.7: "<s>Ugro jajña</s>" (The mighty one was born) is the <s>Niṣkevalya</s>.
11.7.8: From the second [day onward], the <s>Sāvitra</s> and <s>Dyāvāpṛthivīya</s>.
11.7.9: The <s>Ārbhava</s> from the third.
11.7.10: "<s>Agnir Indra</s>" (<s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s>) is the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>.
11.7.11: The <s>Vaiśvānarīya</s> [elements] of the earlier [sub-period] of the earlier three-day period — those [belong to] the later.
11.7.12: "<s>Pra ye śumbhante janasya gopāḥ</s>" (Forth they who shine, the guardians of the people) is the <s>Āgnimāruta</s>.

body.translated_text:
11.8.1: "<s>Agna ojiṣṭham</s>" (O <s>Agni</s>, most vigorous) is the <s>Ājya</s> of the fifth [day], everywhere omitting the last [verse].
11.8.2: The <s>Saṃhārya</s> [verses form] the <s>prauga</s>.
11.8.3: [The triplets are:] "<s>Agram piba</s>" (Drink the first); "<s>Tava Vāyo</s>" (Yours, O <s>Vāyu</s>); "<s>Sa tvam no deva</s>" (You, O god, for us); "<s>Śatena ā na</s>" (With a hundred, come to us); "<s>Ā no Mitrāvaruṇā</s>" (Come to us, <s>Mitra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s>); "<s>No gomantam</s>" (Rich in cattle for us); "<s>Ataś cid Indra</s>" (Even from there, <s>Indra</s>); "<s>Ṇo Viśve Devā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ</s>" (To us, the <s>Viśvedevas</s>, increasers of <s>ṛta</s>).
11.8.4: "<s>Kva sya vīraḥ</s>" (Where is this hero?) is the <s>Marutvatīya</s>.
11.8.5: "<s>Etāyām eti</s>" (He goes on this [path]) is the <s>Niṣkevalya</s>.
11.8.6: From the third [day], the <s>Sāvitra</s> and <s>Dyāvāpṛthivīya</s>.
11.8.7: "<s>Pra vaḥ</s>" (Forth for you); "<s>Sphalakram</s>"; "<s>Citrad</s>"; "<s>Iṭ śiśoḥ</s>" is the <s>Āgnimāruta</s>.

body.translated_text: 11.9.1: 'O friends, towards you, the concordant one' — [this is] the <s>ājya</s> [recitation] of the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> [day], everywhere excluding the last [verse]. 11.9.2: The <s>prauga</s> is compiled [from various hymns]. 11.9.3: 'O <s>Vāyu</s>, come, O visible one; with a chariot of broad brilliance; when today at sunrise; we greet you at sunrise' — or 'O beloved one; to us; with bay horses; O All-Gods, come' — the <s>Bhāradvāja</s> [hymns] — these are the triplets. 11.9.4: 'Great is <s>Indra</s> with heroes' — [this is] the <s>Marutvatīya</s>. 11.9.5: 'Who born' — [this is] the <s>Niṣkevalya</s>. 11.9.6: From the second [day's], the <s>Sāvitra</s> (to <s>Savitṛ</s>). 11.9.7: 'They awakened, those' — [this is] the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>. 11.9.8: 'The flowing streams; you, O <s>Agni</s>, by days' — [this is] the <s>Āgnimāruta</s>. 11.9.9: '<s>Indra</s>, strengthen' — [this is] the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> for the sixth day in the second <s>abhiplava</s> (six-day period). 11.9.10: '<s>Uṣas</s> and Night' — in the third [<s>abhiplava</s>]. 11.9.11: '<s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>' — in the fourth. 11.9.12: Or 'auspicious to us, <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>.' 11.9.13: Or the first [option applies] in the former section, the second in the latter. 11.9.14: 'From afar' — in the fifth.

ŚŚS_11.10.10: eka.sūkte.vā.|.pibā.somam.abhi.tam.u.ṣṭuhi.iti.|.pūrvasya.uttamām.utsṛjati /
ŚŚS_11.10.11: eka.ahāt.tṛtīya.savanam /
body.translated_text: 11.10.1: The <s>Abhijit</s> [day]: with all <s>stomas</s> (chant-types), both <s>sāmans</s>, with <s>Rathantara</s> or <s>Bṛhat</s> as the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> — an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>. 11.10.2: 'Forth for you to the god; whatever is best' — [this is] the <s>ājya</s>. 11.10.3: Both the <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> and <s>Gārtsamada</s> [hymns form] the <s>prauga</s>s. 11.10.4: The <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> triplets come first, the <s>Gārtsamada</s> ones after. 11.10.5: Or the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [uses] those of <s>Gārtsamada</s>. 11.10.6: Or the morning pressing follows the one-day (<s>ekāhika</s>) [pattern]. 11.10.7: 'O <s>Indra</s>, drink; pressed for you, for intoxication' — [beginning] after the one-day <s>Marutvatīya</s>. 11.10.8: 'Whatever your protection' — from the <s>Niṣkevalya</s>. 11.10.9: But the former [hymns apply] when <s>Bṛhat</s> is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. 11.10.10: Or in a single hymn: 'Drink the <s>Soma</s>; praise that one' — he drops the last [verse] of the former. 11.10.11: The third pressing [follows] from the one-day [pattern].

body.translated_text: 11.11.1: [The three-day periods have] the <s>Saptadaśa</s> (seventeenfold) <s>stoma</s>s and <s>Svara</s>-<s>sāmans</s>. 11.11.2: <s>Rathantara</s> is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> of the first [day], <s>Bṛhat</s> of the second, [and] the third has both <s>sāmans</s> with <s>Rathantara</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. 11.11.3: <s>Svara</s>-<s>pṛṣṭha</s>s [are prescribed] according to <s>Kauṣītaki</s>. 11.11.4: <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> [are used] in the <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants]. 11.11.5: [They are] <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>s according to <s>Paiṅgi</s>. 11.11.6: <s>Ukthya</s>s according to <s>Kauṣītaki</s>. 11.11.7: 'To sacrifices; the great; the vital power; O <s>Agni</s>, the mightiest' — these are the <s>ājya</s>s, everywhere excluding the last [verses]. 11.11.8: Those of the first three-day period are the <s>prauga</s>s. 11.11.9: 'Where [is] that hero' — the <s>Marutvatīya</s> of the first day's <s>Svara</s>-<s>sāman</s>; 'with what beauty' — of the second; 'the <s>Gāyata</s>-<s>sāman</s>' — of the third. 11.11.10: And having recited the <s>sāma</s>-<s>pragātha</s>s, [he recites] the <s>Kadvat</s> <s>pragātha</s>s. 11.11.11: 'What new thing' — in the first; 'what then indeed of his' — in the second; 'these indeed to you, O <s>Purūravas</s>' — in the third; and the source (<s>yoni</s>) of the <s>Bṛhat</s>. 11.11.12: 'Who is most beneficial to you' — excluding the last [verse]; 'hither the chariot' — and in the first they sing; 'footless indeed; up; O most brilliant one' — in the second; '<s>Indra</s>, all; and to you they came' — in the third. 11.11.23: Thus [the prescriptions] for [days with] <s>Bṛhat</s>-<s>Rathantara</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. 11.11.14: 'When you were born, unprecedented' — the <s>stotriya</s> (chant-verse) for [days with] <s>Svara</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. 11.11.15: 'O <s>Indra</s> of brilliant rain' — two [verses]; 'which of <s>Indra</s> [is] the enjoyment' — the third of the <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding verse). 11.11.16: Or 'he was intoxicated by your great [offering]' — of the second; making the first [verse] the third. 11.11.17: 'May he delight us for the seeking of wealth' — two [verses]; 'we indeed to you' — the third of the <s>anurūpa</s>. 11.11.18: Or 'offer it back to him' — of the third; making the fourth [verse] the third. 11.11.19: 'O <s>Indra</s>, drink this pressed [<s>Soma</s>]' — two [verses]; 'who knows it' — the third of the <s>anurūpa</s>.

body.translated_text: 11.12.1: From wherever the <s>stotriya</s> (chant-verse) would be in the <s>Bṛhatī</s> [meter], correspondingly the <s>anurūpa</s> should be made in the <s>Bṛhatī</s>. 11.12.2: Having recited the <s>dhāyyā</s> (placing verse) and the <s>Kadvat</s> [<s>pragātha</s>s] and the source (<s>yoni</s>) of the <s>Rathantara</s> on the first [day], of the <s>Bṛhat</s> on the second, of both on the third. 11.12.3: The former [is] the <s>Rathantara</s>'s [source] everywhere. 11.12.4: 'Whatever <s>Indra</s> holds' — two [verses] on the first; 'they sing for you' — on the second; 'the giver; the beast, like a wild elephant' — on the third. 11.12.5: 'O <s>Indra</s>, for you indeed; O <s>Maghavan</s>' — of the nine [verses], three each day, and the previous hymns. 11.12.6: Or having extracted the triplets, both [sets of] hymns. 11.12.7: And in the <s>Svara</s>-sources (<s>yonis</s>) when combined. 11.12.8: Before the <s>Ānuṣṭubha</s> triplet, or he recites with the <s>pragātha</s>. 11.12.9: The third pressings from the first three-day period — thus for [days with] <s>Bṛhat</s>-<s>Rathantara</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. 11.12.10: And the opening verses for [days with] <s>Svara</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>. 11.12.11: And of the <s>Svara</s>-sources. 11.12.12: From the accompanying [verse] onward, combined, from the middle three-day period. 11.12.13: But having extracted the last hymns of the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>s and the triplet 'forth for you; the swift-minded ones; him of old; what then; thus' — he arranges. 11.12.14: Or '<s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>' — on the first. 11.12.15: 'Those who adorn' — the <s>Māruta</s> (to the Maruts). 11.12.16: 'I invoke the gods' — on the second. 11.12.17: '<s>Uṣas</s> and Night' — on the third.

body.translated_text: 11.13.1: With the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> (twenty-onefold) <s>stoma</s>, <s>Bṛhat</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>, or <s>Mahādivākīrtya</s> — an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> — this is the <s>Viṣuvān</s> (solstice day). 11.13.2: It is concluded before the setting of <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun). 11.13.3: The <s>prātaranuvāka</s> (morning litany) [is recited] after sunrise. 11.13.4: Or according to the archetype. 11.13.5: 'I consider <s>Agni</s> [as] the father' — at sunrise, the opening of the <s>prātaranuvāka</s>. 11.13.6: He should recite a hundred-and-ten, a hundred-and-twenty, or a hundred [verses]. 11.13.7: The <s>Vāsiṣṭha</s> <s>āprī</s> hymn [is used]. 11.13.8: A solar animal (<s>saurya paśu</s>) should be offered for the <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day offering). 11.13.9: 'The wondrous one of the gods' — three <s>puronuvākyā</s>s (invitatory verses); the latter [is] the <s>yājyā</s> for the solar [offering]. 11.13.10: In a low voice (<s>upāṃśu</s>). 11.13.11: 'From the ocean, the wave' — [this is] the <s>ājya</s>. 11.13.12: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s>-metered [hymns form] the <s>prauga</s>. 11.13.13: From the middle <s>Chandoma</s> (meter-day), three triplets — the first and the last. 11.13.14: Three from the first. 11.13.15: But in the <s>Āśvina</s> [hymn], '<s>Bhānumatī</s>' (the radiant one) is the third. 11.13.16: 'May the prayer go forth from its seat' — [this is] the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>. 11.13.17: Or the morning pressing [follows] the one-day (<s>ekāhika</s>) [pattern]. 11.13.18: 'Forth for you to the god; you indeed, like <s>Kṣaitava</s>' — or that is the <s>ājya</s>. 11.13.19: And the <s>Mādhucchandasa</s> [hymns]. 11.13.20: 'With what beauty; that [Soma] well-pressed; first-born; O mighty one' — [this is] the <s>Marutvatīya</s>. 11.13.21: 'Shining like the sun' — the <s>stotriya</s> in the <s>Bṛhatī</s> in its own source (<s>svayoni</s>). 11.13.22: 'When, O <s>Indra</s>, heaven' — the <s>anurūpa</s>. 11.13.23: Or the <s>Mahādivākīrtya</s>. 11.13.24: 'The wondrous one of the gods' — the <s>stotriya</s> of the <s>Mahādivākīrtya</s>. 11.13.25: And the following [verses]. 11.13.26: 'Up, <s>Sūrya</s>, with great rays' — the third of the <s>anurūpa</s>. 11.13.27: Or 'great indeed; up that visible one' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragātha</s>s. 11.13.28: Or 'the shining, the great' — [is] the <s>stotriya</s>; 'O <s>Sūrya</s>, in the middle' — the <s>anurūpa</s>. 11.13.29: Or 'always with joyful minds for you.' 11.13.30: 'Great indeed' — the <s>sāma</s>-<s>pragātha</s>. 11.13.31: Or 'who [is] the all-conquering, the far-seeing.' 11.13.32: The source of the <s>Rathantara</s> [is placed] in the <s>Bṛhatī</s> in its own source. 11.13.33: Both [are placed] in their own source. 11.13.34: And in the <s>Mahādivākīrtya</s>.

body.translated_text:
11.14.1: If the <s>Sāmagās</s> (Sāma-chanters) make [errors] in these <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants].
11.14.2: When [the chants] are not being performed, [the hotṛ] should not recite.
11.14.3: 'indraḥ kila' (Indra, indeed) — these are the <s>uktha-mukhīya</s> (opening of recitation) [verses].
11.14.4: 'śam no bhava cakṣasā' (Be auspicious to us through sight) — at the great daylight <s>kīrtya</s> (proclamation).
11.14.5: The hymn 'dyaur na ya indra' (Like heaven, O Indra) — in its own position, in <s>Bṛhatī</s> [meter].
11.14.6: 'ya eka iddha havya' (He who alone is kindled for the oblation) — in a non-native position.
11.14.7: And at the great daylight <s>kīrtya</s>.
11.14.8: 'tam u ṣṭuhi' (Praise him indeed) — when the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> [chants] have been extracted.
11.14.9: 'abhi tyam meṣam' (Unto that ram).
11.14.10: [The verse belonging to] the season and the <s>Janitrīya</s> [hymn] — having recited nine [verses] of the <s>Sarvahari</s> or the <s>nivid</s> (inserted formula).

body.translated_text:
11.15.1: The <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering) [sacrifice is] a <s>Sarvastoma</s> (all-chant), <s>Sarvapṛṣṭha</s> (all-backed), or <s>Bṛhat-pṛṣṭha</s> (great-backed) <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.
11.15.2: 'agniṃ nara' (Agni, men) — the <s>Ājya</s> (ghee-hymn).
11.15.3: 'tvam hi kṣaitavat' (For thou, O dweller) — for the <s>Bṛhat-pṛṣṭha</s>.
11.15.4: The <s>Praugā</s> (introductory hymn) is of <s>Madhucchandas</s>.
11.15.5: The midday [pressing] is in <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-four-fold) [stoma].
11.15.6: Having recited the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> of the <s>Vairāja</s> [chant], and in the <s>Sarvapṛṣṭha</s> the <s>pragātha</s> and the matrix of the <s>Rathantara</s> and the <s>Bṛhat</s>.
11.15.7: From the attendant [chant] onwards, the sixth [forms] the third pressing.
11.15.8: 'kathā devānām' (How of the gods) — the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [hymn] of the daily <s>Bṛhat-pṛṣṭha</s>.
11.15.9: 'ā no bha[ra]' (Bring to us)...

body.translated_text:
12.1.1: [The procedures] for the <s>hotrakāṇām</s> (assistant invokers).
12.1.2: The ritual act at the morning pressing.
12.1.3: 'ā no mitrāvaruṇā' (Come to us, O Mitra and Varuṇa), 'mitraṃ vayam' (Mitra, we), 'mitraṃ huve' (I invoke Mitra), 'ayaṃ vām mitrāvaruṇā' (This for you two, O Mitra and Varuṇa), 'purūruṇā cit' (Even the widely-wandering), 'prati vāṃ sūra udite' (Toward you two at sunrise), 'pra vo mitrāya' (Forth to you for Mitra), 'yad adya sūra udite' (When today at sunrise), 'pra mitrayoḥ' (Forth of the two Mitras), 'tā naḥ śaktam' (May you two be able for us) — these are the <s>stotriya</s> [verses] of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> priest.
12.1.4: 'ā yāhi suṣuma' (Come, O fair-pressed one), 'indram id gāthinaḥ' (Indra indeed, the singers), 'indreṇa sam hi' (Together indeed with Indra), 'indro dadhīcaḥ' (Indra, of Dadhīca), 'ut tiṣṭhann ojasā sahaḥ' (Rising up with might and power), 'bhindhi viśvāḥ' (Break all), 'pra saṃrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām' (Forth, the sovereign of peoples), 'tam indraṃ vājayāmasi' (We urge that Indra), 'mahān indro ya ojasā' (Great Indra who with might), 'yuñjanti bradhnam' (They yoke the tawny one) — [these are the verses] of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>.
12.1.5: 'indra[m]...'

body.translated_text:
12.2.1: In [sacrifices of] two nights or more, in groupings of days, the <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding) [verses of one day] become the <s>stotriya</s> (hymn) [verses] of the next day, even when the <s>stotriya</s> [verses] are the same.
12.2.2: Or [those of] the following [day become the stotriya].
12.2.3: The permanent <s>tṛcas</s> (triplets) at the end of the recitations — they call them the <s>paryāsa</s> (concluding verses).
12.2.4: 'prati vāṃ sūra udite' (Toward you two at sunrise) — [the paryāsa] of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>.
12.2.5: 'kāvyebhir adābhya' (With poetic compositions, O undeceivable one) — at the <s>stotriya</s>.
12.2.6: Or when [there is] a <s>stotriya</s> for the next day.
12.2.7: 'ud ghed abhi' (Up indeed toward) — [the paryāsa] of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>.
12.2.8: 'indrāgnī avasā' (Indra and Agni, with aid) — [the paryāsa] of the <s>Acchāvāka</s>.
12.2.9: Between the <s>anurūpa</s> and the <s>paryāsa</s> is the place for the <s>āvāpa</s> (insertion).
12.2.10: With one [verse], two...

body.translated_text:
12.3.1: The modification [applies] at the midday [pressings].
12.3.2: The final <s>sūktas</s> (hymns) of the two later pressings — they call them <s>paryāsas</s> (concluding hymns).
12.3.3: The midday [recitations have] two <s>sūktas</s> [each].
12.3.4: The <s>ukthas</s> (recitations) [have] four <s>sūktas</s>.
12.3.5: 'Away, forward' — this is always the <s>uktha-mukhīyā</s> (opening of the <s>uktha</s>) for the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>.
12.3.6: 'Proclaim; great; when indeed, O <s>Indra</s>' — on the second [day].
12.3.7: 'Of the warlike one; how great' — on the third [day].
12.3.8: 'Forth for the great, greatly-increasing one; bring forth; we sacrifice to <s>Indra</s>' — [these are the] triplets.
12.3.9: 'At once indeed, O <s>Indra</s>; from far; from near' — on the fourth [day].
12.3.10: 'Forth for him, both; when, O <s>Indra</s>' — [these are the] triplets.
12.3.11: 'In the womb indeed; who [offers] good praise?' — on the fifth [day].
12.3.12: 'For <s>Indra</s> indeed the sky' — [this is the] triplet.
12.3.13: 'To us, O praised one; by strength; may the true one come' — on the sixth [day].
12.3.14: That is the <s>ahīna</s> (multi-day) <s>sūkta</s>.
12.3.15: In the middle three-day period, the triplets are called 'embellishments' (<s>śilpa</s>).
12.3.16: Whatever is other than the <s>stotriya</s> (chant-verse), <s>anurūpa</s> (response-verse), and triplets — that is to be identified in context.
12.3.17: The recitation from the first two days [applies] for all [priests] on the first <s>Chandoma</s> (meter-day).
12.3.18: That from the third and fifth [days applies] to the middle [<s>Chandoma</s>].
12.3.19: That from the fourth and sixth [days applies] to the last [<s>Chandoma</s>].
12.3.20: 'You are great, O <s>Indra</s>; to you indeed' — wherever the <s>Hotṛ</s> recites the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūkta</s>.
12.3.21: 'In you indeed; what the Fathers; not, O <s>Indra</s>' — twenty-one [verses], in the <s>Chandomas</s>, before the <s>paryāsa</s>.
12.3.22: 'Let none other proclaim; we shall not fear; we shall not be diminished' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s> on the tenth day.
12.3.23: 'In the shafts, for him' — and [this is] the <s>Dvipada</s> [verse].

body.translated_text:
12.4.1: 'Who then new?' — the <s>pragātha</s> following immediately after the <s>anurūpa</s> of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>, containing the word '<s>kad</s>' (who/what), in place of the single-day [hymn].
12.4.2: 'By the sacred utterance, to you' — and this is the <s>uktha-mukhīyā</s> (opening of the <s>uktha</s>).
12.4.3: 'Up, the sacred utterances' — this is always the <s>paryāsa</s> (concluding hymn).
12.4.4: 'We indeed praise you,' 'Who indeed knows?' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> on the third day.
12.4.5: And on the first two <s>Chandomas</s>.
12.4.6: But they are reversed on the middle [<s>Chandoma</s>].
12.4.7: 'When <s>Indra</s> [goes] east, west, north' — or these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s>.
12.4.8: 'O <s>Adhvaryus</s>, bring to <s>Indra</s>' — eleven [verses] on the third [day].
12.4.9: 'All the hosts' — this is the <s>stotriya</s>. 'That <s>Indra</s> I invoke;' 'He was intoxicated;' 'Of your drink;' 'Great;' 'To him, to him' — this is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.4.10: 'When, O wealthy one?' 'The hymn,' 'He who spoke with speech' — [these are the] triplets.
12.4.11: 'He who [is] the sole [object of] offering' — on the fourth [day].
12.4.12: '<s>Indra</s> for intoxication,' 'In every intoxication indeed' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.4.13: 'Come,' 'Let us make,' 'He who for us, O <s>Indra</s>, around' — [these are the] triplets.
12.4.14: 'He who [has] sharp horns' — on the fifth [day].
12.4.15: 'The maker of beautiful forms' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.4.16: 'With you, O <s>Maghavan</s> (bountiful one)' — [this is the] triplet.
12.4.17: 'To him indeed, forth, O powerful one' — on the sixth [day].
12.4.18: That is the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūkta</s>.
12.4.19: 'As if towards the sun,' 'Be capable, O Lord of power' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s> on the last <s>Chandoma</s>.
12.4.20: 'You are great, O <s>Indra</s>; he who' — in place of the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūkta</s>.
12.4.21: 'I praise <s>Indra</s>' — in the <s>Chandomas</s>, before the <s>paryāsa</s>.
12.4.22: 'Up, those most honey-rich,' 'Up indeed, it overflows' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s> on the tenth day.
12.4.23: 'In the three <s>Kadru</s> [days], the buffalo' — or [this is] the <s>stotriya</s>. And the last, 'That <s>Indra</s> I invoke,' 'All the hosts' — [this is] the <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.4.24: 'Desiring wealth' — and [this is] the <s>Dvipada</s> [verse].

body.translated_text:
12.5.1: 'What indeed of this?' — the <s>pragātha</s> following immediately after the <s>anurūpa</s> of the <s>Acchāvāka</s>, containing '<s>kad</s>,' in place of the single-day [hymn].
12.5.2: 'The wide one' — and this is the <s>uktha-mukhīyā</s>.
12.5.3: 'As if hewn' — this is always the <s>paryāsa</s>.
12.5.4: 'You indeed,' 'Him indeed, come' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s>.
12.5.5: 'The primeval ones,' 'The most numerous' — on the second [day].
12.5.6: 'The swift crosser indeed, with swift ones' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s>.
12.5.7: 'He who is mightiest' — on the third [day].
12.5.8: 'He who is king,' 'None him' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s>.
12.5.9: 'Together with, O <s>Indra</s>,' 'O <s>Indra</s>, drink this <s>Soma</s>' — [these are the] triplets.
12.5.10: 'Together they have come to you' — on the fourth [day].
12.5.11: 'Of the sweet one, thus,' 'Thus indeed, O <s>Soma</s>' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.5.12: 'Whatever indeed, O truthful one,' 'You of a hundred powers' — [these are the] triplets.
12.5.13: 'When may there be?' 'Chariot-possessions' — on the fifth [day].
12.5.14: 'Both, when O <s>Indra</s>' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.5.15: 'They know of this heroism of yours' — three [verses].
12.5.16: 'The ruling bearer' — on the sixth [day].
12.5.17: That is the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūkta</s>.
12.5.18: 'None him,' 'Not you, O great one' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> on the first <s>Chandoma</s>.
12.5.19: 'May he hear both' — on the middle [<s>Chandoma</s>].
12.5.20: 'From which, O <s>Indra</s>, we fear' — on the last [<s>Chandoma</s>].
12.5.21: All are <s>pragāthas</s>.
12.5.22: 'They desire you' — in the <s>Chandomas</s>, before the <s>paryāsa</s>.
12.5.23: 'With this, the prize' — and [this is] the <s>Dvipada</s> [verse] on the tenth day.
12.5.14: And the single-day [hymn comes] first.

ŚŚS_12.6.19: eka.aha.bhūtasya.aikāhikān.paryāsān.ūrdhvam.ahīna.sūktebhyaḥ /
body.translated_text:
12.6.1: Between the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (opening rite) and the <s>Udayanīya</s> (closing rite) [are placed] those containing '<s>kad</s>' (interrogative hymns), the <s>uktha-mukhīyā</s>s, the '<s>Abhitaṣṭīya</s>' [hymn], and the <s>Bṛhatīkāra</s> (making of <s>Bṛhatī</s>) of the <s>Bārhata</s>s.
12.6.2: Between the <s>uktha-mukhīyā</s> [and the main hymn], the two <s>sūktas</s> are the place for insertion (<s>āvāpa</s>).
12.6.3: [Hymns] from the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> (backbone) [six-day period] are [used as] <s>sūktas</s> in the <s>Abhiplava</s> (six-day period).
12.6.4: In place of the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūktas</s>, [one uses] <s>sūktas</s> from the second day.
12.6.5: The latter [applies to] the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>.
12.6.6: From the first three-day period, [one takes hymns] for the <s>Svara-Sāman</s>s (intonation-chants).
12.6.7: On the <s>Caturviṃśa</s>, <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Viṣuvat</s>, <s>Bṛhat-pṛṣṭha</s>, <s>Viśvajit</s>, and <s>Mahāvrata</s> [days], [one takes hymns] from the sixth [day].
12.6.8: On the <s>Viśvajit</s>, [one uses] all <s>pṛṣṭha</s>s.
12.6.9: The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>'s <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>, together with the <s>pragātha</s>, [are taken] from the <s>Mahānāmnī</s>s (Great Names).
12.6.10: The <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> [recites] the <s>kad</s>-containing <s>pragātha</s> of the <s>Vairūpa</s> [chant].
12.6.11: The <s>Acchāvāka</s> [recites hymns] of the <s>Revatī</s>s.
12.6.12: The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [recites] the <s>Vālakhilya</s> [hymns] undistributed — six <s>sūktas</s>, omitting the '<s>Indranihava</s>' [hymn], and the <s>pragātha</s> 'Come to us, all, together.'
12.6.13: The <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> [recites] the <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> [hymn], the <s>Kuntāpa</s> [hymns] except the <s>Anyūṅkha</s>.
12.6.14: The <s>Acchāvāka</s> [recites] 'Like the sky, O <s>Indra</s>' — the <s>Viṣṇunyaṅga</s> [hymn] in place of the <s>Evayāmarut</s>.
12.6.15: 'He became the one' — the <s>Sāma</s> <s>sūkta</s> of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>.
12.6.16: 'He who is born' — [that] of the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>.
12.6.17: 'Forth indeed of this' — [that] of the <s>Acchāvāka</s>.
12.6.18: Having recited the <s>Sāma</s> <s>sūktas</s>, having recited the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūktas</s>, he frames [them] with the single-day [hymns].
12.6.19: The single-day <s>paryāsas</s> [come] above the <s>ahīna</s> <s>sūktas</s> [when the rite] has become [a] single-day [form].

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.7.1: uktheṣu.kriyamāṇeṣu.vālakhilyā.vṛṣākapim.viṣṇu.nyaṅgam.ity.uddhṛtya.pariśeṣān.madhyaṃdineṣu.śaṃsanti /
ŚŚS_12.7.2: ṣaṣṭhād.ahna.ukthāni /
ŚŚS_12.7.3: atha.yadi.ṣaṣṭha.ahnikam.tṛtīya.savanam.asarva.pṛṣṭhe.ahani.pradiṣṭam.syād.dvitīyād.ahna.ukthāni /
ŚŚS_12.7.4: parokṣa.pṛṣṭhe.pratiśilpāni.kriyante /
ŚŚS_12.7.5: uddhṛtya.vālakhilyā.maitrā.varuṇaḥ.pibā.sutasya.rasina.ity.aindrān.pragāthān.śastvā /
ŚŚS_12.7.6: vṛṣākapim.uddhṛtya.brāhmaṇācchaṃsī.indro.madāya.iti.paṅktīr.aindrīḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_12.7.7: viṣṇu.nyaṅgam.eva.acchāvākaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.7.8: iti.parokṣa.pṛṣṭhe /
body.translated_text:
12.7.1: When the <s>ukthas</s> (recitations) are being performed, having extracted the <s>Vālakhilya</s> [hymns], the <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, and the <s>Viṣṇunyaṅga</s>, they recite the remainder at the midday [pressings].
12.7.2: The <s>ukthas</s> [are taken] from the sixth day.
12.7.3: Now, if the sixth day's third pressing is prescribed on a day that does not have all the <s>pṛṣṭha</s>s, the <s>ukthas</s> [are taken] from the second day.
12.7.4: On a day with the <s>Parokṣa-pṛṣṭha</s> (hidden backbone chant), the <s>pratiśilpas</s> (counter-embellishments) are performed.
12.7.5: Having extracted the <s>Vālakhilya</s>s, the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> recites the <s>Aindra</s> (Indra-related) <s>pragāthas</s> — 'Drink the pressed juice, O delighting one.'
12.7.6: Having extracted the <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> recites the <s>Paṅkti</s> [verses] belonging to <s>Indra</s> — '<s>Indra</s> for intoxication.'
12.7.7: The <s>Acchāvāka</s> [recites] the <s>Viṣṇunyaṅga</s> itself.
12.7.8: Thus on a <s>Parokṣa-pṛṣṭha</s> [day].

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.8.1: atha.viśvajit.śilpe /

ŚŚS_12.8.5: iti.viśvajit.śilpe.vikāraḥ /

ŚŚS_12.8.7: yuvor.yadi.iti.tṛcam /
ŚŚS_12.8.8: ye.yajñena.iti.ca.sūktam /
ŚŚS_12.8.9: svasti.no.mimītām.iti.tṛcam.nividdhānīyam /
ŚŚS_12.8.10: evayāmarutaś.ca.tṛcam /
ŚŚS_12.8.11: yathā.stomam.prātaḥ.savanam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.8.1: Now, the artistic variations of the <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering sacrifice).
ŚŚS 12.8.2: Having recited the <s>pragāthas</s> of the one-day [sacrifice], [he recites] the <s>Vālakhilya</s> [hymns], the <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> [hymn], the <s>Viṣṇu-nyaṅga</s> [hymn], and the <s>Nābhānediṣṭha</s> [hymn] — all the triplets, or [individual triplets].
ŚŚS 12.8.3: A four-verse [set] from the <s>Vālakhilya</s> [hymns].
ŚŚS 12.8.4: Of the <s>Sāman</s> hymns, the <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day) hymns, and the <s>paryāsa</s> (concluding) [hymns] — the assistant priests (<s>hotrakās</s>) recite three triplets each.
ŚŚS 12.8.5: Thus [are] the modifications in the artistic [variation] of the <s>Viśvajit</s>.
ŚŚS 12.8.6: And the triplets that are to receive the <s>nivid</s> (litany).
ŚŚS 12.8.7: 'Yuvor yadi' — a triplet.
ŚŚS 12.8.8: 'Ye yajñena' — and [this entire] hymn.
ŚŚS 12.8.9: 'Svasti no mimītām' — a triplet for the <s>nivid</s>.
ŚŚS 12.8.10: And the <s>Evayāmaruta</s> triplet.
ŚŚS 12.8.11: The morning pressing [follows] according to the <s>stoma</s> [type].

ŚŚS_12.9.8: yadi.gavāmayane.brāhmaṇācchaṃsine.prāg.viṣuvata.aindreṣu.pragātheṣv.abhīvartam.anvāyātayeyur.yasmin.stuvate.sa.stotriyaḥ.śvaḥ.stotriyo.anurūpaḥ /

ŚŚS_12.9.16: indra.kratum.iti.vā.stotriya.indra.jyeṣṭham.ity.anurūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.9.17: paurumīḷham.mānavam.janitrma.bhāradvājam.śyaitanaudhase.etāny.abhīvarta.sthāna.indra.kratāv.eva.ūrdhvam.viṣuvataḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.9.1: The ninefold (<s>trivṛt</s>) [chant of] the <s>Daśarātra</s> — the recitation arranged in triplets.
ŚŚS 12.9.2: Of the <s>ājya</s> [hymns] — the initial triplets.
ŚŚS 12.9.3: Of those containing the <s>nivid</s> — the final [triplets].
ŚŚS 12.9.4: One [verse] each from the remaining hymns and artistic [variations].
ŚŚS 12.9.5: But the sixth [day's arrangement] is the same as the <s>Viśvajit</s> artistic [variation], for the artistic portions.
ŚŚS 12.9.6: [Including] the <s>Nābhānediṣṭha</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 12.9.7: And the <s>Evayāmaruta</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 12.9.8: If, in the <s>Gavāmayana</s> (cow-procession sacrifice), for the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> [priest], before the solstice (<s>viṣuvat</s>), in the <s>Indra</s>-<s>pragāthas</s>, they should cause the <s>abhīvarta</s> [verse] to follow — the one with which he chants is the <s>stotriya</s>; the next day's <s>stotriya</s> [becomes] the <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.9.9: Or with a six-<s>pragātha</s> [arrangement].
ŚŚS 12.9.10: On the third day, [verses in] <s>Bṛhatī</s> [meter].
ŚŚS 12.9.11: 'Tam vo dasmam,' 'Tat tvā yāmi,' 'Abhi pra vaḥ,' 'Pra suśrutam,' 'Ā tvā sahasram,' 'Ā mandrair,' 'Indra yo rājā,' 'Nakiṣ ṭam,' 'Na tvā bṛhantaḥ,' 'Tvam Indra yaśāḥ,' 'Tvam Indra pratūrtiṣu,' 'Pibā sutasya rasinaḥ,' 'Adhvaryo drāvaya' — or [these alternatives].
ŚŚS 12.9.12: At the solstice (<s>viṣuvat</s>) — the <s>Āditya</s> observance.
ŚŚS 12.9.13: 'Citram devānām' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.9.14: Or the <s>Vikarṇa</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 12.9.15: 'Baṇ mahān,' 'Ud u tyat darśatam' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> <s>pragāthas</s> of the <s>Vikarṇa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.9.16: 'Indra kratum' — or [this is] the <s>stotriya</s>; 'Indra jyeṣṭham' — the <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.9.17: The <s>Paurumīḍha</s>, <s>Mānava</s>, <s>Janitrī</s>, <s>Bhāradvāja</s>, <s>Śyaitanaudhasa</s> — these are the <s>abhīvarta</s> substitutions; from 'Indra kratu' upward after the solstice.

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.10.1: The modifications in the <s>ukthas</s> (praises).
ŚŚS 12.10.2: After the <s>anurūpa</s>, the other <s>Indra</s> [hymns] in <s>Jagatī</s> [meter], or other fixed [hymns] — except for the sixth [day], where the fixed [hymns apply].
ŚŚS 12.10.3: 'Pra vo vājaḥ' [and] 'Pra vaḥ sakhāyaḥ' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.10.4: 'Pra sasrāje,' 'Bṛhad Indrā,' 'Ko vām Varuṇa' — for the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest] on the second day.
ŚŚS 12.10.5: 'Ā vām rājānau' — the <s>paryāsa</s> (concluding hymn) on the third and fifth [days], and on the middle <s>chandoma</s> [day].
ŚŚS 12.10.6: 'Purīṣe vām' — on the remaining [days].

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.11.1: Two-footed [verses] on the sixth [day] for all [priests].
ŚŚS 12.11.2: 'Agne tvam na' — the <s>stotriya</s>.
ŚŚS 12.11.3: He makes the fourth [verse] the third.
ŚŚS 12.11.4: 'Agne bhava suṣamiddhā' — the <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.11.5: And the <s>Vālakhilya</s> [hymns] are separated.
ŚŚS 12.11.6: He separates [them] by <s>pads</s> (feet/quarters) in the first hymn.
ŚŚS 12.11.7: By half-verses in the second.
ŚŚS 12.11.8: By whole verses in the third.
ŚŚS 12.11.9: In the last [hymn], he should reverse [the order].
ŚŚS 12.11.11: 'Othā modaiva made modā modaivo...' [exclamatory syllables for the chant].

ŚŚS_12.12.14: imā.nu.kam.iti.stotriyaḥ.|.uttare.ca.ayā.vājam.iti.tṛtīya.anurūpasya /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.12.1: 'Evā hy asi vīrayuḥ' [and] 'Evā hy asya sūnṛtā' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.12.2: 'Yas tastambha' — six [verses] for the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> [priest] on the second day.
ŚŚS 12.12.3: In the two later <s>chandoma</s> [days], in the middle of the hymns.
ŚŚS 12.12.4: 'Yo adribhit' — the triplet [placed] first everywhere, before the <s>paryāsa</s>.
ŚŚS 12.12.5: 'Asteva suprataram' — the <s>paryāsa</s> on the third and fifth [days] and on the middle <s>chandoma</s>.
ŚŚS 12.12.6: 'Acchā ma Indram' — on the remaining [days].

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.13.1: apa.prāca.iti.sukīrtim.śastvā.paṅkti.śaṃsam.vṛṣākapim.madhyamasya.pādasya.dvitīya.uttamayor.akṣarayor.nyūṅkhayati /
ŚŚS_12.13.2: vairājaḥ.pūrvasmin.mahad.vṛṣākapo3.aryaḥ.puṣṭeṣu.mat.sakhā.ity.uttarasmin /
ŚŚS_12.13.3: uparate.pratinyūṅkhayati /
ŚŚS_12.13.4: vairāja.nyūṅkham.uktvā.madetha.madaivo3.o3.othā.modaiva.iti.pratigṛhṇāti /
ŚŚS_12.13.5: tad.yatra.upadrutam.abhinihitam.praśliṣṭam.kṣipra.saṃdhir.iti.nyūṅkhanīyasya.pādasya.ādau.syād.upātītya.tad.dvitīye.akṣare.nyūṅkhayet.śvā.nvo3.iti.yathā.kva.syo3.iti.ca /
ŚŚS_12.13.6: atha.yatra.pañcāla.pada.vṛttiḥ.syād.vivṛttiḥ.pratyaye.nyūṅkhayen.no3.o3.iti /
ŚŚS_12.13.7: tam.śastvā.kuntāpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.13.1: Having recited 'Apa prāca' as the <s>sukīrti</s> (hymn of good fame), the <s>Paṅkti</s> recitation and <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> [hymn] — he prolongs (<s>nyūṅkhayati</s>) the second and last syllables of the middle <s>pāda</s> (foot).
ŚŚS 12.13.2: The <s>Vairāja</s> [chant is applied] in the first [part]: 'Mahad Vṛṣākapo aryaḥ puṣṭeṣu mat sakhā' — in the latter [part].
ŚŚS 12.13.3: When [the chant] stops, he prolongs in response.
ŚŚS 12.13.4: Having uttered the <s>Vairāja</s> prolongation, he responds with 'Madetha madaivo o othā modaiva.'
ŚŚS 12.13.5: Where there is overlap, close conjunction, or fusion [of syllables]...

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.14.1: idam.janā.upa.śruta.narāśaṃsa.staviṣyate.|.ṣaṣṭhim.shasrā.navatim.ca.kaurama.ā.ruśameṣu.dadmahe /
ŚŚS_12.14.2: uṣṭrā.yasya.pravāhiṇo.vadhūmanto.dvir.daśa.|.varṣmā.rathasya.ni.jihīḷate.diva.īṣamāṇā.upaspṛśaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.14.3: eṣa.iṣāya.māmahe.śatam.niṣkān.daśa.srajaḥ.|.trīṇi.śatāny.arvatām.sahasrā.daśa.gonām /
ŚŚS_12.14.4: pra.rebhāso.manīṣā.vṛthā.gāva.ita.īrate.|.amota.putrakā.eṣām.amota.gā.iva.āsate /
ŚŚS_12.14.5: pra.rebha.dhiyam.bharasva.govidam.vasuvidam.|.devatra.imām.vācam.śrīṇīhi.iṣur.na.avīras.tāram /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 12.14.1: 'Hear this, O people — <s>Narāśaṃsa</s> (praise of men) shall be praised. Sixty thousand and ninety — of <s>Kaurama</s>, we give among the <s>Ruśamas</s>.'
ŚŚS 12.14.2: 'His camels are the draft animals, adorned with brides, twelve in number. The height of the chariot touches heaven, approaching the sky.'
ŚŚS 12.14.3: 'This [gift] we desire for his sake — a hundred <s>niṣkas</s> (gold ornaments), ten garlands, three hundred horses, and ten thousand cows.'
ŚŚS 12.14.4: 'The praisers advance with thoughts — the cows freely go forth. Their sons are also [free], their [offspring are also free]...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.15.1: vacyasva.rebha.vacyasva.vṛkṣe.na.pakve.śakunaḥ.|.naṣṭe.jihvā.carcarīti.kṣuro.na.bhurijor.iva /
ŚŚS_12.15.2: indraḥ.kārum.abūbudhad.uttiṣṭha.vi.carā.jaran.|.mama.id.ugrasya.carkṛdhi.sarva.it.te.pṛṣād.ariḥ /
ŚŚS_12.15.3: iha.gāvaḥ.pra.jāyadhvam.iha.aśvā.iha.pūruṣāḥ.|.iho.sahasra.dakṣiṇo.api.pūṣā.ni.ṣīdati /
ŚŚS_12.15.4: mā.imā.indra.gāvo.riṣan.mo.āsām.gopatī.riṣat.|.mā.āsām.amitrayur.jana.indra.mā.stena.īśata /
ŚŚS_12.15.5: yad.indrād.ado.dāśarājñe.amānuṣam.vi.gāhathāḥ.|.virūpaḥ.sarvasmā.āsīt.sa.ha.yakṣmāya.patyate /
body.translated_text:
12.15.1: 'Sing, O <s>Rebha</s>, sing! Like a bird on a ripe tree, thy tongue darts about restlessly, like a razor on a thick [hide].'
12.15.2: '<s>Indra</s> awakened the bard: "Rise up, wander about, O aged one! Serve my fierce [purpose]; all thy enemy shall be crushed."'
12.15.3: 'Here may the cows be born, here the horses, here the men! Here, where the thousand-gifted one sits, <s>Pūṣan</s> too takes his seat.'
12.15.4: 'May these cows not be harmed, O <s>Indra</s>; may their cow-lord not be harmed. Let no hostile person [harm] them, O <s>Indra</s>; let no thief have power [over them].'
12.15.5: 'What, O <s>Indra</s>, in that non-human [battle] of the ten kings, thou didst plunge into — <s>Virūpa</s>, all...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.16.1-1: tvam.vṛṣa.akṣam.maghavvan.naṃram.maryā.akaror.api.|.tvam.rauhiṇam.vyāsyo.vi.vṛtrasya.abhinat.śiraḥ /
ŚŚS_12.16.1-2: praṣṭim.dhāvantam.haryor.auccaihśravasam.abruvan.|.svasty.aśva.jaitrāya.indram.ā.vaha.susrajam /
ŚŚS_12.16.1-3: araṅgaro.vāvadīti.tredhā.baddho.varatrayā.|.irām.u.ha.pra.śaṃsaty.anirām.apa.sedhati /
ŚŚS_12.16.1-4: tvam.indra.śarma.riṇā.havyam.pārāvatebhyaḥ.|.viprāya.stuvate.vasu.ni.dūra.śravase.vahaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.16.1-5: tvam.indra.kapotāya.chinna.pakṣāya.vañcate.|.śyāmākam.pakvam.pīlu.ca.vār.asmā.akṛṇor.bahu /
ŚŚS_12.16.2: catasro.ataḥ.pārikṣityas.tāsām.tṛtīye.pāde.prathama.caturthayor.akṣarayor.vaisvaryam /
body.translated_text:
12.16.1-1: 'Thou, O mighty bull, O bounteous one, didst make the dice-thrower bow down. Thou, <s>Vyāsya</s>, didst split open the head of <s>Vṛtra</s> through <s>Rauhiṇa</s>.'
12.16.1-2: 'They called the lead horse, <s>Uccaiḥśravas</s> (High-Ear), as he ran with the bay steeds: "Good fortune for horse-conquest! Bring <s>Indra</s> with his beautiful garland."'
12.16.1-3: '<s>Araṅgara</s> babbles on, bound threefold with a triple cord. He praises the refreshment and drives away the unrefreshing.'
12.16.1-4: 'Thou, O <s>Indra</s>, dost convey shelter and the oblation from those who dwell afar — wealth to the eloquent praiser, for <s>Dūraśravas</s> (Heard-from-afar).'
12.16.1-5: 'Thou, O <s>Indra</s>, for the pigeon with broken wings, wandering; the dark one...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.17.1-1: rājño.viśva.janīnasya.yo.devo.martyān.ati.|.vaiśvānarasya.suṣṭutim.ā.śṛṇotā.parikṣitaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.17.1-2: parikṣin.naḥ.kṣemam.akar.uttama.āsanam.ā.caran.|.kulāyam.kṛṇvan.kauravyaḥ.patir.vadati.jāyayā /
ŚŚS_12.17.1-3: katarat.ta.ā.harāṇi.dadhi.manthām.parisrutam.|.jāyā.patim.vi.pṛcchati.rāṣṭre.rājñaḥ.parikṣitaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.17.1-4: abhi.iva.svaḥ.pra.jihīte.yavaḥ.pakvaḥ.patho.bilam.|.janaḥ.sa.bhadram.edhati.rāṣṭre.rājñaḥ.parikṣitaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.17.2: othā.modaiva.iti.vaisvarye.pratigṛhṇāti /
ŚŚS_12.17.3: etaśa.pralāpo.ato.viṃśati.padas.tan.nivit.śaṃsam /
body.translated_text:
12.17.1-1: 'Of the king who rules all peoples, the god who [stands] above mortals — hear ye the well-praised [praise] of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>, O [subjects of] <s>Parikṣit</s>!'
12.17.1-2: '<s>Parikṣit</s> made security for us, taking the highest seat. Making a nest, the descendant of <s>Kuru</s> speaks with his wife as lord.'
12.17.1-3: '"Which shall I bring for thee — curd, mixed drink, or filtered [soma]?" — the wife asks the husband, in the kingdom of King <s>Parikṣit</s>.'
12.17.1-4: 'As though for heaven, the ripe barley swells forth [opening] the aperture of the path. The people prosper well in the kingdom of King <s>Parikṣit</s>.'
12.17.2: [Reciting] 'othā modaiva' (And may [there be] delight) — he receives [the gift] at the sovereign [gift-giving ceremony].

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.18.1: etā.aśvā.ā.plavante /

ŚŚS_12.18.15: na.vaniṣad.anātatam /
ŚŚS_12.18.16: ka.eṣām.dundubhim.hanat /
ŚŚS_12.18.17: lelim.hanat.katham.hanat /
ŚŚS_12.18.18: paryāgāram.punaḥ.punaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.18.19: śaphena.pīva.ohate /
ŚŚS_12.18.20: āyavanena.tedanī /
body.translated_text:
12.18.1: 'These mares come swimming.'
12.18.2: 'Upstream, as if offering a morning pressing.'
12.18.3: 'Among them, one is a yellowish spotted mare.'
12.18.4: '"O yellowish spotted one, what dost thou desire?"'
12.18.5: '"A good, golden son."'
12.18.6: '"Where didst thou abandon him?"'
12.18.7: '"Where those three <s>śiṃśapā</s> trees [stand]."'
12.18.8: '"Around [them], three serpents."'
12.18.9: '"[They] sit blowing horns."'
12.18.10: '"A gourd [is] buried."'
12.18.11: '"A pot [is] buried."'
12.18.12: '"What does the wind stir up?"'
12.18.13: '"It would make a nest."'
12.18.14: 'The fierce one...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.19.1: ādityā.ha.jaritar.aṅgirobhyo.aśvam.dakṣiṇām.anayan.|.tām.ha.janitar.na.pratyāyaṃs.tām.u.ha.jaritaḥ.pratyāyan.|.tām.ha.jaritar.na.pratyagṛbhṇaṃs.tām.u.ha.jaritaḥ.pratyagṛbhṇan /
ŚŚS_12.19.2: ahād.eta.sann.avicetanāni.yajñād.eta.sann.apurogavāsaḥ.|.ādityā.rudrā.vasavas.tv.eḷata.idam.rādhaḥ.prati.gṛbhṇīhy.aṅgiraḥ /
ŚŚS_12.19.3: idam.rādho.bṛhat.pṛthu.devā.dadatu.yad.varam.|.tad.vo.astu.sajoṣaṇam.yuṣme.astu.dive.dive.|.pra.tv.eva.gṛbhāyata /
ŚŚS_12.19.4: uta.śveta.āśupatvā.uta.padyābhir.yaviṣṭhaḥ.|.uto.āśu.mānam.bibharti /
ŚŚS_12.19.5: ity.ādityā.aṅgirasya /
ŚŚS_12.19.6: eva.āha.jaritar.othā.modaiva.|.tathā.āha.jaritar.othā.modaiva.ity.āsām.pratigṛṇāti /
ŚŚS_12.19.7: avasāne.pūrvam.praṇava.uttaram /
body.translated_text:
12.19.1: 'The <s>Ādityas</s>, O singer, brought a horse as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee) to the <s>Aṅgirases</s>. Those [singers], O begetter, did not accept it; but those singers did accept it. Those [singers], O singer, did not take it; but those singers took it.'
12.19.2: 'From the day they departed, without awareness; from the sacrifice they departed, without leaders. O <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, <s>Vasus</s>, be gracious! Accept this gift, O <s>Aṅgiras</s>!'
12.19.3: 'May the gods give this gift, broad and wide, which is excellent. May it be agreeable to you; may it be yours day after day. Do receive it!'
12.19.4: 'And the white swift-flying one, and with the feet...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.20.1: pañca.ato.diśām.klṛptayaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.20.1: yaḥ.sabheyo.vidarthyaḥ.sutvā.yajvā.atha.pūrṣaḥ.|.sūryam.ca.amū.riśādasas.tad.devāḥ.prāg.akalpayan /
ŚŚS_12.20.2: yad.bhadrasya.puruṣasya.putro.bhavati.dādhṛṣiḥ.|.tad.vipro.abravīd.u.tad.gandharvaḥ.kāmyam.vacaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.20.3: yo.jāmyā.aprathayat.tad.yat.sakhāyam.dudhūṣati.|.jyeṣṭho.yad.apracetās.tad.āhur.adharāg.iti /
ŚŚS_12.20.4: yaś.ca.paṇir.abhujiṣyo.yaś.ca.revān.adāśuriḥ.|.dhīrāṇām.śaśvatām.aha.tad.apāg.iti.śuśruma /
ŚŚS_12.20.5: ye.ca.devā.ajayanta.atho.ye.ca.parādaduḥ.|.sūryo.divam.iva.gatvāya.maghavāno.vi.rapśate /
body.translated_text:
12.20.1: Five [verses about the] established [ones] in the directions.
12.20.1: 'He who is fit for the assembly, who is suitable for the arena, who presses [Soma], who sacrifices, and who [is] first — the sun and these man-eaters — that the gods established in the east.'
12.20.2: 'When the son of a good man becomes bold — that the learned one declared, and the <s>Gandharva</s> [spoke] the desirable word.'
12.20.3: 'He who harms his own kin, who seeks to injure his friend — the eldest who is without discernment — they say he [belongs] below.'
12.20.4: 'And the miser who cannot be enjoyed, and the wealthy one who gives nothing — we have heard from generations of wise ones — he [belongs] in the west.'
12.20.5: 'And those who are devoted to the gods...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.21.1: ṣaḷ.ato.jana.kalpāḥ /
ŚŚS_12.21.2-1: yo.anākta.akṣo.anabhyakto.amaṇivo.ahiraṇyavaḥ.|.abrahmā.brahmaṇaḥ.putras.totā.kalpeṣu.sammitā /
ŚŚS_12.21.2-2: ya.ākta.akṣaḥ.svabhyaktaḥ.sumaṇiḥ.suhiraṇyavaḥ.|.subrahmā.brahmaṇaḥ.putras.totā.kalpeṣu.sammitā /
ŚŚS_12.21.2-3: aprapāṇā.ca.veśantā.arevān.apradadiś.ca.yaḥ.|.ayabhyā.kanyā.kalyāṇī.totā.kalpeṣu.sammitā /
ŚŚS_12.21.2-4: suprapāṇā.ca.veśantā.revān.supradadiś.ca.yaḥ.|.suyabhyā.kanyā.kalyāṇī.totā.kalpeṣu.sammitā /
ŚŚS_12.21.2-5: parivṛktā.ca.mahiṣy.anastyā.ca.ayudhiṃgamaḥ.|.anāśur.aśvā.ayāmī.totā.kalpeṣu.sammitā /
ŚŚS_12.21.2-6: vāvātā.ca.mahiṣī.svastyā.ca.yudhim.gamaḥ.|.svāśur.aśvā.yāmī.totā.kalpeṣu.sammitā /
ŚŚS_12.21.3: catasro.ataḥ.pravalhikās.trayaś.ca.pratīrādhās.tan.nivit.śaṃsam /
body.translated_text:
12.21.1: Six [verses about] the types of people.
12.21.2-1: 'He whose axle is ungreased, who is himself unanointed, who has no jewels, who has no gold, a non-knower of <s>Brahman</s> [yet] son of a brahmin — such a one is counted among the human types.'
12.21.2-2: 'He whose axle is greased, who is well-anointed, who has fine jewels, who has much gold, a knower of <s>Brahman</s> [and] son of a brahmin — such a one is counted among the human types.'
12.21.2-3: 'Without drinking places, [yet] a town-dweller; without wealth, and one who gives nothing; an unmarriageable yet beautiful maiden — such a one is counted among the human types.'
12.21.2-4: 'With fine drinking places, a town-dweller; wealthy, and a generous giver; a marriageable and beautiful maiden — such a one is counted among the human types.'
12.21.2-5: 'And a rejected wife...'

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.22.1: vitatau.kiraṇau.dvau.tāv.ā.pinaṣṭi.pūruṣaḥ.|.na.vai.kumāri.tat.tathā.yathā.kumāri.manyase /
ŚŚS_12.22.2: mātuṣ.ṭe.kiraṇau.dvau.nivṛttāḥ.puruṣād.dṛtiḥ.|.na.vai.kumāri.tat.tathā.yathā.kumāri.manyase /
ŚŚS_12.22.3: nigṛhya.karṇakau.dvau.nirā.yacchasi.madhyame.|.na.vai.kumāri.tat.tathā.yathā.kumāri.manyase /
ŚŚS_12.22.4: utānāyai.śayānāyai.tiṣṭhann.eva.ava.gūhase.|.na.vai.kumāri.tat.tathā.yathā.kumāri.manyase /
ŚŚS_12.22.5: ślakṣṇāyām.ślakṣṇikāyām.ślakṣṇam.eva.ava.gūhase.|.na.vai.kumāri.tat.tathā.yathā.kumāri.manyase /
ŚŚS_12.22.7: (.yan.nyūnam.yac.ca.adhikam.tat.sarvam.eva.ava.gūhasi.|.na.vai.kumāri.tat.tathā.yathā.kumāri.manyase.) /
body.translated_text:
12.22.1: 'Two [threads] are spread out on the loom; a man presses them together. O maiden, it is not truly as thou thinkest, O maiden!'
12.22.2: 'From thy mother, two [threads on the] loom; turned back from the man, a skin [bag]. O maiden, it is not truly as thou thinkest, O maiden!'
12.22.3: 'Holding the two ear-pins, thou dost draw [the thread] straight in the middle. O maiden, it is not truly as thou thinkest, O maiden!'
12.22.4: 'To one lying supine, thou dost conceal [the thread] while standing. O maiden, it is not truly as thou thinkest, O maiden!'
12.22.5: 'On the smooth, smooth [surface], thou dost conceal something smooth. O maiden, it is not truly [as thou thinkest, O maiden]!'

ŚŚS_12.23.4: vi.ime.devā.akransata.adhvaryo.kṣipram.pra.cara.|.susatyam.id.gavām.asyasi.pra.khudasi /
ŚŚS_12.23.5: patnī.yīyapsyamānā.jaritar.othā.modaiva.hotā.viṣṭvī.me.jaritar.othā.modaiva.ity.asyām.pratigṛṇāti /
ŚŚS_12.23.6: avasāne.pūrvam.praṇava.uttaram /
body.translated_text:
12.23.1: 'Here, thus, eastward, westward, northward, downward — the curved ones shout out! Here, thus, eastward, westward, northward, downward — the calves spatter about! Here, thus, eastward, westward, northward, downward — the pot-cooking melts away! Here, thus, eastward, westward, northward, downward — the klṛlīpu desires!'
12.23.2: 'Bhuḥ!' — [said when] approached. 'Śal!' — [said when] departed. 'Phal!' — [said when] stood upon.
12.23.3: 'Gourds, O singer! Spotted ones, O singer! An ant-hill, O singer! A fig-and-palāśa [leaf], O singer! A dog, O singer! One sitting on leaves, O singer! A cow's hoof, O singer!' — having said each one singly, the permanent response [follows]...

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.24.1: ata.ūrdhvam.daśa.āhanasyāḥ /

ŚŚS_12.24.1-2: yad.asyā.aṃhu.bhedyāḥ.kṛdhu.sthūlam.upātasat.|.muṣkāv.id.asyā.ejato.go.śaphe.śakulāv.iva /
ŚŚS_12.24.1-3: yadā.sthūlena.pasasāṇau.muṣkā.upāvadhīt.|.viṣvañcāv.asyā.vardhataḥ.sikatāv.iva.gardabhau /
ŚŚS_12.24.1-4: mahānagnī.mahānagnam.dhāvantam.anu.dhāvati.|.imās.tu.tasya.gā.rakṣa.yabha.mām.addhy.odanam /
ŚŚS_12.24.1-5: mahānagnī.kṛkavākum.śamyayā.pari.dhāvati.|.vayam.na.vidma.yo.mṛgaḥ.śīrṣṇā.harati.dhāṇikām /
ŚŚS_12.24.1-6: mahānagny.upa.brūte.svasty.āveśitam.pasaḥ.|.ittham.phalasya.vṛkṣasya.śūrpam.śūrpam.bhajemahi /
ŚŚS_12.24.1-7: mahānagny.ulūkhalam.atikrāmanty.abravīt.|.yathā.tava.vanaspate.ni.ghnanti.tathā.mama /
ŚŚS_12.24.1-8: mahān.vai.bhadro.bilvo.mahān.bhadra.udumbaraḥ.|.mahān.abhijñu.bādhate.mahataḥ.sādhu.khodanam /
ŚŚS_12.24.2: kapṛn.naro.yaddha.prācīr.iti.dve /
ŚŚS_12.24.3: tāsām.tṛtīye.pāde.nyūṅkho.yathā.vṛṣākapau /
ŚŚS_12.24.4: kapṛn.nara.iti.dvitīya.daśamayor.akṣarayoḥ /
ŚŚS_12.24.5: nyūṅkhena.itarāsām.avasāya.saṃtānāya.uttamam.padam /
ŚŚS_12.24.6: vi.i.i.ī3.kim.ayam.idam.āho3.o3.othā.modaiva.iti.prtigṛṇāti /
body.translated_text:
12.24.1: Hereafter [follow] the ten [verses] of the <s>Āhanasya</s> [section].
12.24.1-1: "When the gods came to the gambling-place, [they saw] <s>Viṣṭīmina</s>. The woman displays herself by her thigh, like the eyes of truth."
12.24.1-2: "When the short-thick [member] approached her narrow opening, the testicles of this one quivered like two fish in a cow's hoofprint."
12.24.1-3: "When with the thick member he struck the two testicles at the vulva, both of hers swell in opposite directions, like two sandy ones, like donkeys."
12.24.1-4: "The great naked woman runs after the great naked man running. 'Guard these cows of his; copulate with me, eat the rice.'"
12.24.1-5: "The great naked woman runs around the rooster with a stick. 'We do not know what animal carries a grain-basket on its head.'"
12.24.1-6: "The great naked woman says: 'The member has been well inserted. Thus may we enjoy winnowing-basket after winnowing-basket of the fruit-bearing tree.'"
12.24.1-7: "The great naked woman, stepping over the mortar, said: 'As they pound you, O lord of the forest, so may they pound me.'"
12.24.1-8: "Great indeed is the blessed <s>bilva</s> tree, great the blessed <s>udumbara</s> fig. Great is what presses against the knee; good is the churning of the great one."
12.24.2: [Then the two verses] "<s>Kapṛn naraḥ</s>" (The male member) and "<s>Yaddha prācīḥ</s>" (When eastward).
12.24.3: In the third <s>pāda</s> (quarter) of those, the <s>nyūṅkha</s> (prolonged call) [is used], as in [the hymn of] <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>.
12.24.4: "<s>Kapṛn naraḥ</s>" at the second and tenth syllables.
12.24.5: Having concluded the other [verses] with the <s>nyūṅkha</s>, the last <s>pāda</s> [serves] for continuity.
12.24.6: [The response is:] "<s>Vi-i-i-ī3</s>, what is this he says? — <s>Āho3-o3-othā modaiva</s> (Indeed, let there be joy)" — thus the <s>pratīgara</s> (response).

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.25.1: dadhikrāvṇo.akāriṣam.ity.ekā /
ŚŚS_12.25.2: sutāso.madhumattamāḥ.pra.maṃhiṣṭhāya.yo.adribhid.ava.drapsa.iti.tṛcāni.ṣaṣṭhe /
ŚŚS_12.25.3: tvam.na.indrā.bhara.tad.indra.ava.ā.bhara.iti.stotriya.anurūpau /
ŚŚS_12.25.4: sarvam.pra.maṇhiṣṭhīyam.prathame.chandome /
ŚŚS_12.25.5: yo.adribhid.iti.ca.ekā /
ŚŚS_12.25.6: ā.indra.no.gadhyed.u.madhvo.madintaram.iti.madhye /
ŚŚS_12.25.7: eto.nv.indram.stavāma.sakhāya.ity.uttame /
body.translated_text:
12.25.1: "<s>Dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam</s>" (I have praised <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>) — one [verse].
12.25.2: [The triplets for] the sixth [<s>Chandoma</s> day are:] "<s>Sutāso madhumattamāḥ</s>" (Most honeyed pressed [<s>Somas</s>]); "<s>Pra maṃhiṣṭhāya</s>" (For the most bountiful); "<s>Yo adribhit</s>" (He who splits rocks); "<s>Ava drapsaḥ</s>" (Down the drop).
12.25.3: "<s>Tvam na Indrā bhara</s>" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring for us) and "<s>Tad Indra ava ā bhara</s>" (Bring that down, O <s>Indra</s>) are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
12.25.4: The entire "<s>Pra maṃhiṣṭhīya</s>" [hymn is used] in the first <s>Chandoma</s> [day].
12.25.5: And "<s>Yo adribhit</s>" (He who splits rocks) — one [verse].
12.25.6: "<s>Ā Indra no gadhyat</s>" (May <s>Indra</s> take hold for us) and "<s>U madhvo madintaram</s>" (The most intoxicating of sweetness) are in the middle.
12.25.7: "<s>Eto nv Indram stavāma sakhāyaḥ</s>" (Come, O friends, let us praise <s>Indra</s>) is in the last.

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.26.1: indram.viśvā.indram.īśānam.ojasā.iti.stotriya.anurūpāv.anurūpasya.ye.pūrve.te.uttare /
ŚŚS_12.26.2: nū.marta.ity.acchāvākasya.aindrād.anantaram.dvitīya.caturthayoḥ.prathama.uttamayoś.ca.chandomayoḥ /
ŚŚS_12.26.3: viṣṇor.nu.kam.iti.itareṣu /
ŚŚS_12.26.4: urum.yajñāya.iti.tṛcam.pūrvam.sarvatra.paryāsāt /
ŚŚS_12.26.5: sam.vām.karmaṇā.iti.sadā.paryāsaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.26.6: śrudhī.havam.hiraścyā.āśrut.karṇa.iti.stotriya.anurūpau.tṛtīye /
ŚŚS_12.26.7: imam.indra.sutam.piba.pibā.somam.madāya.kam.iti.caturthe /
ŚŚS_12.26.8: asāvi.soma.indra.ta.imam.indra.sutam.piba.iti.pañcame /
ŚŚS_12.26.9: pra.va.indrāya.vṛtrahantamāya.viśvato.dāvann.iti.ṣaṣṭhe /
ŚŚS_12.26.10: evayāmarutam.śastvā.yathā.vṛṣākapim /
ŚŚS_12.26.11: iha.mado3.iti.vairāja.nyūṅkham.uktvā.made.mador.madasya.madirasya.madaivo3.o3.othā.modaiva.iti.pratigṛṇāti /
ŚŚS_12.26.12: ṛtur.janitrī /
ŚŚS_12.26.13: tam.asya.dyāvā.pṛthivī /
ŚŚS_12.26.14: viṣṇor.nu.kam /
ŚŚS_12.26.15: pra.vaḥ.pāntam.andhasaḥ /
ŚŚS_12.26.16: chandomeṣu.ca /
ŚŚS_12.26.17: tisras.tu.prathame /
ŚŚS_12.26.18: bhavā.mitra.iti.tṛcāc.ca.pūrvam.uttarayoś.chandomayoḥ /
ŚŚS_12.26.19: nū.martaḥ.paro.mātrayā.ity.uttamām.uddhṛtya.ṣaṣṭhe /
ŚŚS_12.26.20: yad.indra.citra.yad.indra.te.catasra.iti.stotriya.anurūpau.prathame.chandome /
ŚŚS_12.26.21: purām.bhindur.iti.madhyame.|.pūrvas.tṛco.anurūpas.tṛtīyā.tu.prathamā /
ŚŚS_12.26.22: gāyanti.tvā.ity.uttame /
body.translated_text:
12.26.1: "<s>Indram viśvā</s>" (All [hymns praise] <s>Indra</s>) and "<s>Indram īśānam ojasā</s>" (<s>Indra</s>, lord by might) are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>; those that were before are now after [in the <s>anurūpa</s>].
12.26.2: "<s>Nū martaḥ</s>" (Now the mortal) is for the <s>Acchāvāka</s>, immediately after the <s>Aindra</s> [recitation], in the second and fourth, and first and last <s>Chandoma</s> [days].
12.26.3: "<s>Viṣṇor nu kam</s>" (Of <s>Viṣṇu</s> indeed) in the others.
12.26.4: The triplet "<s>Urum yajñāya</s>" (Broad for the sacrifice) [comes] first everywhere before the <s>paryāsa</s> (concluding section).
12.26.5: "<s>Sam vām karmaṇā</s>" (Together with your deed) is always the <s>paryāsa</s>.
12.26.6: "<s>Śrudhī havam</s>" (Hear the call) and "<s>Hiraścyā āśruṭkarṇa</s>" (With eager ear of gold) are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> in the third.
12.26.7: "<s>Imam Indra sutam piba</s>" (Drink this pressed [<s>Soma</s>], O <s>Indra</s>) and "<s>Pibā somam madāya kam</s>" (Drink <s>Soma</s> for intoxication) in the fourth.
12.26.8: "<s>Asāvi Soma Indra te</s>" (<s>Soma</s> has been pressed for you, <s>Indra</s>) and "<s>Imam Indra sutam piba</s>" in the fifth.
12.26.9: "<s>Pra va Indrāya vṛtrahantamāya</s>" (Forth for <s>Indra</s>, the greatest <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer) and "<s>Viśvato dāvan</s>" (Giving everywhere) in the sixth.
12.26.10: Having recited the <s>Evayāmaruta</s> [hymn], as in [the hymn of] <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>.
12.26.11: Having said the <s>Vairāja nyūṅkha</s> "<s>Iha mado3</s>" (Here is the intoxication), [the response is:] "<s>Made mador madasya madirasya madaivo3-o3-othā modaiva</s>" (In intoxication, of intoxication, of the intoxicating, of the exhilarating — indeed let there be joy).
12.26.12: "<s>Ṛtur janitrī</s>" (The season is the begetter).
12.26.13: "<s>Tam asya dyāvāpṛthivī</s>" (For him, heaven and earth).
12.26.14: "<s>Viṣṇor nu kam</s>" (Of <s>Viṣṇu</s> indeed).
12.26.15: "<s>Pra vaḥ pāntam andhasaḥ</s>" (Forth for you, drink of the plant).
12.26.16: And in the <s>Chandomas</s>.
12.26.17: But three [verses] in the first.
12.26.18: The triplet "<s>Bhavā mitra</s>" (Be a friend) comes before in the later <s>Chandoma</s> [days].
12.26.19: Having extracted the last [verse] "<s>Nū martaḥ paro mātrayā</s>" (Now the mortal, beyond the measure) in the sixth.
12.26.20: "<s>Yad Indra citra</s>" (When, O <s>Indra</s>, the brilliant) and "<s>Yad Indra te catasraḥ</s>" (When, O <s>Indra</s>, your four) are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> in the first <s>Chandoma</s>.
12.26.21: "<s>Purām bhinduḥ</s>" (Breaker of fortresses) in the middle; the earlier triplet is the <s>anurūpa</s>, [but] the third [verse] is [placed] first.
12.26.22: "<s>Gāyanti tvā</s>" (They sing to you) in the last.

body.text:
ŚŚS_12.27.1: caturviṃśe.śastram.prathamāt.chandomāt.sarveṣām /
ŚŚS_12.27.2: yac.caturṇām.dvitīya.prabhṛtīnām.tac.caturṇām.ābhiplavikānām /
ŚŚS_12.27.3: tṛtīya.prabhṛtibhyaḥ.svara.sāmasu /
ŚŚS_12.27.4: atha.yady.abhijitam.viṣuvantam.bṛhat.pṛṣṭham.viśvajitam.mahā.vratīyam.ahar.ity.ukthyāni.kuryuś.cāturviṃśikāny.ukthāni /
ŚŚS_12.27.5: atha.yadi.pṛṣṭhya.abhiplavayoḥ.prathame.ahanī.daśamam.ahar.ity.ukthyāni.kuryur.aikāhikāny.ukthāni /
ŚŚS_12.27.6: uttamam.ābhiplavikam.ukthyam.kuryur.yad.dvitīyasya.ahnas.tṛtīya.savanam.tṛtīya.savanam /
body.translated_text:
12.27.1: The <s>Caturviṃśa</s> [day] recitation is from the first <s>Chandoma</s> [day], for all [priests].
12.27.2: What belongs to the second onward of the four [days] belongs to the four <s>Abhiplava</s> [days].
12.27.3: From the third onward, in the <s>Svarasāman</s> [chants].
12.27.4: Now, if they should make the <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Viṣuvat</s>, <s>Bṛhatpṛṣṭha</s>, <s>Viśvajit</s>, and <s>Mahāvratīya</s> days as <s>Ukthya</s> days, then the <s>ukthas</s> follow the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> [pattern].
12.27.5: Now, if they should make the first days of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> and <s>Abhiplava</s> [cycles] and the tenth day as <s>Ukthya</s> days, then the <s>ukthas</s> follow the single-day [pattern].
12.27.6: They should make the last <s>Abhiplava</s> [day] as <s>Ukthya</s>, [using] the third pressing of the second day as [the model for] the third pressing.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.1.1: pūrva.kāriṇaś.chandogā.adhvaryavaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.1.2: te.ced.anupadiṣṭam.kuryuḥ /
ŚŚS_13.1.4: stotriye.chandogam.ahar.yoge.stoma.vikāre.pṛṣṭhe.saṃsthāyām.ca /
ŚŚS_13.1.5: te.cet.pādam.vā.ardharcam.vā.viparyasyeyur.ūnam.vā.atiriktam.vā.kuryur.na.tad.ādriyeta /
ŚŚS_13.1.6: ṛcām.eva.viparyāsam.anuvidadhīta /
ŚŚS_13.1.7: nyūṅkhanīyaś.cet.pādo.vikarṣeṇa.pūryeta.tasya.saṃkhyāya.dvitīyam.nyūṅkhanīyam /
ŚŚS_13.1.8: ūrdhvam.tu.svarāt.samāna.chandomānāni.vyañjanāni.lupyeran /
body.translated_text:
13.1.1: The <s>Chandogas</s> (Sāmaveda chanters) and <s>Adhvaryus</s> (Yajurveda priests) act first.
13.1.2: If they should do something not prescribed [by the <s>Hotṛ</s>],
13.1.4: [The <s>Hotṛ</s> should follow them] in the <s>stotriya</s> [verse], the <s>Chandoma</s> day, the day-combination, <s>stoma</s> modification, <s>pṛṣṭha</s> [back-chant], and conclusion.
13.1.5: If they should transpose a <s>pāda</s> (quarter-verse) or a half-verse, or make [the chant] deficient or excessive, he should not be concerned about that.
13.1.6: He should follow only the transposition of the <s>ṛcs</s> (verses).
13.1.7: If the <s>pāda</s> requiring the <s>nyūṅkha</s> (prolonged call) is filled by a substitute, the second [verse requiring] the <s>nyūṅkha</s> should be counted accordingly.
13.1.8: But above the <s>svara</s> (accent), the consonants of the same metre may be elided.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.2.1: ānīte.paśau.mṛte.anupākṛte.anyam.ālabheta.ṛtvigbhyas.tam.kārayet /
ŚŚS_13.2.2: upākṛte.vepamāne.|.yasmād.bhīṣā.avepiṣṭhās.tato.no.abhayam.kuru.|.paśūn.naḥ.sarvān.gopāya.namo.rudrāya.mīḷhuṣe.|.svāhā.iti.juhoti /
ŚŚS_13.2.3: yasmād.bhīṣā.avāśiṣṭhā.iti.vāśyamāne /
ŚŚS_13.2.4: yasmād.bhiṣā.apalāyiṣṭhā.iti.palāyamāne /
ŚŚS_13.2.5: yasmād.bhīṣā.nyasada.ity.upaviṣṭe /
ŚŚS_13.2.6: yasmād.bhīṣā.saṃjñaptā.iti.mṛte /
ŚŚS_13.2.7: naṣṭe.mṛte.palāyite.vā.anyam.tad.rūpam.tad.devatyam.paśum.ālabheta /
ŚŚS_13.2.8: mṛtasya.vapām.puroḷāśam.avadānāni.iti.itarasya.vaṣaṭ.kāreṣu.upajuhuyāt /
body.translated_text:
13.2.1: When the animal has been brought but dies before being prepared, one should sacrifice another; one should have the <s>ṛtvijs</s> (priests) perform [the rites] with that.
13.2.2: When the prepared [animal] trembles: "From whatever fear you trembled, make us free from that fear. Protect all our cattle. Homage to <s>Rudra</s> the bountiful, <s>svāhā</s>" — he offers.
13.2.3: "From whatever fear you bellowed" — when [the animal] bellows.
13.2.4: "From whatever fear you fled" — when [it] flees.
13.2.5: "From whatever fear you sat down" — when [it] sits down.
13.2.6: "From whatever fear you were struck senseless" — when [it] dies.
13.2.7: When [the animal is] lost, dead, or has fled, one should sacrifice another animal of the same appearance and [dedicated to] the same deity.
13.2.8: The omentum of the dead one, the <s>puroḍāśa</s>, and the cut portions — one should offer these supplementarily at the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> exclamations of the other [animal].

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.3.1: pravṛtteṣu.mṛte.prayājeṣu.tena.eva.saṃsthāpyam /
ŚŚS_13.3.2: avadāne.naṣṭe.duṣṭe.vimathite.vājyam.pratinidadhyāt /
ŚŚS_13.3.3: hṛdaya.nāśe.anyam.ālabheta /
ŚŚS_13.3.4: yadi.ca.kāmayeta.ārti.vimathitāra.ṛccheyur.iti.kuvid.aṅga.yavam.anta.yavamanta.ity.āgnīdhrīye.juhuyāt /
ŚŚS_13.3.5: aṣṭā.padyām.vaśāyām.anūbandhyāyām.garbhasya.tvaco.vapā.rūpam.phalī.karaṇānām.phālī.karaṇān.garbham.iti.śāmitre.śrapayitvā.itarasya.vaṣaṭ.kāreṣu.śāmitra.eva.juhuyāt /
body.translated_text:
13.3.1: When [the animal] dies after the <s>prayājas</s> (fore-offerings) have commenced, one should bring [the rite] to completion with that same [animal].
13.3.2: When the cut portion is lost, spoiled, or scattered, one should substitute ghee.
13.3.3: When the heart is lost, one should sacrifice another [animal].
13.3.4: If one desires that difficulties and scattering should not befall [the rite], one should offer in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire [with the verses] "<s>Kuvid aṅga yavam anta yavamanta</s>" (Whether indeed at the end of barley, at the end of barley).
13.3.5: In a cow with eight feet (pregnant), as the supplementary cow, the skin of the fetus serves as the omentum; having cooked the fetal portions in the <s>Śāmitra</s> (slaughter-fire), one should offer [them] at the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> exclamations of the other [animal] in the <s>Śāmitra</s> fire itself.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.4.1: yūpe.virūḷhe.anapavṛtte.tvāṣṭram.bahu.rūpam.ālabheta /
ŚŚS_13.4.2: piśaṅga.rūpaḥ.subharo.vayodhās.tan.nas.turīpam.adha.poṣayitnu.devas.tvaṣṭā.savitā.viśva.rūpa.iti.puronuvākhyāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.4.3: pra.sū.mahe.suśaraṇāya.prathama.bhājam.deva.tvaṣṭar.yadd.ha.cārutvam.ānaḷ.iti.yājyāḥ /
body.translated_text:
13.4.1: When the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>) has sprouted and not been turned back, one should sacrifice a multi-colored [animal] for <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>.
13.4.2: [The <s>puronuvākyā</s> invitatory verses are:] "Of tawny color, well-bearing, life-sustaining — may that swift conveyance nourish us. The divine <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s> of all forms."
13.4.3: [The <s>yājyā</s> offering verses are:] "We sing forth to the well-sheltering one, the first-share-holder. O divine <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, when you have obtained the beauty."

body.text:

ŚŚS_13.5.22: sravantyo.vā.viharanti.vāyur.ākāśaś.ca /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.5.1: When two pressing days of competing [sacrificers] who are hostile to each other fall on the same day within the domain of knowledge, they call this a <s>saṃsava</s> (simultaneous pressing).
ŚŚS 13.5.2: The earlier [sacrificers] should complete [their rites] after having begun the <s>prātaranuvāka</s> (morning litany) first.
ŚŚS 13.5.3: They should offer into the well-kindled [fire].
ŚŚS 13.5.4: 'For the resting, for the settling, for the <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter, for the sustaining one — <s>svāhā</s>' — at the morning pressing.
ŚŚS 13.5.5: 'For the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter' — at the midday [pressing].
ŚŚS 13.5.6: 'For the <s>Jagatī</s> meter' — at the third pressing.
ŚŚS 13.5.7: Desiring [the defeat of] the rival <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the <s>Adhvaryu</s> should offer at the morning pressing with three <s>Prājāpatya</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.5.8: [Desiring the defeat of] the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s> [offers] at the midday [pressing].
ŚŚS 13.5.9: [Desiring the defeat of] the <s>Udgātṛ</s>, the <s>Udgātṛ</s> [offers] at the third pressing.
ŚŚS 13.5.10: [Desiring the defeat of] the <s>Brahman</s> [priest], the <s>Brahman</s> [offers] at each pressing.
ŚŚS 13.5.11: [Desiring the defeat of] the sacrificer, the sacrificer [offers] at each pressing.
ŚŚS 13.5.12: Desiring [the defeat of] all rivals, all [priests] offer at each pressing.
ŚŚS 13.5.13: They should employ the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> [sāmans].
ŚŚS 13.5.14: Also the <s>Ābhīka</s>, <s>Ābhīśava</s>, <s>Abhinidhana</s>, and <s>Abhīvarta</s> [chants].
ŚŚS 13.5.15: The <s>Kayāśubhīya</s> [hymn is used] for the <s>Marutvatīya</s> [recitation].
ŚŚS 13.5.16: The <s>Sajanīya</s> [for the] <s>Niṣkevalya</s> [recitation].
ŚŚS 13.5.17: The <s>Vihavya</s> [for the] <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [recitation].
ŚŚS 13.5.18: When the earlier [sacrificers] complete, he should perform a later concluding rite.
ŚŚS 13.5.19: When they perform an <s>Atirātra</s>, [he should perform] a two-night [rite].
ŚŚS 13.5.20: When they perform a two-night [rite], [he should perform] a three-night [rite].
ŚŚS 13.5.21: Or at that concluding rite, he should give more abundant <s>dakṣiṇā</s>s (ritual fees).
ŚŚS 13.5.22: [Like] flowing [rivers] that diverge — [such are] wind and space.

ŚŚS_13.6.7: abhidagdhe.pañca.gā.dakṣiṇā.dadyāt /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.6.1: When the purchased <s>Soma</s> is taken away, without letting the time pass, having procured another, one should press it.
ŚŚS 13.6.2: For the procurement of <s>Soma</s>, one should give something to the <s>Soma</s> seller.
ŚŚS 13.6.3: When [Soma] is unobtainable, having pressed <s>pūtīka</s> [plants], white flowers, <s>arjuna</s> [plants], or <s>kuśa</s> grass, one should mix [the juice] with fresh milk at the morning pressing, with buttermilk (<s>śveta</s>) at the midday [pressing], and with curds at the third pressing.
ŚŚS 13.6.4: Having given one cow as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee), rising from the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath), he should be consecrated again.
ŚŚS 13.6.5: There he should give the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> appropriate to the sacrifice.
ŚŚS 13.6.6: This very [procedure applies].
ŚŚS 13.6.7: When [the Soma] has been burnt, he should give five cows as <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.7.1: prātaḥ.savanāt.some.atirikte /
ŚŚS_13.7.2: asti.somo.ayam.suta.iti.stotriya.anurūpau.hotuḥ /

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.7.1: When <s>Soma</s> remains after the morning pressing:
ŚŚS 13.7.2: 'There is this <s>Soma</s>, pressed' — these are the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> [verses] of the <s>Hotṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 13.7.3: He should add to the <s>stoma</s> (chant) with <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.7.4: The <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verse serves as] the <s>yājyā</s> (offering verse).
ŚŚS 13.7.5: '<s>Indram</s> id gāthino bṛhat' [and] 'Ato devā avantu naḥ' — six [verses].
ŚŚS 13.7.6: Having enclosed with the last [verse], he offers with 'Viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata.'

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.8.1: mādhyaṃdinād.atirikte /

ŚŚS_13.8.4: aindrā.vaiṣṇavī.yājyā /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.8.1: When [Soma] remains after the midday [pressing]:
ŚŚS 13.8.2: 'Baṇ mahān' [and] 'Ud u tyad darśatam' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> are <s>pragātha</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.8.3: He should add to the <s>stoma</s> with <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.8.4: The <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verse serves as] the <s>yājyā</s>.

ŚŚS_13.9.4: aindrā.vaiṣṇavī.yājyā /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.9.1: When [Soma] remains after the third pressing:
ŚŚS 13.9.2: 'Pra tat te adya śipiviṣṭa' [and] 'Pra tad Viṣṇuḥ' — the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 13.9.3: He should add to the <s>stoma</s> with <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.9.4: The <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verse serves as] the <s>yājyā</s>.

ŚŚS_13.10.11: trīṇy.āśvinam.ṣaṣṭi.śatāni /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.10.1: When [Soma] remains after the <s>Āśvina</s> [pressing]:
ŚŚS 13.10.2: He should add to the <s>stoma</s> with <s>Āśvinī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.10.3: The <s>Āśvinī</s> [verse serves as] the <s>yājyā</s>.
ŚŚS 13.10.4: If, while [the hymn] has not been fully praised, dawn breaks upon them with the <s>paryāya</s>s, they chant with five <s>stomas</s> for the <s>Hotraka</s> [priests].
ŚŚS 13.10.5: Having recited the <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> [verses], they should recite two each of the <s>Jagatī</s> [verses] that serve as openings of the <s>uktha</s> [recitations].
ŚŚS 13.10.6: The <s>paridhānīyā</s> [verses] are fixed.
ŚŚS 13.10.7: Or [they use] the complete first <s>paryāya</s>s.
ŚŚS 13.10.8: The first <s>paryāya</s>s [go] to the <s>Hotṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 13.10.9: The middle ones to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> and <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>.
ŚŚS 13.10.10: The last ones to the <s>Acchāvāka</s>.
ŚŚS 13.10.11: The <s>Āśvina</s> [pressing consists of] three hundred and sixty [verses].

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.11.1: yadi.dīkṣitaḥ.pramīyeta.dagdhvā.asthīny.upanahya.putram.bhrātaram.vā.dīkṣayitvā.saha.yajeran /
ŚŚS_13.11.2: abhiṣutya.vā.rājānam.agṛhītvā.grahān.dakṣiṇā.parasyām.vedi.śroṇyām.asthi.kumbham.nidhāya.tasmin.deśe.sārparājñībhiḥ.parācībhiḥ.stuvate /
ŚŚS_13.11.3: mārjālīya.deśe.vā /
ŚŚS_13.11.4: triḥ.prasavyam.mārjālīyam.pariyanti.savyān.ūrūn.apāghnātāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.11.5: sārparājñīr.hotā.nigadet /
ŚŚS_13.11.6: asammitam.stotram /
ŚŚS_13.11.7: aindravāyavyād.yā.grahāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.11.8: saṃvatsare.asthīni.yājayeyuḥ /
ŚŚS_13.11.9: stotre.stotre.asthi.kumbham.upanidadhati /
ŚŚS_13.11.10: mārjalīye.bhakṣān.ninayanti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.11.1: If a consecrated person dies, having cremated [him] and wrapped the bones, they should consecrate his son or brother and perform the sacrifice together.
ŚŚS 13.11.2: Or, having pressed the king [<s>Soma</s>], without taking the <s>graha</s> (libation cups), having placed the bone-urn at the southern hip of the <s>vedi</s> (altar) on the far side, at that spot they chant the <s>Sārparājñī</s> [verses] in reversed order.
ŚŚS 13.11.3: Or at the place of the <s>Mārjālīya</s> [fire].
ŚŚS 13.11.4: They circumambulate the <s>Mārjālīya</s> three times to the left, striking [themselves on] the left thighs.
ŚŚS 13.11.5: The <s>Hotṛ</s> should recite the <s>Sārparājñī</s> [verses] as a <s>nigada</s> (spoken formula).
ŚŚS 13.11.6: The <s>stotra</s> (chant) is of unequal [structure].
ŚŚS 13.11.7: The <s>graha</s>s (cups) [are taken] from the <s>Aindravāyava</s> [cup] onward.
ŚŚS 13.11.8: After a year, they should have the bones offered.
ŚŚS 13.11.9: At each <s>stotra</s>, they place the bone-urn beside [the fire].
ŚŚS 13.11.10: At the <s>Mārjālīya</s> [fire], they convey the <s>bhakṣa</s> (consecrated portions).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.12.1: kalaśe.dīrṇe.vidhum.dadrāṇam.iti.vaṣaṭ.kāra.nidhanena.brāhmaṇācchaṃsine.stuvate /
ŚŚS_13.12.2: pūrvas.tṛco.anurūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.12.3: grāvṇi.dīrṇe.vṛtrasya.tvā.śvasathād.īṣamāṇā.iti.dyutānena.mārutena.brāhmaṇācchaṃsine.stuvate /

ŚŚS_13.12.8: upavāte.nārāśaṃse.yam.jaghanyam.graham.gṛhṇīyāt.tasya.hutasya.alpakam.avanayet.prajāpataye.svāhā.iti /
ŚŚS_13.12.9: duṣṭam.somam.prājāpatyābhiś.catasṛbhir.adhvaryur.uttara.ardha.pūrva.ardha.uparave.avanayet /
ŚŚS_13.12.10: kṛtsnam.vedam.amṛtam.anna.adya.bhāgam.iti.dhyāyann.avavṛṣṭasya.bhakṣayed.indur.indram.avāgāt.tasya.tu.indrav.indra.pītasya.upahūtasya.upahūto.bhakṣayāmi.iti /
