ŚŚS_13.12.13a: ya.ṛte.cid.iti.tṛcena.mahā.vīram.bhinnam.anumantrya.|.trayas.triṃśat.tantavo.ye.vitnire.ya.imam.yajñam.svadhayā.bhajante.|.teṣām.chinnam.sam.imam.dadhāmi.svāhā.gharmo.apyetu.devān /
ŚŚS_13.12.13b: yajñasya.doho.vitataḥ.purutrā.so.aṣṭadhā.divam.anvātatāna.|.sa.yajña.dhukṣva.mahi.me.prajāyai.rāyas.poṣam.viśvamāyur.aśīya.|.svāhā.iti.ca.āhutī.juhoti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.12.1: When a vessel (<s>kalaśa</s>) breaks, they chant for the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> with 'Vidhum dadrāṇam' with the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> as the concluding note (<s>nidhana</s>).
ŚŚS 13.12.2: The preceding <s>tṛca</s> (triad of verses) is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 13.12.3: When a pressing stone (<s>grāvan</s>) breaks, they chant for the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> with 'Vṛtrasya tvā śvasathād īṣamāṇā' set to the <s>Dyutāna</s> <s>Māruta</s> [melody].
ŚŚS 13.12.4: The latter [verse] is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
ŚŚS 13.12.5: He should add to the <s>stoma</s> with <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.12.6: The <s>Aindrāvaiṣṇavī</s> [verse serves as] the <s>yājyā</s>.
ŚŚS 13.12.7: Having raised the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> [cup], [reciting]: 'Be satisfied with the offered and unoffered; with the offered and the unoffered — <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, [be satisfied] with this <s>Soma</s> — <s>svāhā</s>' — he offers into the ashes within the enclosing sticks.
ŚŚS 13.12.8: When the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> [cup] has been exposed to the wind, from whichever <s>graha</s> cup he takes last, he should pour a small portion of that offered [Soma], [saying]: 'To <s>Prajāpati</s> — <s>svāhā</s>.'
ŚŚS 13.12.9: Spoiled <s>Soma</s> — the <s>Adhvaryu</s> should pour it as a residue at the juncture of the northern and southern halves [of the altar] with four <s>Prājāpatya</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 13.12.10: Meditating 'the entire <s>Veda</s>, the immortal, the portion of food,' he should consume [a portion] of the rained-upon [Soma, saying]: '<s>Indu</s> (the drop) has gone to <s>Indra</s>; of that, O <s>Indra</s>, of <s>Indra</s>'s that has been drunk, that has been invoked — invoked, I consume.'
ŚŚS 13.12.11: He should offer into the prepared <s>camasa</s> cup [with the verse] 'Hiraṇyagarbha' (Golden Embryo).
ŚŚS 13.12.12: And having covered it, he should carry it out.
ŚŚS 13.12.13: Having consecrated the broken <s>Mahāvīra</s> [vessel] with the <s>tṛca</s> 'Ya ṛte cit,' [he says]: 'The thirty-three threads that are stretched out, that serve this sacrifice with their own nature — of those that are cut, I join this together — <s>svāhā</s>, may the hot [milk offering] go to the gods.' [And:] 'The milking of the sacrifice, stretched forth in many ways, has been extended eightfold to heaven. Milk for me, O sacrifice, great [blessings] for my progeny; may I enjoy wealth, increase, and the entire lifespan — <s>svāhā</s>' — he offers these two oblations.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.13.1: yadi.satrāya.dīkṣito.atha.sāmyuttiṣṭhet.somam.apabhajya.rājānam.viśvajitā.atirātreṇa.yajeta.sarva.stomena.sarva.pṛṣṭhena.sarva.vedasa.dakṣiṇena /
ŚŚS_13.13.2: āgur.ya.vā /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.13.1: If one consecrated for a <s>sattra</s> (communal session) then withdraws, having distributed the <s>Soma</s>, the king [<s>Soma</s>], he should sacrifice with the <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering) <s>Atirātra</s>, with all <s>stomas</s>, with all <s>pṛṣṭha</s> [sāmans], with all his possessions as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
ŚŚS 13.13.2: Or [if there has been] a transgression.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.14.1: āhita.agnaya.iṣṭa.prathama.yajñā.dīkṣitā.gṛhapati.saptadaśāḥ.satram.āsīran.hotā.maitrāvaruṇo.acchāvāko.grāvastud.brahmā.brāhmaṇācchaṃsī.potā.āgnīdhra.udgātā.prastotā.pratihartā.subrahmaṇyo.adhvaryuḥ.pratiprasthātā.neṣṭā.unnetā /
ŚŚS_13.14.2: ārtvijyasya.avipratiṣedhena.aśakye.yaugapadye /
ŚŚS_13.14.3: dīkṣaṇa.ānupūrvyeṇa.sarveṣām.yājamānam /
ŚŚS_13.14.4: mukhyaḥ.kuryāt.para.arthāni /
ŚŚS_13.14.5: kalpa.vipratiṣedhe.bhūyasām.sādharmyam /
ŚŚS_13.14.6: huteṣu.dākṣiṇeṣu.dakṣiṇā.pathena.kṛṣṇa.ajināni.dhunvanto.ahar.ahar.ity.āvrajeyur.idam.aham.mām.kalyāṇyai.kīrtyai.svargāya.lokāya.amṛtatvāya.dakṣiṇām.nayāni.iti /
ŚŚS_13.14.7: ukthāya.ca.agniṣṭomaḥ.sahasra.dakṣiṇaḥ.pṛṣṭha.śamanīyaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.14.8: sādhāraṇam.ha.eke.pṛṣṭha.śamanīyam /
ŚŚS_13.14.9: dvādaśa.aha.prabhṛtīnyā.catvāriṃśad.rātrād.eka.uttarāṇi.rātri.satrāṇi.teṣu.nityaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.14.10: dvādaśa.aho.yair.ahobhir.vivardhate.tāny.udāhariṣyāmaḥ /
body.translated_text:
13.14.1: Those who have established their sacred fires, who have performed the first sacrifice, who are consecrated -- seventeen <s>gṛhapatis</s> (householder-sacrificers) should sit for the <s>sattra</s> (sacrificial session): the <s>Hotā</s>, the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, the <s>Acchāvāka</s>, the <s>Grāvastut</s>, the <s>Brahmā</s>, the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>, the <s>Potā</s>, the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, the <s>Udgātā</s>, the <s>Prastotā</s>, the <s>Pratihartā</s>, the <s>Subrahmaṇya</s>, the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the <s>Pratiprasthātā</s>, the <s>Neṣṭā</s>, and the <s>Unnetā</s>.
13.14.2: Since the simultaneous performance of all priestly offices is impossible without conflict,
13.14.3: the sacrificial duties of all are performed according to the order of their consecration.
13.14.4: The chief one should perform the duties on behalf of the others.
13.14.5: When there is conflict of ritual procedures, conformity with the majority prevails.
13.14.6: When the <s>dākṣiṇa</s> (offerings for fees) have been offered, they should go day after day along the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (southern) path, shaking black antelope skins, saying: "I lead the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee) for myself, for auspicious fame, for the heavenly world, for immortality."
13.14.7: For the <s>Uktha</s> (recitation day), the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> (fire-praise sacrifice) with a thousand as the fee, accompanied by the <s>Pṛṣṭha-śamanīya</s> (back-chant offering).
13.14.8: Some hold the <s>Pṛṣṭha-śamanīya</s> to be common to all.
13.14.9: From the twelve-day session onward up to the forty-night session, the night-<s>sattras</s> (sessions) increase by one each; in these the rule is fixed.
13.14.10: We shall enumerate the days by which the twelve-day session is expanded.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.15.1: eka.aha.arthe.mahā.vratam.āharanti /
ŚŚS_13.15.2: sarva.stomam.vā.atirātram /
ŚŚS_13.15.3: antareṇa.pṛṣṭhyam.chandomāṃś.ca /
ŚŚS_13.15.4: dvy.aha.arthe.go.āyuṣī /
ŚŚS_13.15.5: dvitīyam.tṛtīyam.ca.abhiplavike.pratīyeta.etasyām.codanāyām /
ŚŚS_13.15.6: try.aha.arthe.trīṇi.pūrvāṇy.ābhiplavikāni /
ŚŚS_13.15.7: catur.aha.arthe.mahā.vrata.caturthāni /
ŚŚS_13.15.8: pañca.aha.arthe.pañca /
ŚŚS_13.15.9: ṣaḷ.aha.arthe.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_13.15.10: sapta.aha.arthe.mahā.vrata.saptamāni /
ŚŚS_13.15.11: etena.nyāyena.tām.tām.saṃkhyām.pūrayanti /
ŚŚS_13.15.12: antareṇa.prāyaṇīyam.pṛṣṭhyam.ca.eteṣām.sthānam /
ŚŚS_13.15.13: ūrdhvam.tu.daśamād.ahno.mahā.vratasya.sthānam /
body.translated_text:
13.15.1: For the purpose of a one-day rite, they employ the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great observance day).
13.15.2: Or an <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight rite) with all <s>stomas</s> (praise-forms).
13.15.3: Between the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> (back-chant six-day) and the <s>Chandoma</s> (metre days).
13.15.4: For the purpose of a two-day rite, the <s>Go</s> (cow day) and <s>Āyus</s> (life day).
13.15.5: The second and the third should be understood as belonging to the <s>Abhiplava</s> (flowing praise-cycle) under this injunction.
13.15.6: For the purpose of a three-day rite, three initial <s>Ābhiplavika</s> (Abhiplava-type) days.
13.15.7: For the purpose of a four-day rite, the <s>Mahāvrata</s> is the fourth.
13.15.8: For the purpose of a five-day rite, five days.
13.15.9: For the purpose of a six-day rite, six days.
13.15.10: For the purpose of a seven-day rite, the <s>Mahāvrata</s> is the seventh.
13.15.11: By this method, they complete whatever number is required.
13.15.12: The place of these is between the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (opening rite) and the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> (back-chant period).
13.15.13: But after the tenth day, the position is that of the <s>Mahāvrata</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.16.1: atha.etāny.apavadanti /
ŚŚS_13.16.2: abhiplavo.abhijid.viśvajitau.ca.āgantūni.viṃśati.rātre /
ŚŚS_13.16.3: abhiplavo.atirātro.dvāv.abhiplavāv.ity.eka.viṃśati.rātraḥ.pūrvaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.16.4: pṛṣṭhyaḥ.svara.sāmāno.viṣuvān.āvṛttāḥ.svara.sāmānas.trayas.triṃśa.ārambhaṇaḥ.pṛṣṭhya.ity.uttaraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.16.5: pṛṣṭhya.sotmaḥ.ṣaḷ.ahaḥ.|.trayas.triṃśam.ahar.aniruktam.|.trayas.triṃśa.ārambhaṇaḥ.pṛṣṭhya.stomaḥ.ṣaḷ.ahaḥ.|.trivṛd.ahar.aniruktam.|.jyotiṣṭomo.agniṣṭoma.iti.catur.viṃśati.rātraḥ.saṃsadām.ayanam.ity.ācakṣate /
body.translated_text:
13.16.1: Now they specify exceptions to these.
13.16.2: The <s>Abhiplava</s>, the <s>Abhijit</s> (victory day), and the <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering day) are additional days in the twenty-night session.
13.16.3: The first twenty-one-night session consists of: an <s>Abhiplava</s>, an <s>Atirātra</s>, and two <s>Abhiplavas</s>.
13.16.4: The latter consists of: a <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, <s>Svara-sāman</s> (tone-chant) days, the <s>Viṣuvān</s> (solstice day), the returning <s>Svara-sāman</s> days, a thirty-three-fold opening, and a <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>.
13.16.5: A <s>Pṛṣṭhya-stoma</s> six-day period, an unexpressed thirty-three-fold day, a thirty-three-fold opening <s>Pṛṣṭhya-stoma</s> six-day period, an unexpressed <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold) day, and a <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> (light-praise) <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> -- this is the twenty-four-night session; they call it the <s>Saṃsadām Ayana</s> (session of assemblies).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.17.1: pañca.ābhiplavikāni.trir.upetya.viśvajid.atirātra.eṣa.eva.pañca.aho.daśa.rātra.iti.trayas.triṃśad.rātraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.17.2: caturviṃśam.abhiplavaḥ.pṛṣṭhyo.nava.aho.go.āyuṣī.daśa.rātro.mahā.vratam.iti.sapta.triṃśad.rātraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.17.3a: catur.viṃśam.trayo.abhiplavāḥ.|.abhijit.svara.sāmāno.viṣuvān.āvṛttāḥ.svara.sāmāno.viśvajic.ca.|.abhijit.prabhṛti.nava.rātra.ity.ācakṣate /
ŚŚS_13.17.3b: abhiplavo.go.āyuṣī.daśa.rātro.mahā.vratam.|.ity.enānna.pañcāśad.rātraḥ.|.saṃvatsara.sammitaḥ /
body.translated_text:
13.17.1: Five <s>Ābhiplavika</s> (Abhiplava-type) periods approached thrice, then the <s>Viśvajit</s> <s>Atirātra</s> -- this same five-day and ten-night arrangement makes the thirty-three-night session.
13.17.2: A twenty-four-fold <s>Abhiplava</s>, a <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, a nine-day period, <s>Go-Āyus</s> (cow and life days), a ten-night period, and the <s>Mahāvrata</s> -- this is the thirty-seven-night session.
13.17.3a: A twenty-four-fold period, three <s>Abhiplavas</s>, <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Svara-sāman</s> days, the <s>Viṣuvān</s>, the returning <s>Svara-sāman</s> days, and the <s>Viśvajit</s> -- from <s>Abhijit</s> onward they call it the nine-night period.
13.17.3b: An <s>Abhiplava</s>, <s>Go-Āyus</s>, a ten-night period, and the <s>Mahāvrata</s> -- thus this is the forty-nine-night session, corresponding to the year.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.18.1: atha.eka.ṣaṣṭi.rātre /
ŚŚS_13.18.2: abhito.nava.rātram.ṣaṣṭhyau /
ŚŚS_13.18.3: tayor.āvṛtta.uttaraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.18.4: nyāya.klṛptaḥ.śata.rātraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.18.5: ardha.pañcadaśa.abhiplavās.teṣām.prathamas.tryaho.daśarātro.mahā.vratam.iti /
body.translated_text:
13.18.1: Now regarding the sixty-one-night session.
13.18.2: On both sides of the nine-night period there are six-day periods.
13.18.3: Of these two, the latter is in reverse order.
13.18.4: The hundred-night session is arranged according to the standard method.
13.18.5: Fourteen and a half <s>Abhiplava</s> cycles -- of these, the first three-day period, the <s>Daśarātra</s> (ten-day rite), and the <s>Mahāvrata</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.19.1: saptadaśa.gavām.ayanasya.dīkṣā /
ŚŚS_13.19.2: dvādaśa.vā /
ŚŚS_13.19.3: taiṣasya.amāvāsyāyā.ekāha.upariṣṭād.dīkṣeran.māghasya.vā /
ŚŚS_13.19.4: teṣām.māghasya.amāvāsyāyām.upavasathaḥ.phālgunasya.vā /
ŚŚS_13.19.5: dvādaśa.dīkṣāḥ.kurvāṇāś.catur.ahe.purastāt.paurṇamāsyā.dīkṣeran /
ŚŚS_13.19.6: teṣām.jyautsnasya.pañcamyām.prasavaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.19.7: prāyaṇīyam.atirātram.upetya.caturviṃśam.ca.pṛṣṭhya.pañcamāṃś.caturo.abhiplavān.upayanti /
ŚŚS_13.19.8: sa.māsaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.19.9: tathā.yuktān.pañca.māsān.upetya.pṛṣṭhya.caturthān.abhiplavān.upayanti /
ŚŚS_13.19.10: nava.rātram.ca /
ŚŚS_13.19.11: ūrdhvam.viśvajitaḥ.pṛṣṭhya.ārambhaṇān.māsān.upayanti /
ŚŚS_13.19.12: pṣṭhya.abhiplavau.ca.anvaham.āvarteta /
ŚŚS_13.19.13: vaiśvadeva.sūktāni.ca.uttamānām.ābhiplavikānām /
ŚŚS_13.19.14: pṛṣṭhyam.upetya.trīn.abhiplavān /
ŚŚS_13.19.15: sa.māsaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.19.16: pṛṣṭhyam.upetya.caturo.abhiplavān.|.tathā.yuktāṃś.caturo.māsān.upetya.trīn.abhiplavān.upayanty.āyur.gām.daśarātram.mahā.vratam.atirātram.ca /
ŚŚS_13.19.17: iti.gavām.ayanasya.ahar.yogaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.19.18: tat.prakṛtīni.saṃvatsara.sattrāṇi /
ŚŚS_13.19.19: teṣu.vikāro.anyatra.daśarātrāt /
ŚŚS_13.19.20: pṛṣṭhyasya.abhiplavaḥ.sthāne.tad.abhiplava.ayanam /
body.translated_text:
13.19.1: Seventeen days is the consecration period for the <s>Gavām Ayana</s> (cows' journey, the year-long session).
13.19.2: Or twelve.
13.19.3: They should be consecrated one day after the new moon of <s>Taiṣa</s> (month of Pauṣa/January) or of <s>Māgha</s> (February).
13.19.4: For them, the <s>upavasatha</s> (preparatory fast day) is on the new moon of <s>Māgha</s> or of <s>Phālguna</s> (March).
13.19.5: Those performing twelve consecrations should be consecrated four days before the full moon.
13.19.6: For them, the initiation is on the fifth day of the bright half.
13.19.7: Having approached the <s>Prāyaṇīya Atirātra</s> (opening overnight rite) and the twenty-four-fold period, they proceed to four <s>Abhiplava</s> cycles with the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> as the fifth.
13.19.8: That is one month.
13.19.9: Having thus approached five months in this arrangement, they proceed to <s>Abhiplava</s> cycles with the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> as the fourth.
13.19.10: And the nine-night period.
13.19.11: After the <s>Viśvajit</s>, they proceed to months beginning with the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>.
13.19.12: And the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> and <s>Abhiplava</s> should alternate day by day.
13.19.13: And the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (all-gods) hymns for the last <s>Ābhiplavika</s> days.
13.19.14: Having approached the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, three <s>Abhiplavas</s>.
13.19.15: That is one month.
13.19.16: Having approached the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, four <s>Abhiplavas</s>; having thus approached four months in this arrangement, they proceed to three <s>Abhiplavas</s>, the <s>Āyus</s> (life day), the <s>Go</s> (cow day), the <s>Daśarātra</s> (ten-day rite), the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, and the <s>Atirātra</s>.
13.19.17: This is the day-arrangement of the <s>Gavām Ayana</s>.
13.19.18: The year-long <s>sattras</s> (sessions) are based on this as their prototype.
13.19.19: In those, variations occur except in the <s>Daśarātra</s>.
13.19.20: When the <s>Abhiplava</s> takes the place of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, that is called the <s>Abhiplava Ayana</s> (Abhiplava session).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.20.1: utsargiṇām.ayane /
ŚŚS_13.20.2: yāni.paurṇamāsībhiḥ.sutyāny.ahāni.samnipateyus.tāny.utsṛjeran /
ŚŚS_13.20.3: ubhābhyām.vā.darśa.pūrṇa.māsābhyām /
ŚŚS_13.20.4: eka.trikam.vā.stomam.kurvīran /
ŚŚS_13.20.5: eka.ekām.vā.stotriyāṇām.utsṛjeran /
ŚŚS_13.20.6: śastrāṇām /
ŚŚS_13.20.7: yajuṣām.ca /
ŚŚS_13.20.7: ahar.utsṛjamānāḥ.prājāpatyena.tad.ahaḥ.paśunā.yajeran /
ŚŚS_13.20.9: yad.devato.vā.savanīyaḥ.syāt /
ŚŚS_13.20.10: tatra.paśu.tantre.havīṃṣy.anvāyātayanti /
ŚŚS_13.20.11: teṣām.sa.dharmo.yaḥ.paśu.tantre.codyamānānām /
ŚŚS_13.20.12: parasya.ahnaḥ.stotriyān.anurūpān.kurvīran /
ŚŚS_13.20.13: yathā.artham.atipraiṣaiḥ /
ŚŚS_13.20.14: utthāya.ca.dvādaśa.aham.āsīran /
ŚŚS_13.20.15: ubhayīr.utsṛjyamānāḥ.saṃsadām.ayanam /
body.translated_text:
13.20.1: In the session of the <s>Utsargins</s> (those who omit):
13.20.2: Those pressing days which would coincide with full moon days, they should omit.
13.20.3: Or on both the new moon and full moon days.
13.20.4: Or they should make the <s>stoma</s> (praise-form) a single triad.
13.20.5: Or they should omit one each of the <s>stotriyas</s> (praise-verses).
13.20.6: And of the <s>śastras</s> (recitations).
13.20.7: And of the <s>yajus</s> (sacrificial formulas).
13.20.7: Those who omit a day should sacrifice on that day with an animal sacred to <s>Prajāpati</s>.
13.20.9: Or with one whose deity corresponds to the <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day offering).
13.20.10: In that case, the oblations are made to follow the animal rite framework.
13.20.11: Their rule is that which applies to those enjoined in the animal rite framework.
13.20.12: They should make the <s>stotriyas</s> and <s>anurūpas</s> (corresponding verses) belong to the following day.
13.20.13: With <s>atipraiṣas</s> (additional directions) as appropriate.
13.20.14: And having risen, they should sit for twelve days.
13.20.15: When both types are omitted, it is the <s>Saṃsadām Ayana</s> (session of assemblies).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.21.1: ādityānām.ayane /
ŚŚS_13.21.2: trivṛt.pañcadaśāv.abhiplava.stomau.pūrvasmin.paṭale /
ŚŚS_13.21.3: pañcadaśa.trivṛtā.uttarasmin /
ŚŚS_13.21.4: madhye.pṛṣṭhyāś.ca.māsāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.21.5: ṣaṣṭhe.māsi.trīn.abhiplavān.upetya.pṛṣṭhyam.upayanti.nava.rātram.ca /
ŚŚS_13.21.6: abhijitaḥ.sthāne.bṛhaspati.savam /
ŚŚS_13.21.7: indra.stomam.viśvajitaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.21.8: pṛṣṭhyam.upetya.abhiplavam.ca.vyūḷha.chandasam.daśarātram /
ŚŚS_13.21.9: trivṛti.stomam.agniṣṭoma.saṃstham /
ŚŚS_13.21.10: udbhid.balabhidau.ca /
ŚŚS_13.21.11: madhye.pṛṣṭhyāṃś.caturo.māsān.upetya.madhye.pṛṣṭhyāv.abhiplavā.upayanti /
ŚŚS_13.21.12: go.āyuṣī /
ŚŚS_13.21.13: chandoma.daśa.aham.ca /
body.translated_text:
13.21.1: In the <s>Ādityānām Ayana</s> (session of the Ādityas):
13.21.2: The <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold) and <s>Pañcadaśa</s> (fifteen-fold) are the <s>Abhiplava</s> <s>stomas</s> in the first half.
13.21.3: <s>Pañcadaśa</s> and <s>Trivṛt</s> in the latter half.
13.21.4: And the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> months are in the middle.
13.21.5: In the sixth month, having approached three <s>Abhiplavas</s>, they proceed to the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> and the nine-night period.
13.21.6: In place of the <s>Abhijit</s>, the <s>Bṛhaspati-sava</s> (Bṛhaspati pressing).
13.21.7: The <s>Indrastoma</s> (Indra-praise) in place of the <s>Viśvajit</s>.
13.21.8: Having approached the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> and the <s>Abhiplava</s>, a <s>Daśarātra</s> with rearranged metres.
13.21.9: A <s>Trivṛt-stoma</s> (nine-fold praise) with <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> completion.
13.21.10: And the <s>Udbhid</s> (sprouting) and <s>Balabhid</s> (strength-breaking) rites.
13.21.11: Having approached the middle <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> months for four months, in the middle <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> periods they proceed to <s>Abhiplavas</s>.
13.21.12: The <s>Go-Āyus</s> (cow and life days).
13.21.13: And the <s>Chandoma</s> (metre-day) ten-day period.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.22.1: aṅgirasām.ayane /
ŚŚS_13.22.2: trivṛd.abhiplava.stomaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.22.3: pṛṣṭhya.ārambhaṇān.māsān.upayanti.pūrvasmin.paṭale /
ŚŚS_13.22.4: pṛṣṭhya.udayān.uttarasmin /
ŚŚS_13.22.5: āyur.gām /
ŚŚS_13.22.6: samānam.anyad.ādityānām.ayanena /
body.translated_text:
13.22.1: In the <s>Aṅgirasām Ayana</s> (session of the Aṅgirases):
13.22.2: The <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold) is the <s>Abhiplava</s> <s>stoma</s>.
13.22.3: They proceed to months beginning with the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> in the first half.
13.22.4: Beginning with the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> conclusion in the latter half.
13.22.5: The <s>Āyus</s> (life day) and <s>Go</s> (cow day).
13.22.6: The rest is the same as the <s>Ādityānām Ayana</s> (session of the Ādityas).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.23.1: dṛti.vātavator.ayane /
ŚŚS_13.23.2: pṛṣṭhya.stomānām.eka.ekena.māsam /
ŚŚS_13.23.3: mahā.vratam.viṣuvān /
ŚŚS_13.23.4: āvṛttānām.pṛṣṭhya.stomānām.eka.ekena.māsam /
ŚŚS_13.23.5: atirātrāv.abhitaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.23.6: agniṣṭomā.madhye /
ŚŚS_13.23.7: daśadaśī.saṃvatsaraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.23.8: dvādaśī.viṣuvān.sarpa.sattrasya /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.23.1: The <s>Dṛtivātavat</s> [session] in the <s>ayana</s> (year-long sacrifice).
ŚŚS 13.23.2: One month each for the <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> (back-chant) <s>stomas</s>.
ŚŚS 13.23.3: The <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great observance) [day] is the solstice (<s>viṣuvat</s>).
ŚŚS 13.23.4: One month each for the returning <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> <s>stomas</s>.
ŚŚS 13.23.5: <s>Atirātras</s> (overnight pressings) on both sides.
ŚŚS 13.23.6: <s>Agniṣṭomas</s> in the middle.
ŚŚS 13.23.7: The ten-by-ten [arrangement makes] a year.
ŚŚS 13.23.8: The twelfth [day] is the solstice of the <s>Sarpa-sattra</s> (serpent session).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.24.1: māsam.dīkṣāḥ.kauṇḍapāyinām.ayanam /
ŚŚS_13.24.2: krītvā.rājānam.upanahya.upasada.upetya.agnihotreṇa.māsam /
ŚŚS_13.24.3: darśa.pūrṇa.māsābhyām.māsam /
ŚŚS_13.24.4: cāturmāsya.parvaṇām.eka.ekena.māsam /
ŚŚS_13.24.5: trivṛt.prabhṛtīnām.pañcānām.pṛṣṭhya.stomānām.eka.ekena.māsam /
ŚŚS_13.24.6: aṣṭādaśa.aham.trayas.triṃśena.daśa.rātram.mahā.vratam.atirātram.ca.iti /
ŚŚS_13.24.7: yo.hotā.so.adhvaryuḥ.sa.potā /
ŚŚS_13.24.8: yo.maitrāvaruṇaḥ.sa.brahmā.sa.pratihartā /
ŚŚS_13.24.9: ya.udgātā.so.acchāvākaḥ.sa.neṣṭā /
ŚŚS_13.24.10: yaḥ.prastotā.sa.brāhmaṇācchaṃsī.sa.grāvastut /
ŚŚS_13.24.11: ya.pratiprasthātā.yo.agnīt.sa.unnetā /
ŚŚS_13.24.12: subrahmaṇyaḥ.subrahmaṇyaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.24.13: gṛhapatir.gṛhapatiḥ /
ŚŚS_13.24.14: deśa.kāla.samnikarṣe.avaideśyā.pradhānasya.vaśam.nayet /
ŚŚS_13.24.16: yathā.deśam.itarāṇi /
ŚŚS_13.24.17: sāṃghātikād.ekāhī.bhavato.nivarteran /
ŚŚS_13.24.18: ayam.yajñīya.atipraiṣaḥ.sapuronuvākyaḥ.śvaḥ.stotriyā.hotrakāṇām.kadvanta.uktha.mukhīyāś.ca.abhitaṣṭīyam.iti.tāyamāna.rūpāṇi /
ŚŚS_13.24.19: gavām.eva.ayanasya.ahar.yogaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.24.1: One month of consecrations (<s>dīkṣā</s>) — [this is] the <s>ayana</s> of the <s>Kauṇḍapāyins</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.2: Having bought the <s>Soma</s> king, having bound [him], having approached with the <s>Upasad</s> rites — one month with the <s>Agnihotra</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.3: One month with the new and full moon offerings (<s>Darśa-pūrṇamāsa</s>).
ŚŚS 13.24.4: One month for each of the seasonal festival (<s>Cāturmāsya</s>) occasions.
ŚŚS 13.24.5: One month for each of the five <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> <s>stomas</s> beginning with the ninefold (<s>trivṛt</s>).
ŚŚS 13.24.6: Eighteen days with the thirty-three[-fold stoma], the ten-day [festival], the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, and the <s>Atirātra</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.7: He who is the <s>Hotṛ</s> is also the <s>Adhvaryu</s> and the <s>Potṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.8: He who is the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> is also the <s>Brahman</s> and the <s>Pratihartṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.9: He who is the <s>Udgātṛ</s> is also the <s>Acchāvāka</s> and the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.10: He who is the <s>Prastotṛ</s> is also the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> and the <s>Grāvastut</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.11: He who is the <s>Pratiprasthātṛ</s> and the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> is also the <s>Unnetṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.12: The <s>Subrahmaṇya</s> [priest acts as] the <s>Subrahmaṇya</s>.
ŚŚS 13.24.13: The householder [acts as] the householder.
ŚŚS 13.24.14: When place and time are close together, the subsidiary [rites] should be brought under the control of the principal [rite].
ŚŚS 13.24.16: The other [rites follow] according to the place.
ŚŚS 13.24.17: From a collective [session], they should return as one-day [sacrificers].
ŚŚS 13.24.18: This sacrificial supplementary direction (<s>atipraiṣa</s>) with its invitatory verse, the next day's <s>stotriya</s> [verses] of the assistant priests, the <s>kadvantas</s>, the <s>uktha</s>-opening [verses], and the enclosing [verse] — these are the distinguishing features.
ŚŚS 13.24.19: The day-connection is [determined by] the <s>Gavāmayana</s> (cow-procession year).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.25.1: caturo.māsān.dīkṣāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.25.2: catura.upasadaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.25.3: caturaḥ.sunvanti.iti /
ŚŚS_13.25.4: gavām.ayanasya.prathama.uttamau.māsau /
ŚŚS_13.25.5: aṣṭā.viṃśinau.ca.viṣuvāṃś.ca /
ŚŚS_13.25.6: tat.kṣullaka.tāpaścitam.ity.ācakṣate /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.25.1: Four months of consecrations (<s>dīkṣā</s>).
ŚŚS 13.25.2: Four [months of] <s>Upasad</s> rites.
ŚŚS 13.25.3: Four [months] they press [Soma].
ŚŚS 13.25.4: [These are] the first and last months of the <s>Gavāmayana</s>.
ŚŚS 13.25.5: And the twenty-eight[-day periods], and the solstice.
ŚŚS 13.25.6: They call that the minor <s>Tāpaścita</s> (fire-penance session).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.26.1: saṃvatsaram.dīkṣāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.26.2: saṃvatsaram.upasadaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.26.3: saṃvatsaram.snvanti.iti /
ŚŚS_13.26.4: tat.tāpaścitam.ity.ācakṣate /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.26.1: One year of consecrations.
ŚŚS 13.26.2: One year of <s>Upasad</s> rites.
ŚŚS 13.26.3: One year they press [Soma].
ŚŚS 13.26.4: They call that the <s>Tāpaścita</s> (fire-penance session).

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.27.1: trīn.saṃvatsarān.dīkṣāḥ /
ŚŚS_13.27.2: trīn.upasadaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.27.3: trīn.sunvanti /
ŚŚS_13.27.4: iti.mahā.tāpaścitam /
ŚŚS_13.27.5: abhyāso.bahu.saṃvatsare.gavām.ayanasya /
ŚŚS_13.27.6: saṃhāryān.vā.parihāpya /
ŚŚS_13.27.7: atirātraḥ.sahasram.ahāny.atirātro.agneḥ.sahasra.sāvyam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.27.1: Three years of consecrations.
ŚŚS 13.27.2: Three [years of] <s>Upasad</s> rites.
ŚŚS 13.27.3: Three [years] they press [Soma].
ŚŚS 13.27.4: This is the <s>Mahā-tāpaścita</s> (great fire-penance session).
ŚŚS 13.27.5: Repetition in the multi-year [sessions follows that] of the <s>Gavāmayana</s>.
ŚŚS 13.27.6: Or, passing over those that are to be combined.
ŚŚS 13.27.7: The <s>Atirātra</s> [lasting] a thousand days — the <s>Atirātra</s> of the thousand pressings of <s>Agni</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.28.1: gavām.ayanam.prathamaḥ.saṃvatsaraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.28.2: atha.ādityānām /
ŚŚS_13.28.3: atha.aṅgirasām /
ŚŚS_13.28.4: tri.sāṃvatsaram.prajāti.kāmānām /
ŚŚS_13.28.5: trivṛt.prabhṛtīnām.caturṇām.pṛṣṭhya.stomānām.eka.ekena.trīṃs.trīn.saṃvatsarān.prajāpate.dvādaśa.saṃvatsaram /
ŚŚS_13.28.6: eteṣām.eva.eka.ekena.nava.nava.śaktyānām.ṣaṭ.triṃśat.saṃvatsaram /
ŚŚS_13.28.7: eteṣām.eva.eka.ekena.pañca.viṃśatiḥ.pañca.viṃśatiḥ.sādhyānām.śata.saṃvatsaram /
ŚŚS_13.28.8: eteṣām.eva.eka.ekena.pañca.pañca.pañcāśato.viśvasṛjām.sahasra.saṃvatsaram /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.28.1: The <s>Gavāmayana</s> is the first year.
ŚŚS 13.28.2: Then [the year] of the <s>Ādityas</s>.
ŚŚS 13.28.3: Then [the year] of the <s>Aṅgirasas</s>.
ŚŚS 13.28.4: The three-year [session] is for those desiring offspring.
ŚŚS 13.28.5: One year each for the four <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> <s>stomas</s> beginning with the ninefold — three years each — <s>Prajāpati</s>'s twelve-year [session].
ŚŚS 13.28.6: One year each for these same [stomas] — nine [years] each for those who are able — the thirty-six-year [session].
ŚŚS 13.28.7: One year each for these same [stomas] — five [years each]...

body.text:
ŚŚS_13.29.1: sarasvatyā.vinaśane.dīkṣā.sārasvatānām /

ŚŚS_13.29.13: tad.asya.anīkam.asmin.pada.ity.aponaputriyasya /

ŚŚS_13.29.19: gṛhapatau.vā.mṛte /
ŚŚS_13.29.20: klākṣam.vā.prasravaṇam.prāpya.agnaye.kāmāya.iṣṭim.nirvapanti /
ŚŚS_13.29.21: tasyām.aśvām.ca.pauruṣīm.ca.dhenuke.dattvā.kāra.pacavam.prati.yamunām.avabhṛtham.abhyavayanti /
ŚŚS_13.29.22: iti.mitrā.varuṇayor.ayanam /
ŚŚS_13.29.23: atirātro.abhijid.viśvajitau.go.āyuṣī.indra.kukṣī.atirātraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.29.24: iti.indra.agnyoḥ /
ŚŚS_13.29.25: atirātro.jyotir.gaur.āyur.viśvajid.abhijitāv.indra.kukṣī.atirātraḥ /
ŚŚS_13.29.26: ity.aryamnaḥ /
ŚŚS_13.29.27: saṃvatsaram.brāhmaṇasya.gā.rakṣet /
ŚŚS_13.29.28: saṃvatsaram.vyarṇe.naitaṃdhave.agnim.indhīta /
ŚŚS_13.29.29: saṃvatsare.parīṇahy.agnīn.ādhāya.dṛṣadvatyā.dakṣiṇena.tīreṇa.āgneyena.aṣṭā.kapālena.śamyā.parāse.śamyā.parāse.yajamāna.eti /
ŚŚS_13.29.30: triḥ.prakṣām.prati.yamunām.avabhṛtham.abhyavayanti /
ŚŚS_13.29.31: iti.dārṣadvatam /
ŚŚS_13.29.32: atirātraḥ.sahasram.trivṛtaḥ.saṃvatsarā.atirātraḥ.prajāpateḥ.sahasra.saṃvatsaram.sahasra.saṃvatsaram /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 13.29.1: At the disappearance of the <s>Sarasvatī</s> [river] — the consecration of the <s>Sārasvatīya</s> [sacrificers].
ŚŚS 13.29.2a: Having bought the <s>Soma</s> king, having bound [him], having approached with the <s>Upasad</s> rites, having approached the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> <s>Atirātra</s>, having offered with the <s>Sāmnāyya</s> (mixed milk offering), the <s>Adhvaryu</s> casts away the <s>śamyā</s> (yoke-pin).
ŚŚS 13.29.2b: There he deposits the <s>Gārhapatya</s> fire, and at thirty-six paces he sets up the <s>Āhavanīya</s>.
ŚŚS 13.29.3: The <s>Sadas</s> (assembly hall) is like a wheel.
ŚŚS 13.29.4: Likewise the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> [fire-shed].
ŚŚS 13.29.5: The sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>) has a mortar as its base.
ŚŚS 13.29.6: There is no <s>uparava</s> (pressing-platform)...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.1.1: ekāheṣv.ahīneṣu.ca.prakṛter.vikāraḥ /
ŚŚS_14.1.2: yasminn.ahani.yad.ahaḥ.pradiśyeta.savanam.vā.sahautram.tat /
ŚŚS_14.1.3: aikāhikam.anādeśe /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.1.1: In one-day (<s>ekāha</s>) and multi-day (<s>ahīna</s>) [sacrifices], there are modifications from the basic model (<s>prakṛti</s>).
ŚŚS 14.1.2: On whatever day and for whatever day-[type] is indicated — that pressing or that [set of] priestly offices [is adopted].
ŚŚS 14.1.3: The one-day [format applies] when there is no [specific] instruction.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.2.1: agny.ādheyena.brahma.varcasa.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.2.2: tasya.aṣṭāsv.aṣṭāsu.stotrāṇi /
ŚŚS_14.2.3: aṣṭa.akṣarā.gāyatrī /
ŚŚS_14.2.4: tejo.brahma.varcasam.gāyatrī /
ŚŚS_14.2.5: rathantaram.pṛṣṭham /
ŚŚS_14.2.6: brahma.rathantaram /
ŚŚS_14.2.7: agniṣṭomo.yajñaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.2.8: brahma.vā.agniṣṭomaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.2.9: etena.triḥ.samṛddhena.brahmaṇā.tejo.brahma.varcasam.āpnoti /
ŚŚS_14.2.10: tṛca.klṛptam.śastram /
ŚŚS_14.2.11: trivṛd.vā.annam.annam.pānam.khādayanti.tasya.sarvasya.āptyai /
ŚŚS_14.2.12: catur.viṃśatir.dakṣiṇā /
ŚŚS_14.2.13: catur.viṃśatir.vai.saṃvatsarasya.ardha.māsāḥ.saṃvatsarasya.eva.āptyai /
ŚŚS_14.2.14: tasya.agnaye.pavamānāya.pāvakāya.śucaya.iti.paśava.upālambhyāḥ.savanīyasya /
ŚŚS_14.2.15: ādityā.vaśā.anubandhyāyā.upālambhya.evam.vidhā /
ŚŚS_14.2.16: tad.yad.evam.paśavo.niyuktā.bhavanti.na.id.agny.ādheyād.ayāni.iti /
ŚŚS_14.2.17: tasya.prātaḥ.savanīyān.anu.puroḷāśān.agnaye.pavamānāya.aṣṭa.kapālam puroḷāśam nirvapati /
ŚŚS_14.2.18: mādhyaṃdinīyān anu.puroḷāśān.agnaye.pāvakasya /
ŚŚS_14.2.19: tṛtīya.savanīyān.anu.puroḷāśān.agnaye.śucaye /
ŚŚS_14.2.20: āvapanam.vai.savanīyāḥ.puroḷāśāḥ.|.āvapana.eva.tad.āvapati /
ŚŚS_14.2.21: atha.yad.ādityā.vaśā.anubandhyāyā.upālambhyā.bhavaty.aditim.vā.anvagny.ādheyam.saṃtiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_14.2.22: yā.anvagny.ādheyasya.saṃsthā.tām.eva.tad.yajñasya.saṃsthām.karoti /
body.translated_text:
14.2.1: One desiring the splendor of sacred knowledge (<s>brahmavarcasa</s>) should sacrifice with the fire-establishment (<s>agnyādheya</s>).
14.2.2: Its chants are [arranged] in groups of eight.
14.2.3: The <s>Gāyatrī</s> has eight syllables.
14.2.4: Radiance and sacred splendor (<s>brahmavarcasa</s>) [are obtained through] the <s>Gāyatrī</s>.
14.2.5: The <s>Rathantara</s> is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant).
14.2.6: The <s>Rathantara</s> is <s>Brahman</s> (the sacred word).
14.2.7: The <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> is the sacrifice.
14.2.8: Or the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> is <s>Brahman</s>.
14.2.9: Through this threefold-prosperous sacred knowledge, one attains radiance and sacred splendor.
14.2.10: The recitation is arranged in <s>tṛcas</s> (triplets).
14.2.11: Or the <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold [stoma]) — they cause [the sacrificer] to eat food, drink, and delicacies; for the attainment of all that.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.3.1: evam.paśavaḥ.puroḷāśāś.ca.anvāyāty.ante.havir.yajñeṣu.someṣu /

ŚŚS_14.3.13: tṛca.klṛptam.ity.etasyām.codanāyām.etat.śastram.pratīyeta /
ŚŚS_14.3.14: aikāhikam.vā.tṛca.klṛptam /

ŚŚS_14.3.18: paśū.ca /
ŚŚS_14.3.19: prājāpatyā.vaśā.anubandhyāyā.upālabhya.evam.vidhā /
body.translated_text:
14.3.1: Thus the animals and rice-cakes follow at the end, in the oblation-sacrifices and Soma-sacrifices.
14.3.2: Its recitation [is as follows].
14.3.3: 'yad vāhiṣṭham' (What is best to convey) — a <s>tṛca</s> (triplet) as the <s>Ājya</s> (ghee-hymn).
14.3.4: The <s>Praugā</s> (introductory hymn) is of <s>Madhucchandas</s>.
14.3.5: Three <s>tṛcas</s> each for the <s>hotrakāṇām</s> (assistant invokers) at the morning pressing: the <s>stotriya</s>, the <s>anurūpa</s>, and the <s>paryāsa</s>.
14.3.6: 'indra marutva iha pāhi somam' (O <s>Indra</s> accompanied by the <s>Maruts</s>, drink the Soma here) — a <s>tṛca</s> for the <s>Marutvatīya</s> (hymn accompanying the Maruts).
14.3.7: 'nṛṇām u tvā nṛtamam gīrbhir ukthaiḥ' (Thee, most manly among men, with songs and praises) — a <s>tṛca</s> for the <s>Niṣkevalya</s> (independent recitation).
14.3.8: 'adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānām' (O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, O hero, forth for the great pressings) — a <s>tṛca</s> for the opening of the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>'s <s>uktha</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.4.1: punar.ādheyena.tejas.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.4.2: tasya.pañcasu.pañcasu.stotrāṇi /
ŚŚS_14.4.3: pañca.padā.paṅktiḥ /
ŚŚS_14.4.4: pāṅkto.vai.yajñaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.4.5: yajñasya.eva.āptyai /
ŚŚS_14.4.6: sarva.āgneyād.agni.ṣṭutaḥ.śastram /
body.translated_text:
14.4.1: One desiring radiance (<s>tejas</s>) should sacrifice with the re-establishment of the fire (<s>punarādheya</s>).
14.4.2: Its chants are [arranged] in groups of five.
14.4.3: The <s>Paṅkti</s> [meter] has five feet.
14.4.4: The sacrifice is indeed <s>Pāṅkta</s> (fivefold).
14.4.5: For the attainment of the sacrifice itself.
14.4.6: The recitation is <s>Agni-ṣṭuta</s> (Agni-praised), from the all-Agni [offering].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.5.1: darśa.pūrṇa.māsāv.anna.adya.kāmasya /
ŚŚS_14.5.2: iḷādadhāv.āgrayaṇaḥ.soma.iṣṭiś.ca.apravargyaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.5.3: dākṣāyaṇa.yajñāś.catvāraḥ.sarva.kāmasya /
ŚŚS_14.5.4: mahā.yajñaś.ca /
ŚŚS_14.5.5: tasmiṃś.cāturmāsya.havīṃṣy.anvāyāty.ante /
ŚŚS_14.5.6: paśavaś.ca.parva.devatābhyaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.5.7: eka.kapāla.devatābhyaś.ca.anubandhyāyā.upālambhyā.evam.vidhāḥ /
ŚŚS_14.5.8: atirātro.yajñaḥ /
body.translated_text:
14.5.1: The new-and-full-moon [sacrifices are] for one desiring food.
14.5.2: The <s>Iḍādadhā</s>, the <s>Āgrayaṇa</s> (first-fruits offering), the <s>Soma-iṣṭi</s>, without the <s>Pravargya</s>.
14.5.3: The four <s>Dākṣāyaṇa</s> sacrifices [are] for one desiring all [wishes].
14.5.4: And the great sacrifice (<s>Mahāyajña</s>).
14.5.5: In that, the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> (four-monthly) oblations follow at the end.
14.5.6: And animals for the festival deities.
14.5.7: And for the deities [of the] single-dish [offerings], the supplementary victim and the slaughter-victim — of this nature.
14.5.8: The <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight sacrifice) is the sacrifice.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.6.1: prajāpatir.ha.prajāti.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.vaiśvadevam.|.tam.āharat.|.tena.ayajata.|.tena.iṣṭvā.prājāyata.|.tena.prajāti.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.6.2: vaiśvadevaḥ.paśur.upālambhyaḥ.savanīyasya /
ŚŚS_14.6.3: dyāvā.pṛthivīyā.vaśā.anubandhyāyā.upālambhyā.evam.vidhā /
ŚŚS_14.6.4: trivṛtaḥ.śastram /
ŚŚS_14.6.5: tṛca.klṛptam.vā /
ŚŚS_14.6.6: avabhṛthād.udetya.udavasānīyayā.iṣṭvā.muni.sattra.iṣṭyā.yajamāna.āste.ahar.ahaś.caturo.māsān.āgneyyā.āgnā.vaiṣṇavyā.vā.antarāleṣu /
ŚŚS_14.6.7: sā.eva.tatra.dīkṣā /
body.translated_text:
14.6.1: <s>Prajāpati</s>, desiring progeny, having practiced austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>. He obtained it. He sacrificed with it. Having sacrificed, he begot [progeny]. Therefore, one desiring progeny should sacrifice with it.
14.6.2: A <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> animal is the slaughter-victim for the pressing-day offering.
14.6.3: A barren cow for <s>Dyāvā-Pṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth) is the supplementary slaughter-victim — of this nature.
14.6.4: The recitation is in <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold [stoma]).
14.6.5: Or arranged in <s>tṛcas</s> (triplets).
14.6.6: Having risen from the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath), having sacrificed with the concluding <s>iṣṭi</s> (<s>udavasānīyā</s>), the sacrificer sits performing the <s>Muni-sattra</s> (sage's session) <s>iṣṭi</s> day after day for four months, with an <s>Āgneyī</s> or <s>Āgnā-Vaiṣṇavī</s> [iṣṭi] in the intermediate periods.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.7.1-1: vaiśvadevena.vai.prajāpatiḥ.prajā.asṛjata /

ŚŚS_14.7.1-10: pra.ha.vā.asya.prajā.varuṇa.pāśebhyaḥ.sarvasmāc.ca.pāpmanaḥ.sampramucyate.ya.evaṃvidvān.varuṇa.praghāsair.yajate /
ŚŚS_14.7.2: ukthyau.bhavataḥ /
ŚŚS_14.7.3: vāruṇaḥ.paśur.upālambhyaḥ.savanīyasya.pūrvasmin /
ŚŚS_14.7.4: māruta.uttarasmin /
ŚŚS_14.7.5: kāyī.vaśā.anūbandhyāyā.upālambhyā.evam.vidhā /
body.translated_text:
14.7.1-1: Through the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s> created the creatures.
14.7.1-2: Those [creatures], once created but not yet procreating, ate <s>Varuṇa</s>'s barley.
14.7.1-3: <s>Varuṇa</s> bound them with <s>Varuṇa</s>'s fetters.
14.7.1-4: Those creatures ran to <s>Prajāpati</s>, their father.
14.7.1-5: [They said:] 'Discover that sacrificial rite by which, having sacrificed, we may be freed from <s>Varuṇa</s>'s fetters and from all evil.'
14.7.1-6: Then <s>Prajāpati</s>, in the fourth month, perceived the two-night sacrificial rite — the <s>Varuṇa-praghāsa</s>.
14.7.1-7: He obtained it. He sacrificed with it.
14.7.1-8: Having sacrificed with it...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.8.1-1: tāḥ.prajāḥ.prajāpatim.abruvan.kasmai.nu.no.anna.adyāya.asṛṣṭhā.iti /

ŚŚS_14.8.10: sautrāmaṇe.ca /
ŚŚS_14.8.11: āyuṣ.kāma.yajñe.mahā.yajñe /
ŚŚS_14.8.12: vinutty.abhibhūtyoḥ /
ŚŚS_14.8.13: svarjiti /
ŚŚS_14.8.14: indra.vajre.ca /
body.translated_text:
14.8.1-1: Those creatures said to <s>Prajāpati</s>: 'For what food-eating hast thou created us?'
14.8.1-2: Then <s>Prajāpati</s>, in the fourth month, perceived the three-night sacrificial rite — the <s>Sākamedha</s>.
14.8.1-3: He obtained it.
14.8.1-4: He sacrificed with it.
14.8.1-5: Having sacrificed with it, he attained food-eating.
14.8.1-6: Therefore, one desiring food-eating should sacrifice with it.
14.8.2: [This is] an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>-<s>Ukthya</s>-<s>Atirātra</s>.
14.8.3: The first slaughter-victim for the pressing-day offering is for <s>Agni Anīkavat</s> (Agni of the vanguard).
14.8.4: The second for the <s>Maruts Sāṃtapana</s> (the scorching Maruts).
14.8.5: [The third for] <s>Mahendra</s>...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.9.1-1: tāḥ.prajāḥ.prajāpatim.abruvan.kasyai.nu.naḥ.pratiṣṭhāyā.asṛṣṭhā.iti /
ŚŚS_14.9.1-2: tata.etam.prajāpatir.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.śunāsīrīyam /
ŚŚS_14.9.1-3: tam.āharat.|.tena.ayajata /
ŚŚS_14.9.1-4: tena.iṣṭvā.pratyatiṣṭhata /
ŚŚS_14.9.1-5: tena.pratiṣṭhā.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.9.2: śunāsīrīyaḥ.paśur.upālambhyaḥ.savanīyasya /
ŚŚS_14.9.3: saurī.vaśā.anūbandhyāyā.upālambhyā.evam.vidhā /
ŚŚS_14.9.4: viṃśatim.vaiśvadeve.dadāti /
ŚŚS_14.9.5: triṃśatam.varuṇa.praghāseṣu /
ŚŚS_14.9.6: pañcāśatam.sāka.medheṣu /
ŚŚS_14.9.7: viṃśatim.śunāsīrīye /
ŚŚS_14.9.8: tad.viṃśati.śatam /
ŚŚS_14.9.9: viṃśati.śatam.vā.ṛtor.ahāni /
ŚŚS_14.9.10: tad.ṛtum.āpnoti /
ŚŚS_14.9.11: ṛtunā.saṃvatsaram /
ŚŚS_14.9.12: ye.ca.saṃvatsare.kāmāḥ /
body.translated_text:
14.9.1-1: Those creatures said to <s>Prajāpati</s>: "For what firm foundation have you created us?"
14.9.1-2: Thereupon <s>Prajāpati</s> perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Śunāsīrīya</s>.
14.9.1-3: He brought it; he sacrificed with it.
14.9.1-4: Having sacrificed with it, he gained a firm foundation.
14.9.1-5: With that, one desiring a firm foundation should sacrifice.
14.9.2: The <s>Śunāsīrīya</s> animal is to be immolated along with the <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day [animal]).
14.9.3: A barren cow belonging to <s>Sūrya</s> is to be immolated as the <s>Anūbandhyā</s> (supplementary cow) — of this very kind.
14.9.4: He gives twenty [as <s>dakṣiṇā</s>] at the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [rite].
14.9.5: Thirty at the <s>Varuṇapraghāsas</s>.
14.9.6: Fifty at the <s>Sākamedhas</s>.
14.9.7: Twenty at the <s>Śunāsīrīya</s>.
14.9.8: That makes one hundred and twenty.
14.9.9: Or one hundred and twenty [correspond to] the days of a season.
14.9.10: Thereby one attains the season.
14.9.11: Through the season, the year.
14.9.12: And whatever desires [are fulfilled] in the year.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.10.1: paśumatsu.cāturmāsyeṣu /

ŚŚS_14.10.13: pitryā.ca /

ŚŚS_14.10.15: tad.vyākhyātam.ekādaśinyā /
ŚŚS_14.10.16: ānīkavataḥ.sāṃtapano.gṛha.medhīyaḥ.krīlino.maitraś.ca.mahā.haviṣi /
ŚŚS_14.10.17: parvaṇi.parvaṇi.vā.saṃsthita.aindrāgnaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.10.18: samānam.ananyat /
ŚŚS_14.10.19: athavā.apy.eka.parvaṇy.eka.paśau.ca.aindrāgne.parāñci.havīṃṣi /
ŚŚS_14.10.20: upahūya.iḷām.pitryā /
ŚŚS_14.10.21: tryambakād.ūrdhvam.anuyāja.prabhṛti.|.manotā.ādi.paśunā.vā /
ŚŚS_14.10.22: saumikaiḥ.samāna.dakṣiṇāni.sarva.paśūni /
ŚŚS_14.10.23: cāturmāsya.paśu.dakṣiṇaiḥ.pāśukāni /
body.translated_text:
14.10.1: In the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> (four-monthly) rites that include animal [sacrifices].
14.10.2: On the first day, the animal rite.
14.10.3: On the second day, the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> animal.
14.10.4: The <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake) of the animal [sacrifice] follows the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> deity according to each seasonal junction (<s>parvan</s>).
14.10.5: The <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> [offering] belongs to the animal rite.
14.10.6: Except at the places of <s>nigama</s> (Vedic citation).
14.10.7: The <s>Vājina</s> (concluding offering) [follows] its proper place.
14.10.8: [The rite] concludes with the heart-spit.
14.10.9: [The animals] for <s>Varuṇa</s> and the <s>Maruts</s> [are offered] at the <s>Varuṇapraghāsas</s>.
14.10.10: They raise the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>) to the north.
14.10.11: [The animals] for <s>Mahendra</s> and <s>Śunāsīrā</s> [are offered] at the two later [rites].
14.10.12: The <s>iṣṭis</s> (oblations) [follow] their proper places.
14.10.13: And the ancestral [rites].
14.10.14: Or the animals [are assigned] according to the deity.
14.10.15: That has been explained in the <s>Ekādaśinī</s> (eleventh-day) [section].
14.10.16: At the <s>Mahāhavis</s> (great oblation): [the animals] of <s>Ānīkavat</s> (the one having an army), <s>Sāṃtapana</s> (the heating), <s>Gṛhamedha</s> (the household sacrifice), <s>Krīḍin</s> (the playful), and <s>Maitra</s> (belonging to <s>Mitra</s>).
14.10.17: Or at each seasonal junction, [the animal] for <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s> is established.
14.10.18: The rest is the same.
14.10.19: Or even at one junction, with one animal for <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s>, the oblations follow [in sequence].
14.10.20: Having invoked <s>Iḍā</s>, the ancestral [offering follows].
14.10.21: After the <s>Tryambaka</s> [offerings], from the <s>anuyāja</s> (after-offering) onward; or with the animal beginning from "<s>Manotā</s>."
14.10.22: All animals [have] the same <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (sacrificial fees) as the <s>Soma</s> [animals].
14.10.23: The animal rites [have] the <s>dakṣiṇās</s> of the <s>Cāturmāsya</s> animal.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.11.1: pratyavarohaṇīyaḥ.pratiṣṭhā.kāmasya /
ŚŚS_14.11.2: saṃkalpa.vikṛto.jyotiṣṭomaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.11.3: paśu.bandhaḥ.paśu.kāmasya /
ŚŚS_14.11.4: ekādaśa.stomaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.11.5: ekādaśa.akṣarā.triṣṭup /
ŚŚS_14.11.6: traiṣṭubhāḥ.paśavaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.11.7: paśūnām.eva.āptyai /
ŚŚS_14.11.8: pibā.somam.abhi.yam.ugra.tarda.etāyāma.upa.gavyanta.indram.iti.nividdhāne /
ŚŚS_14.11.9: ūrdhvam.gavyam.mahi.gṛṇāna.indra.etāyāma.upa.gavyanta.indram.iti.go.saṃstave.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
ŚŚS_14.11.10: udbhid.balabhidor.go.save.ca /
body.translated_text:
14.11.1: The <s>Pratyavarohaṇīya</s> [sacrifice] is for one desiring a firm foundation.
14.11.2: It is a modification of the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> by [specific] intention.
14.11.3: The <s>Paśubandha</s> (animal sacrifice) is for one desiring cattle.
14.11.4: [It has] the eleven-fold <s>stoma</s>.
14.11.5: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre has eleven syllables.
14.11.6: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [relates to] cattle.
14.11.7: For the very attainment of cattle.
14.11.8: [The <s>nivid</s> insertion is:] "Drink <s>Soma</s>; whom, O mighty one, you pierced" and "<s>Etāyām</s>, desiring cattle, [they approach] <s>Indra</s>."
14.11.9: "Above, desiring cattle, O <s>Indra</s>, greatly praised" and "<s>Etāyām</s>, desiring cattle, [they approach] <s>Indra</s>" — in the praise of the cow. That is the characteristic form of this day.
14.11.10: [The same applies to] the <s>Udbhid</s>, <s>Balabhid</s>, and <s>Gosava</s> [sacrifices].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.12.1: atha.ataḥ.sautrāmaṇaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.12.2a: indro.ha.āyuṣ.kāmas.tapas.tepe.|.sa.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.sautrāmaṇam.|.tam.āharat.|.tena.ayajata.|.tena.iṣṭvā.dīrgha.āyutvam.agacchat /
ŚŚS_14.12.2b: tam.u.ha.bharadvājāya.jīrṇāya.provāca.|.anena.vā.aham.iṣṭvā.dīrgha.āyutvam.agaccham.anena.api.tvam.yaja.iti.|.tena.ha.bharadvāja.iṣṭvā.sarva.āyutvam.agacchat.|.sarvam.āyur.eti.ya.evam.veda.ya.u.ca.etena.yajate /
ŚŚS_14.12.3: tasya.rathantaram.pṛṣṭham /
ŚŚS_14.12.4: agniṣṭomo.yajñaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.12.5: yathā.śraddham.dakṣiṇā /
ŚŚS_14.12.6: tatra.trīṇi.trivṛnti.stotrāṇi /
ŚŚS_14.12.7: trīṇi.pañcadaśāni /
ŚŚS_14.12.8: trīṇi.sapta.daśāni /
ŚŚS_14.12.9: trīṇy.ekaviṃśāni.iti /
ŚŚS_14.12.10: uttara.uttaritāyai /
ŚŚS_14.12.11: uttara.uttarāvad.dīrgha.āyutvam.aśravāmahā.iti /
body.translated_text:
14.12.1: Now, about the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> [sacrifice].
14.12.2a: <s>Indra</s>, desiring long life, performed austerity. Having performed austerity, he perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s>. He brought it; he sacrificed with it. Having sacrificed with it, he attained long life.
14.12.2b: He declared it to <s>Bharadvāja</s> when [<s>Bharadvāja</s>] was aged: "Having sacrificed with this, I attained long life; do you also sacrifice with this." <s>Bharadvāja</s>, having sacrificed with it, attained a full lifespan. He who knows thus attains a full lifespan, and he who sacrifices with this.
14.12.3: Its <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant) is the <s>Rathantara</s>.
14.12.4: The sacrifice is an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.
14.12.5: The <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee) is according to one's faith.
14.12.6: In that [sacrifice], three <s>stotras</s> (chants) have the nine-fold (<s>trivṛt</s>) [<s>stoma</s>].
14.12.7: Three have the fifteen-fold.
14.12.8: Three have the seventeen-fold.
14.12.9: Three have the twenty-one-fold.
14.12.10: For progressively surpassing [results].
14.12.11: "Through ever-greater [<s>stomas</s>], may we hear of long life."

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.13.1: tasya.aśvino.loho.ajaḥ.sārasvatī.meṣī.iti.paśū.upalambhyau.savanīyasya /
ŚŚS_14.13.2: indrāya.sutrāmṇe.vaśā.anūbandhyāyā.upālambhyā.evam.vidhā /
ŚŚS_14.13.3: tad.yad.evam.paśavo.niyukā.bhavanti.net.sautrāmaṇyā.ayāni.iti /
ŚŚS_14.13.4: tasya.prātaḥ.savanīyān.anu.puroḷāśān.bāhyato.agnim.upasamādhāya.surā.somena.caranti /
ŚŚS_14.13.5: tṛtīya.savanīyān.anu.puroḷāśān.sāvitram.dvādaśa.kapālam.puroḷāśam.nirvapati /
ŚŚS_14.13.8: āvapanam.vai.savanīyāḥ.puroḷāśā.āvapana.eva.tad.āvapati /
ŚŚS_14.13.9: atha.yad.indrāya.sutrāmṇe.vaśā.anūbandhyāyā.upālambhyā.bhavati.indram.vā.anu.sutrāmāṇam.sautrāmaṇī.saṃtiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_14.13.10: yā.eva.sautrāmaṇyāḥ.saṃsthā.tām.eva.tad.yajñasya.saṃsthā.karoti /
ŚŚS_14.13.11: tam.ha.eke.atirātram.kurvanti /
ŚŚS_14.13.12: eka.viṃśati.stomam.bṛhat.pṛṣṭham.ubhaya.sāmānam /
ŚŚS_14.13.13: tasya.yad.viśvajito.bṛhat.pṛṣṭhasya.śastram.tat.śastram /
ŚŚS_14.13.14: atra.havir.yajñāḥ.somāḥ.saṃtiṣṭhante /
body.translated_text:
14.13.1: For the <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day) [sacrifice], the animals to be immolated are: for the <s>Aśvins</s>, a reddish he-goat; for <s>Sarasvatī</s>, a ewe.
14.13.2: For <s>Indra Sutrāman</s> (the Good Protector), a barren cow is to be immolated as the <s>Anūbandhyā</s> — of this very kind.
14.13.3: The reason these animals are thus yoked [to the sacrifice] is so that the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> may not fail.
14.13.4: After the morning pressing <s>puroḍāśas</s>, having established a fire outside, they proceed with <s>surā</s> (liquor) and <s>Soma</s>.
14.13.5: After the third-pressing <s>puroḍāśas</s>, he prepares a <s>puroḍāśa</s> on twelve potsherds for <s>Savitṛ</s>.
14.13.8: The pressing-day <s>puroḍāśas</s> are indeed a sowing; thereby he sows a sowing.
14.13.9: Now, the reason a barren cow is to be immolated as the <s>Anūbandhyā</s> for <s>Indra Sutrāman</s> is that the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> is concluded in accordance with <s>Indra Sutrāman</s>.
14.13.10: Whatever is the conclusion of the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s>, that he makes the conclusion of the sacrifice.
14.13.11: Some make it an <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight rite).
14.13.12: Having the twenty-one-fold <s>stoma</s>, the <s>Bṛhat</s> as <s>pṛṣṭha</s>, with the <s>sāman</s> on both sides.
14.13.13: Its recitation is that of the <s>Viśvajit</s> with the <s>Bṛhat pṛṣṭha</s>.
14.13.14: Here the oblation sacrifices and the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifices] are concluded.

body.text: ŚŚS_14.14.1: devā.ha.paśu.kāmāś.caturo.māsān.vratam.caritvā.etam.udbhidam.yajña.kratum.apaśyan.|.tena.paśūn.āpuḥ.|.tena.paśu.kāmo.yajeta.|.udbhidā.iṣṭvā.yadi.manyeta.cirān.mā.paśava.āgur.iti.caturo.māsān.vratam.caritvā.balabhidā.yajeta.|.kṣipram.ha.enam.paśava.āyanti /
body.translated_text: 14.14.1: The gods, desiring cattle, having observed a vow for four months, perceived this <s>Udbhid</s> (sprouting) sacrificial rite. With it they obtained cattle. With it one desiring cattle should sacrifice. Having sacrificed with the <s>Udbhid</s>, if one thinks "My cattle are arriving slowly," having observed a vow for four months, one should sacrifice with the <s>Balabhid</s> (strength-splitting). Then cattle come to one quickly.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.15.1: go.savena.paśu.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.15.2: ṣaṭ.triṃśat.stomena /
ŚŚS_14.15.3: ṣaṭ.triṃśad.akṣarā.bṛhatī /
ŚŚS_14.15.4: bārhatāḥ.paśavaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.15.5: paśūnām.eva.āptyai /
ŚŚS_14.15.6: ṣaṭ.triṃśat.sahasrā.dakṣiṇā.gosavasya /
ŚŚS_14.15.7: ayutam.vā /
ŚŚS_14.15.8: ukthyo.yajñaḥ /
body.translated_text:
14.15.1: One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the <s>Gosava</s> (cow-gaining sacrifice).
14.15.2: With the thirty-six-fold <s>stoma</s>.
14.15.3: The <s>Bṛhatī</s> metre has thirty-six syllables.
14.15.4: Cattle [are connected with] the <s>Bṛhat</s>.
14.15.5: For the very attainment of cattle.
14.15.6: The <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee) of the <s>Gosava</s> is thirty-six thousand.
14.15.7: Or ten thousand.
14.15.8: The sacrifice is an <s>Ukthya</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.16.1: ṛta.peyena.tejas.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.16.2: dvādaśa.dīkṣā.dvādaśa.upasadaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.16.3: madhyamena.aṅguṣṭha.parvaṇā.audumbaram.camasam.mitam.ghṛtasya.vratayet /
ŚŚS_14.16.4: ayujāsu.kṣīra.odanam.dīkṣāsu /
ŚŚS_14.16.5: soma.camaso.dakṣiṇa.abhiṣutasya /
ŚŚS_14.16.8: ṛtam.satyam.vadanto.bhakṣayeyuḥ /
ŚŚS_14.16.9: janiṣṭhā.ugraḥ.sahase.turāya.kathā.mahām.avṛdhat.kasya.kasya.hotur.iti.nividdhāne /
ŚŚS_14.16.10: mandamāna.ṛtād.adhi.prajāyā.ṛtasya.hi.śurudhaḥ.santi.pūrvīr.ity.ṛtavatī.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
14.16.1: One desiring splendor should sacrifice with the <s>Ṛtapeya</s> (truth-drinking sacrifice).
14.16.2: Twelve consecrations (<s>dīkṣā</s>), twelve approach-offerings (<s>upasad</s>).
14.16.3: He should vow [to drink] ghee measured by a fig-wood cup [the size of] the middle joint of the thumb.
14.16.4: [He eats] milk-rice on the odd-numbered consecration days.
14.16.5: The <s>Soma</s> cup of the one who has pressed on the right [side].
14.16.8: They should partake [while] speaking truth and <s>ṛta</s> (cosmic order).
14.16.9: [The <s>nivid</s> insertion is:] "Born the mightiest, for strength, for the swift one" and "How the great one grew; whose <s>Hotṛ</s>?"
14.16.10: "Rejoicing from <s>ṛta</s>, from offspring of <s>ṛta</s>" and "Many are the nourishments of <s>ṛta</s>" — the <s>ṛta</s>-containing [verses]. That is the characteristic form of this day.

body.text: ŚŚS_14.17.1: prajāpatir.imam.lokam.īpsaṃs.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.bhūḥ.|.tena.iṣṭvā.imam.lokam.āpnot.|.tena.imam.lokam.īpsan.yajeta /
body.translated_text: 14.17.1: <s>Prajāpati</s>, desiring this world, having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — <s>Bhūḥ</s>. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained this world. With it, one desiring this world should sacrifice.

body.text: ŚŚS_14.18.1: prajāpatir.antarikṣa.lokam.īpsaṃs.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.bhuvaḥ.|.tena.iṣṭvā.antarikṣa.lokam.āpnot.|.tena.antarikṣa.lokam.īpsan.yajeta /
body.translated_text: 14.18.1: <s>Prajāpati</s>, desiring the atmospheric world, having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained the atmospheric world. With it, one desiring the atmospheric world should sacrifice.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.19.1: prajāpatir.amum.lokam.īpsaṃs.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.svaḥ.|.tena.iṣṭvā.amum.lokam.āpnot.|.tena.amum.lokam.īpsan.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.19.2: eka.viṃśatiḥ.śveta.aśvā.dakṣiṇā /
ŚŚS_14.19.3: vaiṣuvatam.ahaḥ /
body.translated_text:
14.19.1: <s>Prajāpati</s>, desiring the yonder world, having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — <s>Svaḥ</s>. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained the yonder world. With it, one desiring the yonder world should sacrifice.
14.19.2: Twenty-one white horses are the <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.
14.19.3: [It follows] the <s>Viṣuvat</s> (solstice) day [pattern].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.20.1: sūryo.ha.tejas.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.śukra.stomam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.teja.āpnot.|.tena.tejas.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.20.2: eka.viṃśatiḥ.śveta.aśvā.dakṣiṇā /
ŚŚS_14.20.3: vaiṣuvatam.ahaḥ /
body.translated_text:
14.20.1: <s>Sūrya</s>, desiring splendor, having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Śukrastoma</s> (bright-chant). Having sacrificed with it, he obtained splendor. With it, one desiring splendor should sacrifice.
14.20.2: Twenty-one white horses are the <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.
14.20.3: [It follows] the <s>Viṣuvat</s> day [pattern].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.21.1: tīvra.savaḥ.prajayā.paśubhis.tīvrasya.bubhūṣataḥ /
ŚŚS_14.21.2: ayam.tīvras.tīvrasud.idra.somo.vṛtrahatyāya.harivo.asya.pāhi.|.vajram.śiśāno.jaṭharam.pṛṇasva.anādhṛṣyam.vṛṣabham.tuṃram.indram.|.iti.purastān.marutvatīyasya.nividdhānasya /
ŚŚS_14.21.3: tīvrasya.abhivayasa.iti.niṣkevalye /
body.translated_text:
14.21.1: The <s>Tīvrasava</s> (intense pressing) [is for one desiring] progeny and cattle, wishing to become strong.
14.21.2: [The nivid formula:] 'ayaṃ tīvras tīvrasud indra somo vṛtrahatyāya harivo asya pāhi | vajraṃ śiśāno jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva anādhṛṣyam vṛṣabhaṃ tuṃram indram' (This intense Soma, O <s>Indra</s>, pressed intensely, drink of it for the slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s>, O lord of bay horses; sharpening thy thunderbolt, fill thy belly — [to] the unassailable, mighty, powerful <s>Indra</s>) — [this is inserted] before the <s>Marutvatīya</s> [recitation] with its <s>nivid</s>.
14.21.3: 'tīvrasya abhivayasaḥ' (Of the intense one, of vigorous strength) — in the <s>Niṣkevalya</s> [recitation].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.22.1: jyotiḥ.sūta.savaḥ /

ŚŚS_14.22.12: dhānvanāny.upaśerate /
ŚŚS_14.22.13: śaramayam.barhiḥ /
ŚŚS_14.22.14: bādhaka.idhmaḥ.paridhayaś.ca /
ŚŚS_14.22.15: vaibhīdako.yūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.22.16: upatāpinīnām.gavām.ājyam /
ŚŚS_14.22.17: anustaraṇyā.goś.carma.adhiṣavaṇam /
ŚŚS_14.22.18: śavanabhye.adhiṣavaṇa.phalake /
ŚŚS_14.22.19: śava.caṃvām.āpaḥ.saṃsrutās.tābhir.vasatīvarīḥ.pṛñcanti /
ŚŚS_14.22.20: upota.paruṣā.adhijya.dhanvāno.lihita.uṣṇīṣā.asi.baddhāḥ.pracareyuḥ /
ŚŚS_14.22.21: na.ha.etam.kaścana.īśīta.iyat.so.advādaśa.aham.jīvet /
ŚŚS_14.22.22: na.ha.via.tam.kaścana.stṛṇute.ya.etaiḥ.pratyabhicarati /
ŚŚS_14.22.23: sadaḥ.pāpmānam.dviṣataś.ca.apajighāṃsamānasya /
ŚŚS_14.22.24: upottamāś.ca.śastrāṇām.utsṛjyante /
ŚŚS_14.22.25: upasadaḥ.prajā.kāmasya.paśu.kāmasya.ca /
ŚŚS_14.22.26: upottamāś.ca.śastrāṇām.upajāyante /
body.translated_text:
14.22.1: The <s>Jyotiḥsūta</s> pressing (Light-begotten).
14.22.2: The <s>Gausthapati</s> pressing (Cow-householder).
14.22.3: The <s>Āyurgrāmaṇī</s> pressing (Life-chieftain).
14.22.4: The <s>Saṃdaṃśa</s> (Pincer), <s>Anustoma</s> (Following-praise), <s>Iṣu</s> (Arrow), <s>Vajra</s> (Thunderbolt), <s>Śyena</s> (Hawk), <s>Ajira</s> (Swift), <s>Mṛtyuntaka</s> (Death-ender), <s>Kṣurapavi</s> (Razor-edge), <s>Śīrṣacchida</s> (Head-splitter), <s>Mahaśśyena</s> (Great Hawk) — and the sorcery-sacrifice (<s>abhicāra</s>).
14.22.5: [The recitation uses] the two <s>Manyu-sūktas</s> (Wrath-hymns) with their <s>nivid</s>, arranged by characteristic mark.
14.22.6: Whatever <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant) they use in sorcery — that archetypal <s>pṛṣṭha</s> [is employed] against the one being cursed.
14.22.7: In the <s>Iṣu</s> (Arrow [sacrifice]), the <s>Bṛhad-Brahma-Sāma</s> [chant].
14.22.8: The <s>Abhīvarta</s> [chant] in the others.
14.22.9: The <s>sadas</s> (assembly hall) is covered with pointed [grass].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.23.1: deva.asurāḥ.samayatanta.|.te.devā.bṛhaspatim.purohitam.upādhāvann.upa.tam.yajña.kratum.jānīhi.yena.iṣṭvā.asurān.abhibhavemahi.iti.|.sa.etam.ṛṣabham.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.|.tena.iṣṭvā.asurāna.abhyabhavat.|.tena.dviṣato.bhrātṛvyān.abhibubhūṣan.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.23.2: pañcadaśa.stomasya.saptadaśo.mādhyaṃdinaḥ.pavamānas.tad.asya.ṛṣabha.rūpam /
ŚŚS_14.23.3: pibā.somam.abhi.yam.ugra.tardas.tam.u.ṣṭuhi.yo.abhibūty.ojā.iti.nividdhāne /
ŚŚS_14.23.4: yaḥ.śipravān.vṛṣabho.yo.matīnām.gīrbhir.vardha.vṛṣabham.carṣaṇīnām.ity.ṛṣabhavatī.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
14.23.1: The gods and <s>Asuras</s> were in conflict. The gods ran to <s>Bṛhaspati</s> as their family priest [saying]: 'Discover that sacrificial rite by which, having sacrificed, we may overcome the <s>Asuras</s>.' He perceived this <s>Ṛṣabha</s> (Bull) sacrificial rite. Having sacrificed with it, [the gods] overcame the <s>Asuras</s>. Therefore, one wishing to overcome hostile rivals should sacrifice with it.
14.23.2: Of the fifteen-fold <s>stoma</s>, the midday <s>Pavamāna</s> is seventeen-fold — that is its bull-like form.
14.23.3: 'pibā somam abhi yam ugra tardaḥ' (Drink the Soma by which, O mighty one, thou hast burst forth) and 'tam u ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūty ojāḥ' (Praise him who is victorious in power) — [these are recited] with the <s>nivid</s>.
14.23.4: 'yaḥ śipravān vṛṣabho yo matīnāṃ gīrbhir vardha' (He who has the jaw-guard, the bull, who grows by thoughts and songs)...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.24.1: sūryo.ha.tejas.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.vyomānam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.teja.āpnot.|.tena.tejas.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.24.2: saptadaśa.stomasya.ekaviṃśa.ārbhavaḥ.pavamānaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.24.3: ekaviṃśo.vā.eṣa.ya.eṣa.tapati.tad.enam.svena.rūpeṇa.samardhayati /
ŚŚS_14.24.4: imā.u.tvā.purutamasya.indram.stava.iti.nividdhāne /
ŚŚS_14.24.24: sūryeṇa.vayunavac.cakāra.sa.sūryaḥ.pary.urū.varāṃsi.iti.sūrya.abhivyāhāre.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
14.24.1: <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun), desiring radiance, having practiced austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Vyomāna</s> (Soaring). Having sacrificed with it, he attained radiance. Therefore, one desiring radiance should sacrifice with it.
14.24.2: Of the seventeen-fold <s>stoma</s>, the <s>Ārbhava</s> <s>Pavamāna</s> is twenty-one-fold.
14.24.3: This sun that shines is indeed the twenty-one-fold; thus he endows [the sacrificer] with his own form.
14.24.4: 'imā u tvā purutamasya' (These for thee, O most manifold) and 'indraṃ stava' (Praise Indra) — [recited] with the <s>nivid</s>.
14.24.24: 'sūryeṇa vayunavac cakāra' (He made [it] discernible through the sun) and 'sa sūryaḥ pary urū varāṃsi' (That sun [encompasses] the broad spaces) — at the mention of the sun — that is the form of this [sacrifice] day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.25.1: vasiṣṭho.ha.anna.adya.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.virājam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.anna.adyam.āpnot.|.tena.anna.adya.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.25.2: pañcadaśau.pūrvau.pavamānau.trivṛnti.itarāṇi /
ŚŚS_14.25.3: sa.virājam.abhisampadyate /
ŚŚS_14.25.4: śrīr.virāḷ.anna.adyam.śriyo.virājo.anna.adyasya.upāptyai /
ŚŚS_14.25.5: mahaścit.tvam.indra.yata.etāṃs.tvam.rāja.indra.ye.ca.devā.ity.akṣara.vairāje.nividdhāne.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
14.25.1: <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, desiring food-eating, having practiced austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Virāja</s> (Sovereign). Having sacrificed with it, he attained food-eating. Therefore, one desiring food-eating should sacrifice with it.
14.25.2: The first two <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants] are in fifteen-fold [stoma]; the rest in nine-fold.
14.25.3: He attains the <s>Virāj</s> (sovereign meter).
14.25.4: <s>Śrī</s> (prosperity) is the <s>Virāj</s>; food-eating [comes from] prosperity — for the attainment of the <s>Virāj</s> and food-eating.
14.25.5: 'mahaścit tvam indra' (Even the great, thou O Indra), 'yata etāṃs tvam rāja indra ye ca devāḥ' (Since thou, King Indra, and those gods) — [recited] in the syllabic <s>Vairāja</s> [form] with the <s>nivid</s> — that is the form of this [sacrifice] day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.26.1: indro.ha.svārājya.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.svarājam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.svārājyam.āpnot.|.tena.svārājya.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.26.2: saptadaśau.pūrvau.pavamānau.trivṛnti.itarāni /
ŚŚS_14.26.3: tāś.catasraḥ.stotriyā.virājam.atiyanti /
ŚŚS_14.26.4: tābhiḥ.svārājyam.āpnoti /
ŚŚS_14.26.5: akṣara.vairāje.ca /
body.translated_text:
14.26.1: <s>Indra</s>, desiring sovereignty, having practiced austerity, perceived this sacrificial rite — the <s>Svarāja</s> (Self-sovereign). Having sacrificed with it, he attained sovereignty. Therefore, one desiring sovereignty should sacrifice with it.
14.26.2: The first two <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants] are in seventeen-fold [stoma]; the rest in nine-fold.
14.26.3: Those four <s>stotriya</s> [verses] surpass the <s>Virāj</s>.
14.26.4: Through them, one attains sovereignty.
14.26.5: And in the syllabic <s>Vairāja</s> [form].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.27.1: uśanā.ha.kāvyo.asurāṇām.purohita.āsa.|.sa.ha.devānām.annam.aśitvā.paridadre.|.sa.ha.aikṣata.|.katham.nu.tena.yajña.kratunā.yajeyam.yena.iṣṭvā.pāpmānam.apahanyām.iti.|.sa.etam.uśana.stomam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.|.tena.iṣṭvā.pāpmānam.apāhata.|.tena.pāpmānam.apajighāṃsamāno.yajeta /

ŚŚS_14.27.13: uśanā.yat.sahasrair.ayātam.varivasyann.uśane.kāvyāya.ity.uśanavatī.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
14.27.1: <s>Uśanas Kāvya</s> was the family priest of the <s>Asuras</s>. Having eaten the food of the gods, he was disgraced. He considered: 'By what sacrificial rite should I sacrifice, so that having sacrificed, I may remove sin?' He perceived the <s>Uśanastoma</s> (Uśanas-praise) sacrificial rite. Having sacrificed with it, he removed sin. Therefore, one wishing to remove sin should sacrifice with it.
14.27.2: And [one suffering from] abdominal disease.
14.27.3: The morning pressing is in <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold [stoma]).
14.27.4: <s>Brahman</s> (sacred power) is indeed the <s>Trivṛt</s>.
14.27.5: Through the <s>Trivṛt</s>, through sacred power, he removes sin from the front.
14.27.6: The midday [pressing is in] <s>Ṣaḍaśa</s> (sixteen-fold [stoma]).

ŚŚS_14.28.1: sa.ha.aikṣata.|.pāpmānam.apahatya.katham.nu.tena.yajña.kratunā.yajeyam.yena.iṣṭvā.anna.adyam.āpnuyām.iti.|.sa.etam.uttaram.uśana.stomam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.|.tena.iṣṭvā.anna.adyam.āpnoti.|.tena.anna.adya.kāmo.yajeta /

ŚŚS_14.28.9: tathā.eva.etad.yajamānas.trivṛtā.eva.tad.brahmaṇā.ubhayato.anna.adyam.parigṛhya.ātman.dhatte /
ŚŚS_14.28.10: uśanavatī.ca /
ŚŚS_14.28.11: vividhaś.ca.evam.stomo.anna.adya.kāmasya /
ŚŚS_14.28.12: akṣara.vairāje.ca /
ŚŚS_14.28.13: sahasram.śata.aśvam.dakṣiṇā /
body.translated_text:
14.28.1: He considered: 'Having removed sin, by what sacrificial rite should I sacrifice, so that having sacrificed, I may attain food-eating?' He perceived this second <s>Uśanastoma</s> sacrificial rite. Having sacrificed with it, one attains food-eating. Therefore, one desiring food-eating should sacrifice with it.
14.28.2: The morning pressing is in <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold).
14.28.3: <s>Brahman</s> is indeed the <s>Trivṛt</s>.
14.28.4: The midday [pressing is in] <s>Ṣaḍaśa</s> (sixteen-fold).
14.28.5: That is the <s>Virāj</s>; [and from the Virāj comes] food-eating.
14.28.6: The third pressing is in <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold).
14.28.7: <s>Brahman</s> is indeed the <s>Trivṛt</s>.
14.28.8: Through the <s>Trivṛt</s>, through sacred power on both sides, food-eating...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.29.1: indra.agnī.vai.deveṣv.aham.śreyase.vivadeyātām.|.te.devā.ūcuḥ.|.yadi.vā.imāv.evam.vivadiṣyete.abhi.no.asurā.bhaviṣyanti.|.upa.tam.yajña.kratum.jānīma.yena.enau.saṃśamayemahi.iti.|.ta.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyann.indra.agnyoḥ.kulāyam.|.tena.enau.samaśamayan /
ŚŚS_14.29.2: tena.brāhmaṇaś.ca.kṣatriyaś.ca.samyajeyātām.yam.puro.dhāsyamānaḥ.syāt /
ŚŚS_14.29.3: brahma.kṣatre.eva.tat.tanvau.saṃsṛjete /
ŚŚS_14.29.4: trivṛt.pañcadaśau.stomau /
ŚŚS_14.29.5: agnir.vai.trivṛd.indraḥ.pañcadaśaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.29.6: indra.agnī.eva.tat.tanvau.samasṛjatām /
ŚŚS_14.29.7: tiṣṭhā.harī.tam.u.ṣṭuhi.iti.nividdhāne /
ŚŚS_14.29.8: agneḥ.piba.jihvayā.somam.indra.agnir.na.śuṣkam.vanam.indra.hetir.ity.aindre.agnimatī.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
14.29.1: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> were quarreling among the gods about who was greater. The gods said: 'If these two continue quarreling thus, the <s>Asuras</s> will overcome us. Let us discover that sacrificial rite by which we may pacify them.' They perceived the sacrificial rite — the <s>Kulāya</s> (Nest) of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>. With that they pacified them.
14.29.2: With it, a brahmin and a warrior should sacrifice together — when one is about to be appointed as family priest (<s>purohita</s>).
14.29.3: In that, the brahmin and warrior classes join their bodies.
14.29.4: The <s>stomas</s> are <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold) and <s>Pañcadaśa</s> (fifteen-fold).
14.29.5: <s>Agni</s> is indeed the <s>Trivṛt</s>; <s>Indra</s> is the <s>Pañcadaśa</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.30.1: mitrā.varuṇayor.vai.vairājyam.anyatara.aicchat.svārājyam.anyataraḥ.|.tāv.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyatām.virāṭ.svarājam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.vairājyam.anyatara.āpnot.svārājyam.anyataraḥ /
ŚŚS_14.30.2: akṣara.vairāje.ca /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.30.1: Of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> — one desired sovereign rule (<s>vairājya</s>), the other desired self-rule (<s>svārājya</s>). They perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Virāṭ-svarāja</s>. Having sacrificed with it, one obtained sovereign rule and the other obtained self-rule.
ŚŚS 14.30.2: And [this applies] in the <s>Akṣara-vairāja</s> [sacrifice].

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.31.1: jyeṣṭha.stomaḥ.kaniṣṭha.kulīnasya.jyaiṣṭhyam.kāmayamānasya /
ŚŚS_14.31.2: saptadaśo.bahiṣ.pavamānaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.31.3: eṣa.vai.stomānām.jyeṣṭhaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.31.4: tam.eva.tad.yajña.mukhe.yunakti /
ŚŚS_14.31.5: janiṣṭhā.ugraḥ.sahasre.turāya.pra.vaḥ.satām.jyeṣṭhatamāya.suṣṭutim.iti.jyeṣṭha.abhivyāhāre.nividdhāne.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.31.1: The <s>Jyeṣṭha-stoma</s> (eldest chant-type) [is for] one of the youngest lineage who desires seniority.
ŚŚS 14.31.2: The seventeen-fold [chant] is the external <s>Pavamāna</s>.
ŚŚS 14.31.3: This indeed is the eldest of the <s>stomas</s>.
ŚŚS 14.31.4: He yokes that very one at the mouth (beginning) of the sacrifice.
ŚŚS 14.31.5: 'The most newly born, the fierce one, for overcoming thousands' [and] 'For you, the most excellent of the virtuous, [I offer] a well-spoken praise' — the <s>nivid</s> is placed where there is mention of 'eldest' — that is the distinguishing feature of this [sacrificial] day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.32.1: deva.asurāḥ.samayanta.|.te.devā.bṛhaspatim.purohitam.upādhāvan.|.upa.tam.yajña.kratum.jānīhi.yena.iṣṭvā.asurā.na.anvaveyur.iti.|.sa.etam.durāśam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.|.tena.iṣṭvā.asurā.na.anvavāyan.|.tato.vai.devā.abhavan.parā.asurāḥ.|.bhavaty.ātmanā.parā.asya.dveṣyo.ya.evam.veda /
ŚŚS_14.32.2: apara.pakṣe.sauri.iṣṭiḥ.pūrva.ahṇe /
ŚŚS_14.32.3: cāndramasī.sāyam /
ŚŚS_14.32.4: vidhum.dadrāṇam.navo.navaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.32.5: sauvarṇaḥ.śata.valo.dakṣiṇā.pūrvasyām /
ŚŚS_14.32.6: rājata.uttarasyām /
ŚŚS_14.32.7: bhāradvājam.pṛṣṭham /
ŚŚS_14.32.8: tathā.sūkte /
ŚŚS_14.32.9: stotre.stotre.stute.triṃśatam.triṃśatma.śata.valān.dadāti /
ŚŚS_14.32.10: yāvad.vā.yajamāno.hiraṇyasya.icchet /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.32.1: The gods and <s>Asuras</s> were in conflict. The gods approached <s>Bṛhaspati</s> [as their] <s>purohita</s> (chief priest): 'Find that sacrificial design by which, having sacrificed, the <s>Asuras</s> will not follow us.' He perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Durāśa</s> (hard-to-reach). Having sacrificed with it, the <s>Asuras</s> did not follow [them]. Then indeed the gods prospered, and the <s>Asuras</s> were defeated. He who knows thus prospers by himself, and his enemy is defeated.
ŚŚS 14.32.2: In the dark fortnight, the <s>Sauri-iṣṭi</s> (solar offering) [is performed] in the forenoon.
ŚŚS 14.32.3: The lunar [offering] in the evening.
ŚŚS 14.32.4: 'The one who upholds the firmament, ever new.'
ŚŚS 14.32.5: A golden ornament of a hundred [shapes] is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> in the first [offering].
ŚŚS 14.32.6: A silver [ornament] in the latter.
ŚŚS 14.32.7: The <s>Bhāradvāja</s> [hymn] is the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant).
ŚŚS 14.32.8: Likewise in the hymns.
ŚŚS 14.32.9: At each chanting, when it is chanted, he gives thirty ornaments of a hundred [shapes].
ŚŚS 14.32.10: Or as much gold as the sacrificer desires.

ŚŚS_14.33.20: aśva.rathaḥ.khāḍga.kavaco.vaiyāghra.paricchada.ārkṣa.upāsaṅgo.dvaipa.dhanvadhiḥ.śyāva.aśvo.dakṣiṇā /

ŚŚS_14.33.22: indra.somam.soma.pata.indram.stava.iti.nividdhāne.indra.abhivyāhāre.|.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.33.1: <s>Indra</s>, desiring reverence (<s>apaciti</s>), having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Apaciti</s>. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained reverence. Therefore, one who desires reverence should sacrifice with it.
ŚŚS 14.33.2: The twenty-four-fold [stomas] are the first two <s>Pavamānas</s>.
ŚŚS 14.33.3: The ninefold and fifteen-fold [are] the <s>ājya</s> [hymns].
ŚŚS 14.33.4: The seventeen-fold and twenty-one-fold [are] the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chants).
ŚŚS 14.33.5: The twenty-seven-fold [is] the <s>Ārbhava</s> [chant]...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.34.1: sūryo.ha.tviṣi.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.tviṣim.|.tena.iṣṭvā.tviṣim.āpnot.|.tena.tviṣi.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.34.2: aśva.rathaḥ.kāṃsya.kavacaḥ.śveta.aśvo.dakṣiṇā /
ŚŚS_14.34.3: tviṣimatā.rūpeṇa.tviṣim.āpnavāni.iti /
ŚŚS_14.34.4: sūrya.abhivyāhāre.nividdhāne.|.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.34.1: <s>Sūrya</s> (the sun), desiring radiance (<s>tviṣi</s>), having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Tviṣi</s>. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained radiance. Therefore, one who desires radiance should sacrifice with it.
ŚŚS 14.34.2: A horse with a chariot, wearing a bronze armor, with a white horse — [this is] the <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.
ŚŚS 14.34.3: 'By the radiant form, may I obtain radiance.'
ŚŚS 14.34.4: The <s>nivid</s> is placed where there is mention of <s>Sūrya</s> — that is the distinguishing feature of this day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.35.1: varuṇo.ha.vṛṣṭi.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.vṛṣṭim.|.tena.iṣṭvā.vṛṣṭim.āpnot.|.tena.vṛṣṭi.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.35.2: ud.vām.cakṣur.varuṇa.supratīkam.indrā.varuṇā.yuvam.adhvarāya.na.iti.indrā.varuṇa.abhivyāhāre.nividdhāne.|.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.35.1: <s>Varuṇa</s>, desiring rain (<s>vṛṣṭi</s>), having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Vṛṣṭi</s>. Having sacrificed with it, he obtained rain. Therefore, one who desires rain should sacrifice with it.
ŚŚS 14.35.2: 'Upward [rises] your eye, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, fair-faced' [and] 'O <s>Indra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s>, you two for the sacrifice' — the <s>nivid</s> is placed where there is mention of <s>Indra</s>-<s>Varuṇa</s> — that is the distinguishing feature of this day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.36.1: bhānumatī.ha.tejas.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyad.ādityam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.teja.āpnot.|.tena.tejas.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.36.2: yam.vai.sūryam.svar.bhānuḥ.svar.bhānor.adha.yad.ity.āditya.abhivyāhāre.nividdhāne.|.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.36.1: <s>Bhānumatī</s> (the radiant one), desiring splendor (<s>tejas</s>), having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Āditya</s> [sacrifice]. Having sacrificed with it, she obtained splendor. Therefore, one who desires splendor should sacrifice with it.
ŚŚS 14.36.2: 'The sun whom <s>Svarbhānu</s> [obscured]' [and] 'From beneath <s>Svarbhānu</s>' — the <s>nivid</s> is placed where there is mention of <s>Āditya</s> — that is the distinguishing feature of this day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.37.1: indrā.viṣṇur.ha.svarga.kāmas.tapas.taptvā.etam.yajña.kratum.apaśyat.svargam.|.tena.iṣṭvā.svargam.āpnot.|.tena.svarga.kāmo.yajeta /
ŚŚS_14.37.2: indra.abhivyāhāre.nividdhāne.|.tad.etasya.ahno.rūpam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.37.1: <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, desiring heaven (<s>svarga</s>), having performed austerity, perceived this sacrificial design — the <s>Svarga</s>. Having sacrificed with it, they obtained heaven. Therefore, one who desires heaven should sacrifice with it.
ŚŚS 14.37.2: The <s>nivid</s> is placed where there is mention of <s>Indra</s> — that is the distinguishing feature of this day.

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.38.1: deva.asurāḥ.samayatanta.|.te.devā.bṛhaspatim.purohitam.upādhāvan.|.upa.tau.yajña.kratū.jānīhi.yābhyām.iṣṭvā.asurān.vinuttyā.abhibhavemahi.iti.|.sa.etau.yajña.kratū.apaśyad.vinutty.abhibhūtī.|.tān.vinuttinā.vinuttyā.abhibhūtinā.abhyabhavan /

ŚŚS_14.38.5: atha.abhibhūteḥ.ṣaḷ.ūrdhvāḥ.pṛṣṭhya.stomāḥ.ṣaḷ.āvṛttāḥ.samyañcaḥ.stomāḥ /
ŚŚS_14.38.6: samyañco.vai.bhūtvā.abhibhavanti.iti /
ŚŚS_14.38.7: tad.abhibhūte.rūpam /
ŚŚS_14.38.8: yad.viśvajito.bṛhat.pṛṣṭhasya.tad.enayoḥ.śastram /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.38.1: The gods and <s>Asuras</s> were in conflict. The gods approached <s>Bṛhaspati</s> [as their] <s>purohita</s>: 'Find those two sacrificial designs by which, having sacrificed, we may defeat the <s>Asuras</s> by driving [them] away and by overpowering [them].' He perceived those two sacrificial designs — the <s>Vinuṭṭi</s> (driving away) and the <s>Abhibhūti</s> (overpowering). They overcame them by the <s>Vinuṭṭi</s>, driving [them] away, and by the <s>Abhibhūti</s>, overpowering [them].
ŚŚS 14.38.2: Of the <s>Vinuṭṭi</s>, the six ascending <s>pṛṣṭhya</s> [stomas]...

body.text:
ŚŚS_14.39.1: rāśi.marāyāv.anna.adya.kāmasya /
ŚŚS_14.39.2: uttamau.chandomau.samūḷhāt /
ŚŚS_14.39.3: strīṇām.gavām.sahasram.dakṣiṇe.dadāti /
ŚŚS_14.39.4: puṃsām.uttare /

ŚŚS_14.39.7: yamāv.anūcīna.garbhau.vā.samyajeyātām /
ŚŚS_14.39.8: vighanaḥ.pāpmānam.dviṣataś.ca.apajighāṃsamānasya /
ŚŚS_14.39.9: kayā.śubhīya.tad.id.āsīye.vā.nividdhāne /
ŚŚS_14.39.10: bhrātṛvyam.dviṣataś.ca.apajighāṃsamānasya /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.39.1: The <s>Rāśi-marāya</s> (heap-killing) [sacrifices are for] one who desires food.
ŚŚS 14.39.2: The last two <s>chandomas</s> are from the combined [arrangement].
ŚŚS 14.39.3: He gives a thousand female cows as the <s>dakṣiṇā</s>.
ŚŚS 14.39.4: Of males, in the latter [offering].
ŚŚS 14.39.5: The continuous [rites are] the consecration (<s>dīkṣā</s>) and the <s>Upasad</s> rites.
ŚŚS 14.39.6: Likewise the concluding (<s>udayanīya</s>) [rites].
ŚŚS 14.39.7: Twins or those born in succession may sacrifice together.

ŚŚS_14.40.22: āśvinī.vaśā.anūbandhyāyāḥ.sthāne /

body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.40.1a: The <s>Ādityas</s> and the <s>Aṅgirases</s> competed: 'We shall reach the heavenly world first,' said the <s>Ādityas</s>; 'We [shall],' said the <s>Aṅgirases</s>. The <s>Aṅgirases</s> said to the <s>Ādityas</s>: 'Tomorrow at the pressing, perform the sacrifice for us.' <s>Agni</s> was their messenger.
ŚŚS 14.40.1b: The <s>Ādityas</s> said: 'If these [Aṅgirases] sacrifice first, they will reach the heavenly world first. The <s>Asuras</s> will prevail over us. Let us discover that sacrificial plan by which we may sacrifice first.'
ŚŚS 14.40.1c: They perceived this <s>Sādyaḥkra</s> (same-day) sacrificial plan. Having sacrificed with it, they went first to the heavenly world. With it, one desiring heaven should sacrifice.
ŚŚS 14.40.2: The <s>stoma</s> (chant-form) is the <s>Trivṛt</s> (ninefold).
ŚŚS 14.40.3: The <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant) is the <s>Rathantara</s>.
ŚŚS 14.40.4: The recitation (<s>śastra</s>) is arranged in <s>tṛca</s>s (triads).
ŚŚS 14.40.5: The sacrifice is an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.
ŚŚS 14.40.6: The <s>vedi</s> (altar) is [made in] a field of barley.
ŚŚS 14.40.7: The <s>uttaravedi</s> (high altar) is a barley threshing floor.
ŚŚS 14.40.8: The <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post) is a plowshare.
ŚŚS 14.40.9: The <s>caṣāla</s> (capital of the post) is a bundle of barley.
ŚŚS 14.40.10: The <s>vasatīvarī</s> (overnight water) [is brought] from the family of one who has already sacrificed.
ŚŚS 14.40.11: Curds are carried in leather bags.
ŚŚS 14.40.12: From that, whatever clarified butter rises — with that they proceed.
ŚŚS 14.40.13: A horse-chariot is the <s>Soma</s> conveyance.
ŚŚS 14.40.14: [The Soma seller is found] at most a <s>yojana</s> (league) away.
ŚŚS 14.40.15: A horse is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
ŚŚS 14.40.16: The <s>dīkṣaṇīyā</s> (consecration offering) [takes place] in the forenoon.
ŚŚS 14.40.17: The ritual acts follow in immediate succession.
ŚŚS 14.40.18: The <s>Pravargya</s> (hot-milk rite) is omitted in its substance.
ŚŚS 14.40.19: There are three <s>Upasad</s> [offerings] in reverse order.
ŚŚS 14.40.20: The <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) is the <s>Agnīṣomīya</s> [offering].
ŚŚS 14.40.21: At the time of the <s>savanīya</s> (pressing), the animals [are offered] in a connected sequence.
ŚŚS 14.40.22: A barren cow dedicated to the <s>Aśvins</s> [takes] the place of the <s>Anūbandhyā</s> [cow].
ŚŚS 14.40.23: Or he should sacrifice with a <s>Maitrāvaruṇī</s> milk offering.
ŚŚS 14.40.24: Or else, they sought what had been done before.

ŚŚS_14.41.1: eṣā.eva.uttarasya.vidhā /
ŚŚS_14.41.2: stomā.eva.anyathā /

ŚŚS_14.41.5: yo.agiṣṭome.kāmo.ya.ukthye.tayor.ubhayor.āptyai /

ŚŚS_14.41.7: go.dhūmam.akhalaḥ /
ŚŚS_14.41.8: go.dhūma.kalāpiś.caṣālam /

ŚŚS_14.41.11: traipade.antataḥ /
ŚŚS_14.41.12: vaḍavā.dakṣiṇā /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 14.41.1: The same procedure applies to the next [sacrifice].
ŚŚS 14.41.2: Only the <s>stomas</s> (chant-forms) are different.
ŚŚS 14.41.3: The <s>Pavamāna</s> [chants] are <s>aṣṭādaśa</s> (eighteenfold); the rest are <s>trivṛt</s> (ninefold).
ŚŚS 14.41.4: This is a contracted <s>Ukthya</s> [sacrifice].
ŚŚS 14.41.5: For the attainment of both desires — that which one has in the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> and that in the <s>Ukthya</s>.
ŚŚS 14.41.6: The <s>vedi</s> (altar) is a field of <s>godhūma</s> (wheat).
ŚŚS 14.41.7: The threshing floor is of wheat.
ŚŚS 14.41.8: The <s>caṣāla</s> (capital of the post) is a bundle of wheat.
ŚŚS 14.41.9: Water in a pot serves as the <s>vasatīvarī</s> (overnight water).
ŚŚS 14.41.10: A horse is the <s>Soma</s> conveyance.
ŚŚS 14.41.11: [The Soma seller is found] at most a <s>tripada</s> (three steps) away.
ŚŚS 14.41.12: A mare is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
