body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 16.29.1: Now that which is tenfold — that [is attained] by the ten-night [session] (<s>Daśarātra</s>).
ŚŚS 16.29.2: The <s>Virāj</s> meter has ten syllables; <s>Virāj</s> is food. Whatever is tenfold, whether cosmological or pertaining to the self — all that one attains by this.
ŚŚS 16.29.3: [It consists of] one and a half <s>Abhiplava</s> [sets], or nine <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>s.
ŚŚS 16.29.4: The <s>Daśarātra</s> is a variant of the concluding form (<s>saṃsthā</s>).
ŚŚS 16.29.5: And [with] the <s>Vaiśvānara</s> [day].
ŚŚS 16.29.6: Having sacrificed with this, <s>Jala Jātūkarṇya</s> attained the position of chief priest (<s>purodhā</s>) for three kings of the <s>Nigustha</s> [dynasty] — [those] of <s>Kāśī</s>, <s>Videha</s>, and <s>Kauśala</s>.
ŚŚS 16.29.7: <s>Śvetaketu</s>, seeing his glory, reproached his father: 'You gave instruction to those desiring sacrifice, or those whom you wished to enrich with glory and fame — [saying] "thus is our self."'
ŚŚS 16.29.8: He [the father] said to him: 'Do not speak to me thus, son. The sacrificial plan became known to me. You have sought to inquire about it from an inferior knower of <s>Brahman</s>.'
ŚŚS 16.29.9: And indeed it was just as he had told him.
ŚŚS 16.29.10: This is the sacrifice for one desiring the position of chief priest.
ŚŚS 16.29.11: He attains the position of chief priest — one who knows thus.
ŚŚS 16.29.12: The <s>Trikakud</s> (three-peaked) recitation is derived from the <s>Catuṣṭoma</s> (four-stoma) [arrangement].
ŚŚS 16.29.13: And the <s>Mahā-trikakud</s> (great three-peaked).
ŚŚS 16.29.14: And the <s>Chandoma-trikakud</s>.
ŚŚS 16.29.15: [The days are:] <s>Agniṣṭut</s>, <s>Indrastut</s>, <s>Vaiśvadevastut</s>, the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [day], and the <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.
ŚŚS 16.29.16: Six days, the <s>Abhijit</s> and <s>Aśvajit</s> [days], the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, and the <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.
ŚŚS 16.29.17: A standard <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> as the ninth or eighth [day]; the <s>Viśvajit</s> as the tenth.
ŚŚS 16.29.18: That which is tenfold — that one attains by the ten-night [session].

body.text:
ŚŚS_16.30.1: atha.yad.ekādaśavidham.tad.ekādaśa.rātreṇa /
ŚŚS_16.30.2: ekādaśa.akṣarā.triṣṭup.traiṣṭubhāḥ.paśavas.tad.yat.kim.ca.ekādaśavidham.adhidaivatam.adhyātmam.tat.sarvam.enena.āpnoti /
ŚŚS_16.30.3: vyūḷha.chandā.daśarātraḥ /
ŚŚS_16.30.7: viśvajid.ekādaśaḥ /
ŚŚS_16.30.8: tam.pauṇḍarīka.ity.ācakṣate /
ŚŚS_16.30.9: ayutam.dakṣiṇā /
ŚŚS_16.30.10: aśva.sahasram.ekādaśam.ity.eke /
ŚŚS_16.30.11: ukto.dvādaśāhaḥ /
ŚŚS_16.30.12: ta.ete.purastād.agniṣṭomā.upariṣṭād.atirātrā.uttara.uttariṇa.eka.uttarā.ahīnāḥ /
ŚŚS_16.30.13: uttara.uttariṇīm.eva.tat.śriyam.virājam.anna.adyam.āpnoti.ya.evam.veda.ya.evam.veda /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 16.30.1: Now that which is elevenfold — that [is attained] by the eleven-night [session].
ŚŚS 16.30.2: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter has eleven syllables; animals are <s>traiṣṭubha</s> (of the Triṣṭubh). Whatever is elevenfold, whether cosmological or pertaining to the self — all that one attains by this.
ŚŚS 16.30.3: [It is] a <s>Daśarātra</s> with extended meters.
ŚŚS 16.30.7: The <s>Viśvajit</s> is the eleventh [day].
ŚŚS 16.30.8: They call it the <s>Puṇḍarīka</s> (lotus) [sacrifice].
ŚŚS 16.30.9: Ten thousand is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
ŚŚS 16.30.10: A thousand horses as the eleventh [fee] — [say] some.
ŚŚS 16.30.11: The twelve-day [session] has been described.
ŚŚS 16.30.12: These [sessions], having <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>s at the beginning and <s>Atirātra</s>s at the end, are <s>ahīna</s>s (multi-day rites) that progressively increase, each surpassing the previous, each one greater by one [day].
ŚŚS 16.30.13: One who knows thus attains ever-increasing glory, <s>Virāj</s>, and food to eat — one who knows thus.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.1.1: atha.ato.mahā.vratasya /
ŚŚS_17.1.2: purastād.eva.katipaya.ahena.hotā.preṅkha.phalakam.utpāṭayati /
ŚŚS_17.1.3: tiṣṭhata.eva.udumbarasya /
ŚŚS_17.1.4: purastād.ādityasya.udayanataḥ /
ŚŚS_17.1.5: yadi.purastān.na.vidyeta.atha.apy.uttarataḥ /
ŚŚS_17.1.6: yadi.dakṣiṇataḥ /
ŚŚS_17.1.7: paścād.vā.syāt /
ŚŚS_17.1.8: mūle.chedayitvā.prān.vā.udan.vā.tiṣṭhann.utpāṭya.yady.aṇur.udumbaraḥ.syāt /
ŚŚS_17.1.9: api.de.vā.trīṇi.vā.phalakāni.saṃtṛḍyuḥ /
ŚŚS_17.1.10: tad.bāhu.mātram.prāg.bhavati /
ŚŚS_17.1.11: aratni.mātram.tiryak /
ŚŚS_17.1.12: saṃtaṣṭam /
ŚŚS_17.1.13: prajñāta.agram /
ŚŚS_17.1.14: tac.caturdhā.anteṣu.vitardayati /
ŚŚS_17.1.15: atha.etasya.vai.vā.udumbarasya.anyasya.vā.viśākhyau.chedayanti /
ŚŚS_17.1.16: paraḥ.puruṣe /
ŚŚS_17.1.17: vaṃśam.ca /
ŚŚS_17.1.18: yady.udumbaro.na.vidyeta.yo.anyo.vṛkṣaḥ.phala.grahiṣṇuḥ.kalyāṇa.abhivyāhāro.vā.syāt.tasya.etad.upakalpayet /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.1.1: Now concerning the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great vow).
ŚŚS 17.1.2: Some days beforehand, the <s>Hotṛ</s> carves a swing-plank.
ŚŚS 17.1.3: From a standing <s>udumbara</s> (fig) tree.
ŚŚS 17.1.4: [Located] to the east of where the sun rises.
ŚŚS 17.1.5: If there is none to the east, then from the north.
ŚŚS 17.1.6: If [none there], from the south.
ŚŚS 17.1.7: Or it may be from the west.
ŚŚS 17.1.8: Having cut it at the root, standing facing east or north, he carves it out — if the <s>udumbara</s> tree is small.
ŚŚS 17.1.9: Or they may fasten together two or three planks.
ŚŚS 17.1.10: It extends a forearm's length forward.
ŚŚS 17.1.11: A cubit's length across.
ŚŚS 17.1.12: Smoothly hewn.
ŚŚS 17.1.13: With a recognizable front.
ŚŚS 17.1.14: He notches it at the four ends.
ŚŚS 17.1.15: Then from this very <s>udumbara</s> tree or from another, they cut two forked [posts].
ŚŚS 17.1.16: [Each] a man's height tall.
ŚŚS 17.1.17: And a crossbeam.
ŚŚS 17.1.18: If an <s>udumbara</s> tree is not available, whatever other tree bears fruit or has an auspicious name — from that they should prepare this.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.2.1: atha.mauñjyau.rajjū.kārayanti /
ŚŚS_17.2.2: dṛḍhe /
ŚŚS_17.2.3: triguṇe /
ŚŚS_17.2.4: paro.dvi.vyāyāme /
ŚŚS_17.2.5: etāvadd.hotāram.abhitaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.2.6: audumbarīm.āsandīm.udgātre.saṃghnanti /
ŚŚS_17.2.7: tasyai.prādeśa.mātrāḥ.pādā.bhavanti /
ŚŚS_17.2.8: aratri.mātrāṇi.śīrṣaṇyāny.anūcyāni /
ŚŚS_17.2.9: tām.saṃhatya.mauñjībhiḥ.syāndyābhir.vivayanti.dvi.guṇābhiḥ.prasala.visṛṣṭābhiḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.2.1: Then they have two ropes made of <s>muñja</s> (reed) grass.
ŚŚS 17.2.2: Sturdy.
ŚŚS 17.2.3: Triple-stranded.
ŚŚS 17.2.4: More than two arm-spans long.
ŚŚS 17.2.5: Of this length on both sides of the <s>Hotṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 17.2.6: They construct a seat (<s>āsandī</s>) of <s>udumbara</s> wood for the <s>Udgātṛ</s>.
ŚŚS 17.2.7: Its legs are a span high.
ŚŚS 17.2.8: The headrest and backrest are a cubit in length.
ŚŚS 17.2.9: Having assembled it, they weave it with double-stranded <s>muñja</s> thongs, loosely attached.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.3.1: atha.etām.vīṇām.śata.tantrīm.upakalpayanti /
ŚŚS_17.3.2: tasyāḥ.pālāśī.sūnā.bhavati /
ŚŚS_17.3.3: audumbaro.daṇḍaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.3.4: api.vā.audumbarī.sūnā.pālāśo.daṇḍaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.3.5: tām.ānaḍuhena.sarva.rohitena.carmaṇā.bāhyato.lomnā.abhiṣīvyanti /
ŚŚS_17.3.6: tasyai.mūle.daṇḍam.daśadhā.atividhyanti /
ŚŚS_17.3.7: tad.daśa.daśa.rajjūḥ.pravayanti /
ŚŚS_17.3.8: tā.agre.nānā.badhnanti /
ŚŚS_17.3.9: daṇḍa.samāsā.vīṇā.śata.tantrī.bhavati /
ŚŚS_17.3.10: vetasa.śākhā.sapalāśā.vādiny.upaklṛptā.bhavati /
ŚŚS_17.3.11: svayam.natā.vā.śā.iṣīkā /
ŚŚS_17.3.12: ghāṭa.karkarīr.avaghaṭarikāḥ.kāṇḍavīṇāḥ.piccorā.iti.patnya.upakalpayanti /
ŚŚS_17.3.13: upamukhena.picchorām.vādayet /
ŚŚS_17.3.14: vādanena.kāṇḍavīṇāmṇ /
ŚŚS_17.3.15: tām.ghāṭarīr.ity.ācakṣate /
ŚŚS_17.3.16: yā.ghāṭarī.mṛdum.vādayet.sārātiḥ.syāt /
ŚŚS_17.3.17: dviṣantam.janayet /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.3.1: Then they prepare this hundred-stringed <s>vīṇā</s> (lute).
ŚŚS 17.3.2: Its resonating body (<s>sūnā</s>) is of <s>palāśa</s> (flame tree) wood.
ŚŚS 17.3.3: The neck (<s>daṇḍa</s>) is of <s>udumbara</s> wood.
ŚŚS 17.3.4: Or the resonating body is of <s>udumbara</s> and the neck of <s>palāśa</s>.
ŚŚS 17.3.5: They sew it with the hide of a completely red bull, with the hair facing outward.
ŚŚS 17.3.6: At its base, they pierce the neck in ten places.
ŚŚS 17.3.7: Through those [holes] they string ten groups of ten strings.
ŚŚS 17.3.8: They tie them separately at the end.
ŚŚS 17.3.9: When complete with the neck, the <s>vīṇā</s> has a hundred strings.
ŚŚS 17.3.10: A willow branch with its leaves serves as the prepared plectrum.
ŚŚS 17.3.11: Or a naturally curved <s>śara</s> reed.
ŚŚS 17.3.12: The wives prepare jars (<s>ghāṭa</s>), clay pots (<s>karkarī</s>), small pots (<s>avaghaṭarikā</s>), bamboo lutes (<s>kāṇḍavīṇā</s>), and <s>piccorā</s> (a type of instrument).
ŚŚS 17.3.13: One should play the <s>picchorā</s> face-to-face.
ŚŚS 17.3.14: The <s>kāṇḍavīṇā</s> by plucking.
ŚŚS 17.3.15: They call it the <s>ghāṭarī</s>.
ŚŚS 17.3.16: She who plays the <s>ghāṭarī</s> softly would be a good friend.
ŚŚS 17.3.17: [Otherwise] she would produce an enemy.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.4.1: caturo.dundubhīn.adhvaryuḥ.sahananān.upakalpayati /
ŚŚS_17.4.2: pūrvasyai.dvāryā.abhito.dvāra.bāhū.bahiḥ.sadaḥ.saṃdhau.sahananāv.āsañjayati /
ŚŚS_17.4.3: aparasyai.dvāryā.abhito.dvāra.bāhū.antaḥ.sadaḥ.saṃdhau.sahananāv.āsañjayati /
ŚŚS_17.4.4: yadi.ṣaṭ.syur.dakṣiṇa.ardhe.sadasa.ekam.uttara.ardha.ekam /
ŚŚS_17.4.5: muñjānām.ca.kuśānām.ca.kūrcam.adhvaryave.saṃskurvanti /
ŚŚS_17.4.6: tasmiṃs.tiṣṭhan.pratyāgṛṇāti /
ŚŚS_17.4.7: atha.itare.dīkṣitāḥ.pratipuruṣam.bṛsīḥ.kurvate.yathā.prādeśa.mātreṇa.upari.bhūmeḥ.syuḥ /
ŚŚS_17.4.8: atha.yā.mārjālīyam.paryeṣyantyo.bhavanti.tābhyaḥ.pratyekam.navān.kalaśān.upakalpayanti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.4.1: The <s>Adhvaryu</s> prepares four drums (<s>dundubhi</s>), [which are] percussive instruments.
ŚŚS 17.4.2: At the eastern doorway, on both doorposts, outside the <s>sadas</s> (assembly hall), at the joints, he hangs two percussive [drums].
ŚŚS 17.4.3: At the western doorway, on both doorposts, inside the <s>sadas</s>, at the joints, he hangs two percussive [drums].
ŚŚS 17.4.4: If there are six, one in the southern half of the <s>sadas</s> and one in the northern half.
ŚŚS 17.4.5: They prepare a bundle of <s>muñja</s> and <s>kuśa</s> grasses for the <s>Adhvaryu</s>.
ŚŚS 17.4.6: Standing on that, he responds [to the chanting].
ŚŚS 17.4.7: Then the other consecrated ones each make cushions (<s>bṛsī</s>) such that they are a span's height above the ground.
ŚŚS 17.4.8: Then for those [women] who will be circumambulating the <s>Mārjālīya</s> [fire], they prepare nine jars each.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.5.1: atha.etam.aśvaratham.upakalpayanti.vitata.varūtham /
ŚŚS_17.5.2: dhanuś.ca.trīṃś.ca.iṣūn /
ŚŚS_17.5.3: rājānam.vā.rāja.mātram.vājer.astāram /
ŚŚS_17.5.4: yadi.rājā.vā.rāja.mātro.vā.na.vidyeta.ya.etām.dhiyam.vidyāt.sa.etat.kuryāt /
ŚŚS_17.5.5: uttareṇa.āgnīdhram.prāñcyau.prahve.sthūṇe.viminvanty.ākhaṇāya /
ŚŚS_17.5.6: tad.iḷa.saṃvartam.vā.utkaram.vā.carmaṇā.abhivitanvanti /
ŚŚS_17.5.7: tan.na.sapatreṇa.atividhyet /
ŚŚS_17.5.8: jaghanena.āgnīdhram.bahir.vedya.vaṭam.khananti /
ŚŚS_17.5.9: tam.etasya.upālambhyasya.ṛṣabhasya.carmaṇā.prācīna.grīveṇa.udīcīna.grīveṇa.vā.uttarato.lomnā.abhiṣīvyanti /
ŚŚS_17.5.10: tam.tasya.eva.lāṅgūlena.kāle.bhūmi.dundubhim.āghnanti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.5.1: Then they prepare a horse-chariot with an extended body.
ŚŚS 17.5.2: And a bow and three arrows.
ŚŚS 17.5.3: A king or a prince as the chariot-driver.
ŚŚS 17.5.4: If a king or prince is not available, one who knows this sacred teaching should perform this [role].
ŚŚS 17.5.5: North of the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> [fire area], they erect two posts leaning forward, for the target.
ŚŚS 17.5.6: They stretch a hide over a mound of earth or a heap [of refuse to make the target].
ŚŚS 17.5.7: One should not pierce it with a feathered [arrow].
ŚŚS 17.5.8: Behind the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, outside the <s>vedi</s>, they dig a pit.
ŚŚS 17.5.9: They cover it with the hide of the bull to be sacrificed, with the neck facing east or with the neck facing north, with the hair outward.
ŚŚS 17.5.10: They beat that [earth drum] at the [proper] time with the tail of that very [bull] — the ground drum (<s>bhūmidundubhi</s>).

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.6.1: atha.śūdra.āryau.strī.pumāṃsau.baṇḍa.khalatī.ity.upakalpayanti /
ŚŚS_17.6.2: tad.etat.purāṇam.utsannam.na.kāryam.etasmin.samupaklṛpte /
ŚŚS_17.6.3: saṃsthite.daśame.ahani.sado.havir.dhānāni.samūhanti /
ŚŚS_17.6.4: āgnīdhram.patnī.śālam.ca /
ŚŚS_17.6.5: atha.navaiḥ.kuśair.bahulam.upastṛṇanti /
ŚŚS_17.6.6: katipayān.kuśa.bhārān.nidadhati.prātar.bṛsībhyaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.6.1: Then they arrange a <s>Śūdra</s> and an <s>Ārya</s>, a woman and a man, a eunuch (<s>baṇḍa</s>) and a bald person (<s>khalatī</s>).
ŚŚS 17.6.2: This is an ancient [practice] that has fallen into disuse; it should not be performed when these [substitutes] are arranged.
ŚŚS 17.6.3: When the tenth day has concluded, they sweep together the <s>Sadas</s> (assembly hall) and the <s>Havirdhāna</s> (Soma-cart sheds).
ŚŚS 17.6.4: And the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> [fire-shed] and the <s>Patnī-śālā</s> (wives' hall).
ŚŚS 17.6.5: Then they spread fresh <s>kuśa</s> grass abundantly.
ŚŚS 17.6.6: They place a few bundles of <s>kuśa</s> grass in the morning for the cushions (<s>bṛsīs</s>).

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.7.1: atha.mahā.rātre.mahā.vratāya.prātar.anuvākam.upākurvanti /
ŚŚS_17.7.2: yathā.parisahasram.anubrūyāt /
ŚŚS_17.7.3: tasya.pañcaviṃśaḥ.stomaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.7.4: rājanam.pṛṣṭham /
ŚŚS_17.7.5: agniṣṭomo.yajñaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.7.6: atha.ete.pariṣṭavaṇīyā.bhavanti.tṛvṛt.pañcadaśaḥ.saptadaśa.ekaviṃśa.iti /
ŚŚS_17.7.7: aindrāgno.vā.aikādaśinānām.vā.ekaḥ.savanīyaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.7.8: aindraś.ca.ṛṣabhaḥ.prājāpatyaś.ca.aja.upālambhyau /
ŚŚS_17.7.9: nirukta.aindraḥ /
ŚŚS_17.7.10: upāṃśu.prājāpatyaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.7.11: te.yatra.vapāsu.hutāṣu.samprasarpanti.tad.etat.preṅkha.miśram.bahir.vedi.prakṣālya.antareṇa.cātvāla.utkarau.tīrtham.tena.prapadya.uttareṇa.āgnīdhrīyam.dhiṣṇyam.paryāhṛtya.pūrvayā.dvārā.sadaḥ.prahṛtya.agreṇa.uttareṇa.hotur.dhiṣṇyam.prān.upanidadhati /
ŚŚS_17.7.12: evam.eva.yasya.yasya.bahir.vedi.bhavati.yathā.saṃcaraḥ.samprasarpaṇe.bhavati.tathā.āhṛtya.uttarata.upanidadhati /
ŚŚS_17.7.13: tasya.traiṣṭubham.prātaḥ.savanam.syād.iti.paiṅgyam.śuṣka.bhṛṅgārīyam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.7.1: Then, in the deep night, they begin the morning litany (<s>prātaranuvāka</s>) for the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great observance).
ŚŚS 17.7.2: He should recite up to a full thousand [verses].
ŚŚS 17.7.3: Its <s>stoma</s> is the twenty-five-fold.
ŚŚS 17.7.4: The <s>Rājana</s> [is] the <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant).
ŚŚS 17.7.5: The sacrifice is an <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.
ŚŚS 17.7.6: Then these are the additional chants (<s>pariṣṭavaṇīya</s>): the ninefold, fifteen-fold, seventeen-fold, and twenty-one-fold.
ŚŚS 17.7.7: Either an <s>Aindrāgna</s> (for <s>Indra</s>-<s>Agni</s>) [animal], or one from the eleven-fold [set], is the pressing-day [animal].
ŚŚS 17.7.8: A bull for <s>Indra</s> and a he-goat for <s>Prajāpati</s> are to be sacrificed.
ŚŚS 17.7.9: The one for <s>Indra</s> [is offered] with explicit [dedication].
ŚŚS 17.7.10: The one for <s>Prajāpati</s> [is offered] in a low voice (<s>upāṃśu</s>).
ŚŚS 17.7.11: When the omental offerings have been made, they proceed forth — that [ritual implement], mixed with the swing (<s>preṅkha</s>), having washed it outside the <s>Vedi</s>, entering through the ford between the <s>Cātvāla</s> (pit) and the <s>Utkara</s> (refuse-heap), going around to the north of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire-hearth, entering the <s>Sadas</s> through the eastern door, passing to the north of the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s fire-hearth, they deposit [it] facing east.
ŚŚS 17.7.12: Likewise, for whatever [implement] is outside the <s>Vedi</s>, having brought it in the manner of the procession at the pressing forth, they deposit it to the north.
ŚŚS 17.7.13: Its morning pressing should be in <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [meter] — this is the teaching of <s>Paiṅgya</s> and <s>Śuṣka-Bhṛṅgāra</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.8.1: viśo.viśo.vo.atithim.ity.ājyam /
ŚŚS_17.8.2: tasya.dvādaśa.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.agnim.naro.dīdhitibhir.araṇyor.ity.etat.pañcaviṃśaty.ṛcam.upasaṃśaṃsati /
ŚŚS_17.8.3: tad.diṣṭa.śastram /
ŚŚS_17.8.4: traiṣṭubhaḥ.praugaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.8.5: kuvid.aṅga.namasā.ye.vṛdhāsa.iti.vāyavyam.ca.aindravāyavam.ca /
ŚŚS_17.8.6: maitrāvaruṇam.ca.yathā.viṣuvati /
ŚŚS_17.8.7: ka.u.śravat.katamo.yajñiyānām.ity.āśvinam /
ŚŚS_17.8.8: kathā.mahām.avṛdhat.kasya.hotur.ity.aindram /
ŚŚS_17.8.10: uta.syā.naḥ.sarasvatī.juṣāṇa.iti.sārasvatam /
ŚŚS_17.8.11: sa.tṛca.klṛptaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.8.12: tasya.pacchaḥ.śastram /
ŚŚS_17.8.13: aikāhikam.vā.prātaḥ.savanam /
ŚŚS_17.8.14: klṛptam.prātaḥ.savanam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.8.1: 'Viśo viśo vo atithim' (For every clan, your guest) — [this is] the <s>ājya</s> (ghee-hymn).
ŚŚS 17.8.2: Having recited twelve of its half-verses, he supplements with 'Agnim naro dīdhitibhir araṇyoḥ' — this [makes] twenty-five verses.
ŚŚS 17.8.3: That is the fixed recitation (<s>diṣṭa-śastra</s>).
ŚŚS 17.8.4: The <s>prauga</s> (introductory litany) is in the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter.
ŚŚS 17.8.5: 'Kuvid aṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ' — [this is] the <s>Vāyavya</s> (for <s>Vāyu</s>) and the <s>Aindravāyava</s> (for <s>Indra</s>-<s>Vāyu</s>).
ŚŚS 17.8.6: The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [portion is] the same as at the solstice (<s>viṣuvat</s>).
ŚŚS 17.8.7: 'Ka u śravat katamo yajñiyānām' (Who will hear? Which of the worship-worthy ones?) — [this is] the <s>Āśvina</s> (for the <s>Aśvins</s>).
ŚŚS 17.8.8: 'Kathā mahām avṛdhat kasya hotuḥ' (How did the great one grow? Of which invoker?) — [this is] the <s>Aindra</s> (for <s>Indra</s>).
ŚŚS 17.8.10: 'Uta syā naḥ Sarasvatī juṣāṇā' (And may <s>Sarasvatī</s> delight in us) — [this is] the <s>Sārasvata</s> (for <s>Sarasvatī</s>).
ŚŚS 17.8.11: It is arranged in triplets.
ŚŚS 17.8.12: Its recitation [follows] with the concluding [portion].
ŚŚS 17.8.13: Or the morning pressing [follows] the one-day [format].
ŚŚS 17.8.14: The morning pressing is [thus] arranged.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.9.1: atha.ato.mādhyaṃdinam.savanam /
ŚŚS_17.9.2: ā.tvā.ratham.yathā.ūtaya.iti.marutvatīyasya.pratipat /
ŚŚS_17.9.3: idam.vaso.sutam.andha.ity.anucaraḥ /
ŚŚS_17.9.4: eṣa.eva.nitya.ekāha.ātānaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.9.5: asatsu.me.jaritaḥ.sābhivega.iti.vāsukram.pūrvam.śastvā.mahān.indro.nṛvadā.carṣaṇiprā.ity.etasmiṃs.traiṣṭubhe.nividam.dadhāti /
ŚŚS_17.9.6: ubhe.sūkte.paccaḥ.saṃśasyet /
ŚŚS_17.9.7: iti.nvā.u.marutvatīyam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.9.1: Now, the midday pressing.
ŚŚS 17.9.2: 'Ā tvā ratham yathā ūtaye' (Come to your chariot for aid) — this is the opening of the <s>Marutvatīya</s>.
ŚŚS 17.9.3: 'Idam vaso sutam andhaḥ' (This pressed juice, O <s>Vasu</s>) — [this is] the attendant [hymn] (<s>anucara</s>).
ŚŚS 17.9.4: This same is the permanent one-day connection (<s>ātāna</s>).
ŚŚS 17.9.5: 'Asatsu me jaritaḥ sābhivegā' — having recited the <s>Vāsukra</s> [hymn] first, in this <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [hymn] 'Mahān Indro nṛvad ā carṣaṇiprāḥ,' he places the <s>nivid</s> (litany).
ŚŚS 17.9.6: Both hymns should be recited with the concluding [portion].
ŚŚS 17.9.7: Thus indeed is the <s>Marutvatīya</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.10.1: atha.ato.niṣkevalyam /
ŚŚS_17.10.2: saṃsthite.prātaḥ.savane.preṅkhāvaṭau.khānayed.iti.sā.sthitiḥ /
ŚŚS_17.10.3: śaste.marutvatīya.iti.paiṅgyam /
ŚŚS_17.10.4: jaghanena.svam.dhiṣṇyam.padam.ca.catur.aṅgulam.ca.pramāya.tat.paścād.udīcīna.agram.phalakam.nidhāya.ubhayataś.catur.aṅgule.upadhāya.bahiś.catur.aṅgulābhyām.lekhe.lekhayitvā.preṅkhāvaṭau.khānayed.dakṣiṇam.pūrvam.atha.uttaram /
ŚŚS_17.10.5: prāñcau.vā.udañcau.vā.utkirā.utkiranti /
ŚŚS_17.10.6: tad.viśākhyāv.avadhāya.udīcīna.agram.vaṃśam.abhyādadhāti /
ŚŚS_17.10.7: śīrṣṇā.hotā.mimīte /
ŚŚS_17.10.8: yadi.hrasvaḥ.syād.ūrdhva.bāhur.mimīte /
ŚŚS_17.10.9: dṛḍha.paryuṣṭe.paryṛṣati.yathā.na.vyatheyātām /
ŚŚS_17.10.10: atha.etat.preṅkha.phalakam.rajjubhiś.caturdhā.anteṣu.parivyayati.yathā.na.sambhraśyeta /
ŚŚS_17.10.11: uttareṇa.dakṣiṇām.preṅkha.sthūṇām.dakṣiṇām.rajjum.badhnanti /
ŚŚS_17.10.12: dakṣiṇena.uttarām.preṅkha.sthūṇām.uttarām.rajjum.badhnanti /
ŚŚS_17.10.13: tat.sambādhya.prāsyati.yathā.prādeśa.mātreṇa.upari.bhūmeḥ.syāt /
ŚŚS_17.10.15: tad.abhi.nivīḷham.paryṛṣati.yathā.na.vyatheta /
ŚŚS_17.10.16: tat.sambādhya.uttarasyām.preṅkha.sthūṇāyām.apāśrayati /
ŚŚS_17.10.17: tat.śaste.marutvatīye.yathā.sthānam.sthāpayet /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.10.1: Now the <s>Niṣkevalya</s> (exclusive recitation).
ŚŚS 17.10.2: When the morning pressing has concluded, he should have the swing-pits (<s>preṅkhāvaṭau</s>) dug — that is the procedure.
ŚŚS 17.10.3: '[This is done] when the <s>Marutvatīya</s> is being recited' — this is the teaching of <s>Paiṅgya</s>.
ŚŚS 17.10.4: Behind his own fire-hearth, measuring one foot-length (<s>pada</s>) and four finger-widths (<s>aṅgula</s>), placing a plank there behind, facing north, setting supports of four finger-widths on both sides, having drawn lines four finger-widths outside those, he should have the swing-pits dug — the southern one first, then the northern.
ŚŚS 17.10.5: The excavated earth is thrown either eastward or northward.
ŚŚS 17.10.6: Having set up two forked posts (<s>viśākha</s>) [in those pits], he places a crossbar facing north.
ŚŚS 17.10.7: The <s>Hotṛ</s> measures [the height] with his head.
ŚŚS 17.10.8: If he is short, he measures with arms raised upward.
ŚŚS 17.10.9: He ties [the posts] firmly and tightly so that they would not shake.
ŚŚS 17.10.10: Then he wraps ropes fourfold around the edges of the swing-plank so that it would not slip.
ŚŚS 17.10.11: To the north of the southern swing-post, they tie the southern rope.
ŚŚS 17.10.12: To the south of the northern swing-post, they tie the northern rope.
ŚŚS 17.10.13: Having tightened that, he casts [the swing] so that it is about a span (<s>prādeśa</s>) above the ground.
ŚŚS 17.10.15: He ties that firmly and closely so that it would not shake.
ŚŚS 17.10.16: Having tightened that, he leans [the swing] against the northern swing-post.
ŚŚS 17.10.17: When the <s>Marutvatīya</s> is being recited, he should set [the swing] in its place.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.11.1: atha.adhvaryur.māhendram.graham.gṛhītvā.iti /
ŚŚS_17.11.2: agreṇa.hotur.dhiṣṇyam.prān.upaviśati /
ŚŚS_17.11.3: tam.hotā.āha.adhvarya.upa.nu.rama.iti /
ŚŚS_17.11.4: sa.uttareṇa.uttarām.preṅkha.sthūṇām.uttareṇa.adhvaryum.prana.upaniṣkramya.pūrvayā.dvārā.āgnīdhram.prapadya.uttareṇa.āgnīdhrīyam.dhiṣṇyam.paryetya.paścāt.prān.upaviśya.dakṣiṇam.jānv.ācya.sruveṇa.ājya.sthālyā.upahatya.juhoti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.11.1: Then the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, having taken the <s>Māhendra</s> (great <s>Indra</s>) cup.
ŚŚS 17.11.2: He sits down facing east, in front of the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s fire-hearth.
ŚŚS 17.11.3: The <s>Hotṛ</s> addresses him: 'O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, approach now with delight.'
ŚŚS 17.11.4: He [the <s>Hotṛ</s>], passing to the north of the northern swing-post, to the north of the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, going out eastward, entering the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> [shed] through the eastern door, going around to the north of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire-hearth, sitting down facing east behind [it], bending his right knee, having touched [the ghee] in the ghee-pot with the offering-ladle (<s>sruva</s>), he makes the offering.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.12.1: āyuṣmad.gāyatram.viśvāyū.rathantaram.sarva.āyur.bṛhat.sāma.āyur.vāmadevyam.atyāyur.yajñāyajñīyam.teṣām.aham.āyuṣā.ayuṣmān.bhūyāsam.asyai.prāṇaḥ.saṃcarati.prajāyai.hṛdayāya.kam.sarvā.vinuḍya.saṃtṛḍyo.mayy.astu.śaradaḥ.śatam.svāhā.iti.prathamām /
ŚŚS_17.12.1: dive.svāhā.antarikṣāya.svāhā.pṛthivyai.svāhā.iti.tisraḥ /
ŚŚS_17.12.3: gave.svāhā.vāce.svāhā.vācaspataye.svāhā.ity.aparās.tisraḥ /
ŚŚS_17.12.4a: yad.idam.iti.haitiham.daivyam.saha.uccaret.|.tad.vayam.yajāmahe.yad.asmabhyam.iti.dravat /
ŚŚS_17.12.4: vāco.rājan.yajāmahe.vācaspate.sahasva.me.|.yo.asmān.abhidāsati.|.svāhā.ity.aṣṭamīm.hutvā.yathā.āyatanam.sruvam.nidhāya.yathā.prapannam.upaniṣkramya.agreṇa.sada.uttareṇa.srutim.prān.tiṣṭhan.parimādān.japān.japati /
ŚŚS_17.12.5: vāg.āyur.viśva.āyur.viśvam.āyur.ehy.evā.hi.indra.upehi.viśvatha.vidā.maghavan.vidā.iti /
ŚŚS_17.12.6: atha.atra.eva.tiṣṭhann.agnim.yathā.aṅgam.upatiṣṭhate /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.12.1: 'The <s>Gāyatra</s> [<s>Sāman</s>] gives long life; the <s>Rathantara</s> gives all life; the <s>Bṛhat Sāman</s> gives complete life; the <s>Vāmadevya</s> gives life; the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> gives exceeding life — by the life of these, may I become long-lived. <s>Prāṇa</s> (breath) moves together for this progeny, for the heart. Having pierced through all obstacles, may there be in me a hundred autumns. <s>Svāhā</s>!' — [this is] the first [oblation].
ŚŚS 17.12.1: 'To heaven, <s>svāhā</s>! To the atmosphere, <s>svāhā</s>! To the earth, <s>svāhā</s>!' — three [oblations].
ŚŚS 17.12.3: 'To the cow, <s>svāhā</s>! To speech, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of speech, <s>svāhā</s>!' — another three.
ŚŚS 17.12.4a: 'Whatever here is traditional and divine, may it rise up together. That we worship, may it flow forth to us.'
ŚŚS 17.12.4: 'O King of speech, we worship. O Lord of speech, overpower for me. Whoever attacks us — <s>svāhā</s>!' Having offered the eighth [oblation], placing the offering-ladle (<s>sruva</s>) in its receptacle, going out as [he] entered, standing facing east in front of the <s>Sadas</s>, to the north of the drainage channel, he mutters the <s>Parimāda</s> (encircling-intoxication) formulas.
ŚŚS 17.12.5: 'Speech, life, all-life, complete life — come! Thus indeed, O <s>Indra</s>, approach from all sides! O bountiful one, know! Know!'
ŚŚS 17.12.6: Then, standing right there, he worships <s>Agni</s> limb by limb.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.13.1: namas.te.gāyatrāya.yat.te.śiro.yat.te.pura.iti.pūrva.ardham /
ŚŚS_17.13.2: namas.te.rathantarāya.yas.te.dakṣiṇo.bāhur.yas.te.dakṣiṇaḥ.pakṣa.iti.dakṣiṇam.pakṣam /
ŚŚS_17.13.3: namas.te.bṛhate.yas.ta.uttaro.bāhur.yas.ta.uttaraḥ.pakṣa.ity.uttaram.pakṣam /
ŚŚS_17.13.4: namas.te.vāmadevyāya.yat.te.madhyam.yas.ta.ātmā.iti.madhyam /
ŚŚS_17.13.5: namas.te.yajñāyajñīyāya.yat.te.puccham.yā.pratiṣṭhā.iti.puccham /
ŚŚS_17.13.6: samiddhasya.eva.etān.bhāgān.upatiṣṭheta.yady.uttara.vedau.bhavati /
ŚŚS_17.13.7: atha.atra.eva.tiṣṭhann.ādityam.upatiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_17.13.8: ākāśam.śālāyai.kuryur.iti.ha.eka.āhuḥ /
ŚŚS_17.13.9: deśena.tv.eva.upātiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_17.13.10: subhūr.nāmā.asi.śreṣṭho.rāśmir.devānām.saṃsadyayā.tanvā.brahma.jinvasi.tayā.mā.jinva.tayā.mā.janaya.tayā.mā.pāhi.brahma.varcasam.anna.adyam.mayi.tviṣim.dhā.namas.te.astu.mā.mā.hiṃsīr.iti /
ŚŚS_17.13.11: atha.dakṣiṇa.āvṛt.praviśati /
ŚŚS_17.13.12: paścāt.preṅkham.prān.upaviśya.tad.anvārabhyān.anusṛjan.vāg.yata.āsta.ādhisarpaṇāt /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.13.1: 'Homage to your <s>Gāyatra</s> [form] — that which is your head, that which is your front' — [thus he addresses] the front half.
ŚŚS 17.13.2: 'Homage to your <s>Rathantara</s> [form] — that which is your right arm, that which is your right wing' — the right side.
ŚŚS 17.13.3: 'Homage to your <s>Bṛhat</s> [form] — that which is your left arm, that which is your left wing' — the left side.
ŚŚS 17.13.4: 'Homage to your <s>Vāmadevya</s> [form] — that which is your middle, that which is your self (<s>ātman</s>)' — the middle.
ŚŚS 17.13.5: 'Homage to your <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> [form] — that which is your tail, that which is your foundation' — the tail.
ŚŚS 17.13.6: He should worship these parts [only] when [the fire] is kindled, if it is on the <s>Uttara-vedi</s> (high altar).
ŚŚS 17.13.7: Then, standing right there, he worships the sun (<s>Āditya</s>).
ŚŚS 17.13.8: 'They should make an opening in the roof [of the hall]' — thus say some.
ŚŚS 17.13.9: But he worships [the sun] only by [facing its] direction.
ŚŚS 17.13.10: 'You are named <s>Subhū</s> (well-being), the most excellent ray of the gods. By that body with which you impel the sacred word (<s>brahman</s>), by that impel me, by that generate me, by that protect me. Place in me sacred brilliance (<s>brahmavarcas</s>), food-eating, and splendor. Homage to you! Do not harm me!'
ŚŚS 17.13.11: Then he enters turning to the right.
ŚŚS 17.13.12: Sitting behind the swing facing east, having grasped it, releasing it [gently], he sits in silence, speech-restrained, until the crawling-forth (<s>ādhisarpaṇa</s>).

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.14.1: sa.purastād.eva.chandogebhyaḥ.śīrṣaṇyāṃs.tṛcān.nigādayeta /
ŚŚS_17.14.2: sa.purastād.eva.adhvaryuṇā.saṃvādayeta /
ŚŚS_17.14.3: dvādaśa.kṛtvas.tūṣṇīm.śaṃse.pratyāgṛṇītād.vihṛtam.ātmānam.ca.pada.anuṣaṅgāṃś.ca.saṃśiṣya.abhyavahṛtam.tvam.pratyāgṛṇītād.iti /
ŚŚS_17.14.4: atha.prastotāram.āha.saptasu.stotriyāsu.pariśiṣṭāsu.naḥ.prabrūtāt.tāvadd.hi.idam.japyam.iti /
ŚŚS_17.14.5: atha.adhvaryuḥ.stotram.upākaroti /
ŚŚS_17.14.6: yatra.eva.udgātā.āsandīm.adihrohaty.atha.prastotā.pratihartārau.bṛsyāv.adhisarpataḥ /
ŚŚS_17.14.7: upagātāraś.ca /
ŚŚS_17.14.8: udgātā.eva.prathamo.vīṇām.pravādayati /
ŚŚS_17.14.9: tam.patnyo.anu.pravādayanti /
ŚŚS_17.14.10: āghnanti.dundubhīn /
ŚŚS_17.14.11: āhanti.bhūmi.dundubhim /
ŚŚS_17.14.12: kurvanti.ghoṣam.ghoṣa.kṛtaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.14.13: atha.pūrṇa.kumbhā.apo.bibhratyo.mārjālīyam.pariyanti /
ŚŚS_17.14.14: hai.mahā3.idam.madhv.idam.madhv.ity.etām.vācam.vadanti /
ŚŚS_17.14.15: apradakṣiṇam.triḥ /
ŚŚS_17.14.16: prasalavi.tūṣṇīm.tata.ūrdhvam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.14.1: He should have the <s>chandoga</s> (chanters) recite the head-<s>tṛcas</s> (three-verse hymns) beforehand.
ŚŚS 17.14.2: He should converse with the <s>Adhvaryu</s> beforehand.
ŚŚS 17.14.3: Twelve times he should respond in the silent recitation (<s>tūṣṇīm śaṃsa</s>), combining the separated self-[verses] and the connecting <s>padas</s>, and he should respond to the combined [recitation] saying 'thus.'
ŚŚS 17.14.4: Then he says to the <s>Prastotṛ</s> (lead chanter): 'When seven <s>stotriyas</s> (praise verses) remain, announce it to us, for until then this must be muttered.'
ŚŚS 17.14.5: Then the <s>Adhvaryu</s> initiates the <s>stotra</s> (chant).
ŚŚS 17.14.6: At the very moment when the <s>Udgātṛ</s> (chief chanter) ascends the throne (<s>āsandī</s>), the <s>Prastotṛ</s> and <s>Pratihartṛ</s> (response chanter) mount their cushions.
ŚŚS 17.14.7: And the assistant chanters (<s>upagātṛs</s>) [also mount theirs].
ŚŚS 17.14.8: The <s>Udgātṛ</s> himself first plays the <s>vīṇā</s> (lute).
ŚŚS 17.14.9: The wives play after him.
ŚŚS 17.14.10: They beat the drums (<s>dundubhis</s>).
ŚŚS 17.14.11: [One] beats the ground drum (<s>bhūmidundubhi</s>).
ŚŚS 17.14.12: The noise-makers produce their noise.
ŚŚS 17.14.13: Then [women] carrying full water-jars circumambulate the <s>Mārjālīya</s> [fire].
ŚŚS 17.14.14: They utter this speech: 'Hai! This is honey! O great one! This is honey!'
ŚŚS 17.14.15: Three times counter-clockwise.
ŚŚS 17.14.16: In regular order, silently from then onward.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.15.1: atha.etam.aśva.ratham.yuñjanti /
ŚŚS_17.15.2: agreṇa.dakṣiṇam.vedyaṃsam /
ŚŚS_17.15.3: tam.samnaddha.ātiṣṭhati.rājā.vā.rāja.mātro.vā.dhanuś.ca.trīṃś.ca.iṣūn.ādāya /
ŚŚS_17.15.4: so.abhito.vedim.triḥ.prasalavi.parivartamāna.etam.ākhaṇam.vidhyati /
ŚŚS_17.15.5: tam.na.sapatreṇa.atividhyet /
ŚŚS_17.15.6: evam.dvitīyam.evam.tṛtīyam /
ŚŚS_17.15.7: tam.prāñcam.udañcam.śrathnanti /
ŚŚS_17.15.8: tam.tatra.eva.vimuñcanti /
ŚŚS_17.15.9: atha.prastotā.saptasu.stotriyāsu.pariśiṣṭā.svāhā.velā.iti /
ŚŚS_17.15.10: atha.hotā.dakṣiṇena.prādeśena.preṅkha.phalakam.ca.bhūmim.ca.samṛśan.japati.sam.mahān.mahatyā.dadhād.iti /
ŚŚS_17.15.11: atha.upari.preṅkha.phalake.prādeśam.nidhāya.japati.sam.devo.devyā.dadhād.iti /
ŚŚS_17.15.13: atha.upari.preṅkha.phalakāt.prādeśa.mātre.prādeśam.dhārayan.japati.sam.brahma.brāhmaṇyā.dadhād.iti /
ŚŚS_17.15.13: atha.upanidhāya.preṅkha.phalakam.trir.abhyanya.trir.abhyavān.iti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.15.1: Then they yoke this horse-chariot.
ŚŚS 17.15.2: In front of the southern shoulder of the <s>vedi</s> (altar).
ŚŚS 17.15.3: A king or one of royal stature mounts it, fully armored, taking a bow and three arrows.
ŚŚS 17.15.4: He drives around the <s>vedi</s> three times in regular order and strikes this target.
ŚŚS 17.15.5: He should not pierce it through with a feathered [arrow].
ŚŚS 17.15.6: Likewise the second [time], likewise the third.
ŚŚS 17.15.7: They unyoke it facing forward and northward.
ŚŚS 17.15.8: They release it right there.
ŚŚS 17.15.9: Then the <s>Prastotṛ</s> [announces]: 'With seven <s>stotriyas</s> remaining — <s>svāhā</s>, it is time!'
ŚŚS 17.15.10: Then the <s>Hotṛ</s>, touching the swing-plank and the ground with his right span, mutters: 'May the great [one] unite with the great.'
ŚŚS 17.15.11: Then, placing his span on top of the swing-plank, he mutters: 'May the god unite with the goddess.'
ŚŚS 17.15.13: Then, holding his span a span's distance above the swing-plank, he mutters: 'May <s>Brahman</s> unite with <s>Brāhmaṇī</s> (sacred speech).'
ŚŚS 17.15.13: Then, placing [his hand] against the swing-plank, three times forward and three times backward.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.16.1: atha.enad.urasā.saṃspṛśya.dakṣiṇam.bhāgam.ātmano.atiharan.japaty.arko.asi.vasavas.tvā.gāyatreṇa.chandasā.ārohantu.tān.aham.anvārohāmi.rājyāya.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.2: atha.uttaram.bhāgam.ātmano.atiharan.japati.rudrās.tvā.traiṣṭubhena.chandasā.ārohantu.tān.aham.anvārohāmi.svārājyāya.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.3: atha.dakṣiṇam.bhāgam.ātmano.atiharan.japaty.ādityās.tvā.jāgatena.chandasā.ārohantu.tān.aham.anvārohāmi.sāṃrājyāya.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.4: atha.uttaram.bhāgam.ātmano.atiharan.japati.viśve.tvā.devā.ānuṣṭubhena.chandasā.ārohantu.tān.aham.anvārohāmi.kāmaprāya.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.5: atha.samadhiṛpya.prāñcau.pādā.upāvahṛtya.bhūmau.pratiṣṭhāpayati /
ŚŚS_17.16.6: atha.trir.abhyanya.trir.abhyavān.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.7: atha.upari.preṅkha.phalake.dakṣiṇa.uttariṇam.upastham.kṛtvā.dakṣiṇena.prādeśena.paścāt.preṅkha.phalakam.upaspṛśati.prajāpatiṣ.ṭvā.ārohatu.vāyuḥ.preṅkhayatv.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.8: atha.trir.abhyanya.trir.abhyavān.iti /
ŚŚS_17.16.9: atha.prāñco.pāṇī.parigṛhya.japati /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.16.1: Then, touching it with his chest, passing it to the right side of his body, he mutters: 'You are the <s>arka</s> (sun/hymn). May the <s>Vasus</s> ascend you with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> metre. I ascend after them, for sovereignty (<s>rājya</s>).'
ŚŚS 17.16.2: Then, passing it to the left side of his body, he mutters: 'May the <s>Rudras</s> ascend you with the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre. I ascend after them, for self-sovereignty (<s>svārājya</s>).'
ŚŚS 17.16.3: Then, passing it to the right side of his body, he mutters: 'May the <s>Ādityas</s> ascend you with the <s>Jagatī</s> metre. I ascend after them, for supreme sovereignty (<s>sāṃrājya</s>).'
ŚŚS 17.16.4: Then, passing it to the left side of his body, he mutters: 'May the <s>Viśvedevas</s> (all-gods) ascend you with the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> metre. I ascend after them, for the fulfillment of desires (<s>kāmaprāya</s>).'
ŚŚS 17.16.5: Then, having fully mounted, he draws both feet forward and places them firmly on the ground.
ŚŚS 17.16.6: Then three times forward and three times backward.
ŚŚS 17.16.7: Then, sitting on the swing-plank with his lap facing south and north, he touches the back of the swing-plank with his right span [and mutters]: 'May <s>Prajāpati</s> ascend you. May <s>Vāyu</s> set you swinging.'
ŚŚS 17.16.8: Then three times forward and three times backward.
ŚŚS 17.16.9: Then, grasping both hands forward, he mutters.

body.text:
ŚŚS_17.17.1: sam.vāk.prāṇena.sam.aham.prāṇena.sam.cakṣur.manasā.sam.aham.manasā.sam.prajāpatiḥ.paśubhiḥ.sam.aham.paśubhiḥ.suparṣo.asi.garutmān.premām.vācam.vadiṣyāmi.bahu.kariṣyantīm.bahu.kariṣyan.bāhor.bhūyaḥ.svargam.iṣyantīm.svargam.iṣyann.iti /
ŚŚS_17.17.2: atha.trir.abhyanya.trir.abhyavān.iti /
ŚŚS_17.17.3: sa.visṛṣṭa.vān.matsaram.vininīṣamāṇa.āsta.ā.stotrasya.pravadanāt /
ŚŚS_17.17.4: yatra.eva.hotā.preṅkham.adhirohati.tat.sarve.sagṛha.patikā.bṛsīr.adhisarpanti /
ŚŚS_17.17.5: uttamāyām.stotriyāyām.pariśiṣṭāyām.avatṛṇatti.dundubhīn /
ŚŚS_17.17.6: avatṛṇatti.bhūmi.dundubhim /
ŚŚS_17.17.7: uparamanti.ghoṣam.ghoṣa.kṛtaḥ /
ŚŚS_17.17.8: atha.pūrṇa.kumbhā.apo.bibhratyo.mārjālīyam.pariyanti /
ŚŚS_17.17.9: mārjālīye.tāḥ.kalaśān.avaninīya.upanidhāya.yathā.etam.utsṛjyante /
ŚŚS_17.17.10: eṣā.iti.prāha /
ŚŚS_17.17.11: prokte.hotā.vācam.yacchaty.ā.anuvaṣaṭ.kārāt /
ŚŚS_17.17.12: upa.prathāram.āhāve.anuramati /
ŚŚS_17.17.13: pratihṛta.āhvayate /
ŚŚS_17.17.14: adhvaryo.śoṃsāvo3.ity.uccair.āhūya.yathā.asya.vāk.sarvā.anyā.vāco.ativadet /
ŚŚS_17.17.15: uccair.āhūya.trir.upāṃśu.him.kṛtya.upāṃśu.tūṣṇīm.śaṃsam.|.tasya.atas.tasya.ataḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 17.17.1: 'May speech unite with breath, may I unite with breath. May sight unite with mind, may I unite with mind. May <s>Prajāpati</s> unite with cattle, may I unite with cattle. You are well-winged <s>Garutmān</s> (eagle). I shall speak this speech that will bring abundance, as one who will bring abundance — more than the arm's [reach], going to heaven, as one going to heaven.'
ŚŚS 17.17.2: Then three times forward and three times backward.
ŚŚS 17.17.3: Having released [the swing], he sits removing the intoxicating exhilaration until the commencement of the <s>stotra</s> (chant).
ŚŚS 17.17.4: At the very moment when the <s>Hotṛ</s> mounts the swing, all [the priests] together with the householder mount their cushions.
ŚŚS 17.17.5: When the last <s>stotriyā</s> (praise verse) remains, he silences the drums.
ŚŚS 17.17.6: He silences the ground drum.
ŚŚS 17.17.7: The noise-makers cease their noise.
ŚŚS 17.17.8: Then [women] carrying full water-jars circumambulate the <s>Mārjālīya</s> [fire].
ŚŚS 17.17.9: At the <s>Mārjālīya</s>, they set down the jars, deposit them, and are released as before.
ŚŚS 17.17.10: He declares: 'This is it.'
ŚŚS 17.17.11: When declared, the <s>Hotṛ</s> restrains his voice until the <s>anuvaṣaṭkāra</s> (response call).
ŚŚS 17.17.12: He pauses at the <s>prathāra</s> (distribution) in the invocation.
ŚŚS 17.17.13: After the response (<s>pratihāra</s>), he calls out.
ŚŚS 17.17.14: 'O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, <s>śoṃsāvo3</s>!' — he calls out loudly such that his voice exceeds all other voices.
ŚŚS 17.17.15: Having called out loudly, three times softly (<s>upāṃśu</s>) making the <s>hiṃkāra</s> sound, [then] softly the silent recitation. From that [point], from that [point onward].

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.1.1: uccair.āhūya.trir.upāṃśu.him.kṛtya /
ŚŚS_18.1.2: brahma.jajñānam.prathamam.purastād.iyam.pitre.rāṣṭryā.ity.agre.viśve.devā.mama.śṛṇvantu.yajñiyā.ity.etās.tisra.ṛcas.tūṣṇīm.śaṃsas.tā.upāṃśv.apraṇuvan.pacchaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.3: atha.ātmane.vācam.utsṛjati /
ŚŚS_18.1.4: tad.id.āsa.bhuvaneṣu.jyeṣṭham.iti.stotriyas.tṛcaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.5: tad.etan.navarcam /
ŚŚS_18.1.6: vane.na.vā.yo.nyadhāyi.ca.akann.ity.aṣṭau /
ŚŚS_18.1.7: śākmanā.śokā.aruṇaḥ.suparṇa.iti.tṛcam /
ŚŚS_18.1.8: yo.adadhāj.jyotiṣi.jyotir.antar.mahat.tan.nāma.guhyam.puruspṛg.idam.ta.ekam.para.ū.ta.ekam.iti.tisra.eka.pātinyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.9: tās.trayo.viṃśatiḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.10: triḥ.śastayā.prathamayā.saha.pañcaviṃśatiḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.11: sa.eṣa.ātmā.pañca.viṃśaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.12: tam.nadena.upasṛṣṭam.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.1.13: nadam.va.odatīnām.iti /
ŚŚS_18.1.14: traiṣṭubhāni.pūrvāṇi.padāni.nadasya.uttarāṇi /
ŚŚS_18.1.15: prathamena.traiṣṭubhena.padena.prathamam.nadasya.padam.upasaṃdhāya.avasyati /
ŚŚS_18.1.16: dvitīyena.traiṣṭubhena.dvitīyam.saṃdhāya.praṇauti /
ŚŚS_18.1.17: tṛtīyena.traiṣṭubhena.tṛtīyam.saṃdhāya.avasyati /
ŚŚS_18.1.18: caturthena.traiṣṭubhena.caturtham.saṃdhāya.praṇauti /
ŚŚS_18.1.19: evma.vihṛtām.prathamām.triḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.1.20: parācīr.uttarāḥ /
ŚŚS_18.1.21: evam.vihṛtā.eva.yā.tṛtīyā.sūktasya.tasyā.uttaram.ardharcam.utsṛjati.nadasya.ca.uttaram /
ŚŚS_18.1.22: tau.purastād.dvipadānām.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.1.23: ātmānam.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam.śaṃsati.|.tā.asya.sūda.dohasa.iti.tām.ardharcaśaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.1.1: Having called out loudly, three times softly making the <s>hiṃkāra</s> sound.
ŚŚS 18.1.2: '<s>Brahma</s> (sacred knowledge) was born first in the east' — 'This [hymn] for the father, for the kingdom' — 'May the <s>Viśvedevas</s>, worthy of sacrifice, hear me at the start' — these three verses are the silent recitation; he recites them softly, not chanting aloud, verse by verse.
ŚŚS 18.1.3: Then he releases his voice for himself.
ŚŚS 18.1.4: 'That indeed was the greatest among beings' — these are the <s>stotriya tṛcas</s> (praise three-verse hymns).
ŚŚS 18.1.5: That comprises nine verses.
ŚŚS 18.1.6: 'He who was placed in the forest, and who fell asleep' — eight [verses].
ŚŚS 18.1.7: 'The tawny, well-winged <s>Suparṇa</s> (eagle), fierce with the power of <s>Śākman</s>' — a <s>tṛca</s> (three-verse group).
ŚŚS 18.1.8: 'He who placed light within light' — 'Great is that hidden, widely-touching name' — 'This is your one [foot], that is your other supreme one' — three single-<s>pāda</s> (quarter-verse) [citations].
ŚŚS 18.1.9: Those are twenty-three.
ŚŚS 18.1.10: With the first recited three times, together [they make] twenty-five.
ŚŚS 18.1.11: This self (<s>ātman</s>) is indeed twenty-five-fold.
ŚŚS 18.1.12: He recites it combined with the <s>nada</s> (reed-pipe [hymn]).
ŚŚS 18.1.13: 'The reed-pipe of the shining ones' — thus.
ŚŚS 18.1.14: The <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [verse-quarters] are the earlier <s>padas</s>; the <s>nada</s>'s are the latter.
ŚŚS 18.1.15: Joining the first <s>Triṣṭubh</s> quarter with the first quarter of the <s>nada</s>, he concludes.
ŚŚS 18.1.16: Joining the second <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [quarter] with the second, he chants.
ŚŚS 18.1.17: Joining the third <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [quarter] with the third, he concludes.
ŚŚS 18.1.18: Joining the fourth <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [quarter] with the fourth, he chants.
ŚŚS 18.1.19: Thus the first, separated, he recites three times.
ŚŚS 18.1.20: The subsequent ones in reverse order.
ŚŚS 18.1.21: Likewise, the third [verse] of the hymn, separated — he drops the latter half-verse of it and of the <s>nada</s>.
ŚŚS 18.1.22: Those he recites before the two-<s>pāda</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.1.23: Having recited the self-[hymn] (<s>ātman</s>), then he recites the <s>sūdadohasa</s> (bountifully-milking hymn). 'Those are his bountifully-milking ones' — that, half-verse by half-verse.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.2.1: atha.etāni.śīrṣaṇyāni.tṛcāni.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.2.2: indram.id.gāthina.indreṇa.sam.hi.indro.dadhīca.uttiṣṭhann.ojasā.saha.ud.ghed.abhi.śrutām.agham.ud.u.tyam.jāta.vedasam.ity.eteṣām.tṛcānām.yeṣu.sāmagāḥ.stuvīraṃs.tāni.śaṃset /
ŚŚS_18.2.3: ud.u.tyam.jāta.vedasam.ity.etasminn.u.ha.eke.navarce.stuvate /
ŚŚS_18.2.4: te.yadi.tathā.kuryur.etad.eva.śaṃset /
ŚŚS_18.2.5: ud.u.tyam.jāta.vedasam.ity.etasya.u.ha.eke.prathame.tṛce.stuvate /
ŚŚS_18.2.6: te.yadi.tathā.kuryur.itareṣām.ye.kāmayeta.te.upāharet /
ŚŚS_18.2.7: tāny.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
18.2.1: Now he recites these <s>śīrṣaṇya</s> (head-related) <s>tṛcas</s> (sets of three verses).
18.2.2: "<s>indram id gāthino</s>" (RV 1.63), "<s>indreṇa sam hi</s>" (RV 10.153), "<s>indro dadhīca</s>" (RV 1.84), "<s>uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha</s>" (RV 2.11), "<s>ud ghed abhi śrutām agham</s>" (RV 1.36.14), "<s>ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam</s>" (RV 1.50) — of these <s>tṛcas</s>, whichever ones the <s>Sāmagās</s> (Sāmaveda chanters) chant upon, those he should recite.
18.2.3: Some perform the <s>stuti</s> (praise) on the <s>navarca</s> (nine-verse hymn) beginning with "<s>ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam</s>."
18.2.4: If they do so, he should recite this very one.
18.2.5: Some perform the <s>stuti</s> on the first <s>tṛca</s> of "<s>ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam</s>."
18.2.6: If they do so, he should bring in from the remaining ones whichever he desires.
18.2.7: Having recited those by half-verses, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s> (the refrain verse).

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.3.1: atha.etam.graivam.tṛcam.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.3.2a: yasya.idam.oja.ārujas.tujo.yujo.balam.sahaḥ.|.indrasya.rantyam.bṛhat /
ŚŚS_18.3.2b: anādhṛṣṭam.vipanyayā.nādhṛṣa.ādadharṣayā.|.dhṛṣāṇam.dhṛṣitam.śavaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.3.2c: sa.no.dadātu.tam.rayim.puru.piśaṅga.saṃdṛśam.|.indraspati.stava.stomo.janeṣu.iti /
ŚŚS_18.3.3: tam.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
18.3.1: Now he recites this <s>graiva</s> (neck-related) <s>tṛca</s> (set of three verses).
18.3.2a: "Whose power broke forth, who yokes his vigor, whose strength and might — great is the delight of <s>Indra</s>,"
18.3.2b: "Unassailable by hostility, unconquerable by the unconquerable — bold and emboldened is his power,"
18.3.2c: "May he grant us that wealth, resplendent with many tawny hues — O lord <s>Indra</s>, your praise-hymn is among the peoples."
18.3.3: Having recited that by half-verses, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.4.1: urum.no.lokam.anu.neṣi.vidvān.ity.akṣā /
ŚŚS_18.4.2: tām.pacchaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.4.3: atha.rathantarasya.stotriyam.punar.ādāyam.kakup.kāram.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.4.4: atha.rathantarasya.anurūpam.punar.ādāyam.kakup.kāram.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.4.5: ataḥ.dhāyyām.pacchaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.4.6: atha.rāthantaram.pragātham.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.4.7: ya.eka.idd.havyaś.carṣaṇīnām.iti.sūktam.tat.pacchas.tasya.dvitīyām.uddhṛtya.viśvo.hy.anyo.arir.ā.jagāma.iti.yā.etasya.dvitīyā.tām.iha.dvitīyām.karoti.sūktam.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.4.8: tam.indram.johavīmi.maghavānam.ugram.iti.prahastakas.tṛcaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.4.9: tam.pacchaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
18.4.1: "<s>uruṃ no lokam anu neṣi vidvān</s>" (Lead us knowing to the wide space) — this is the <s>akṣā</s> (single-verse unit).
18.4.2: Having recited it with the <s>pacchas</s> (response), then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.4.3: Then the <s>stotriya</s> (praise verse) of the <s>Rathantara</s>, with repetition, making a <s>kakubh</s> (metrical adjustment), then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.4.4: Then the <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding verse) of the <s>Rathantara</s>, with repetition, making a <s>kakubh</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.4.5: After that, having recited the <s>dhāyyā</s> (meditation verse) with the <s>pacchas</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.4.6: Then having recited the <s>Rāthantara</s> <s>pragātha</s> (chant-pair) by half-verses, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.4.7: "<s>ya eka id dhavyaś carṣaṇīnām</s>" (He who alone is the invocable one among peoples) — that is the <s>sūkta</s> (hymn). That is recited with <s>pacchas</s>. Having extracted its second verse — "<s>viśvo hy anyo arir ā jagāma</s>" (For every other foe has come) — whichever is the second of that one, he makes it the second here. Having recited the <s>sūkta</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.4.8: "<s>tam indraṃ johavīmi maghavānam ugram</s>" (I call upon that <s>Indra</s>, the mighty bounteous one) — this is the <s>prahastakas</s> (concluding) <s>tṛca</s>.
18.4.9: Having recited it with the <s>pacchas</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.5.1: sa.sūrye.janayan.jyotir.indro.ayā.dhiyā.taraṇir.aṅgirasvān.|.ṛtena.śuṣmī.havamāno.arkair.abhi.spṛdha.usro.vedim.tatarda.|.ity.akṣā /
ŚŚS_18.5.2: tām.pacchaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.5.3: atha.bṛhataḥ.stotriyam.punar.ādāyam.kakup.kāram.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.5.4: atha.bṛhato.anurūpam.punar.ādāyam.kakup.kāram.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.5.5: na.atra.dhāyyā.bhavati /
ŚŚS_18.5.6: atha.bārhatam.pragātahm.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.5.7: viśvo.hy.anyo.arir.ā.jagāma.iti.sūktam.tat.pacchas.tasya.dvitīyām.uddhṛtya.ya.eka.idd.havyaś.carṣaṇīnām.iti.yā.etasya.dvitīyā.tām.iha.dvitīyām.karoti /
ŚŚS_18.5.8: sūktam.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.5.9: viśvāḥ.pṛtanā.abhibhūtaram.naram.iti.prahastakas.tṛcaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.5.10: tasya.pacchaḥ.prathamām.śaṃsaty.ardharcaśa.uttare /
ŚŚS_18.5.11: prahastakam.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
18.5.1: "<s>sa sūrye janayan jyotir indraḥ</s>" (That <s>Indra</s>, generating light in the sun), "<s>ayā dhiyā taraṇir Aṅgirasvān</s>" (With this thought, the deliverer accompanied by the <s>Aṅgirases</s>), "<s>ṛtena śuṣmī havamāno arkair abhi spṛdhaḥ usro vediṃ tatarda</s>" (The spirited one, invoked by cosmic order with chants, pierced the altar against rivals at dawn) — this is the <s>akṣā</s>.
18.5.2: Having recited it with the <s>pacchas</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.5.3: Then the <s>stotriya</s> (praise verse) of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, with repetition, making a <s>kakubh</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.5.4: Then the <s>anurūpa</s> (corresponding verse) of the <s>Bṛhat</s>, with repetition, making a <s>kakubh</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.5.5: There is no <s>dhāyyā</s> (meditation verse) here.
18.5.6: Then having recited the <s>Bārhata</s> <s>pragātha</s> by half-verses, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.5.7: "<s>viśvo hy anyo arir ā jagāma</s>" (For every other foe has come) — that is the <s>sūkta</s>. That is recited with <s>pacchas</s>. Having extracted its second verse — "<s>ya eka id dhavyaś carṣaṇīnām</s>" (He who alone is the invocable one among peoples) — whichever is the second of that one, he makes it the second here.
18.5.8: Having recited the <s>sūkta</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.5.9: "<s>viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram</s>" (The man who overcomes all armies) — this is the <s>prahastakas</s> <s>tṛca</s>.
18.5.10: Of that, he recites the first verse with <s>pacchas</s>, the remaining ones by half-verses.
18.5.11: Having recited the <s>prahastaka</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.6.1: atha.etāni.catur.uttarāṇi.tṛcāni.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.6.2: indrāya.madvane.sutam.indram.vṛtrāya.hantave.gāyanti.tvā.gāyatriṇo.na.tvā.bṛhanto.adraya.iti.catvāri.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.6.3: tāny.ardharcaśaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.6.4: itthā.hi.soma.in.mada.iti.pāṅktam.tṛcam.tat.paṅkti.śaṃsam /
ŚŚS_18.6.5: sam.ca.tve.jagmur.gira.indra.pūrvīr.ād.aṅgirāḥ.prathamam.dadhire.vaya.iti.traiṣṭubha.jāgate.tṛce /
ŚŚS_18.6.6: te.pacchaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
18.6.1: Now he recites these <s>tṛcas</s> (sets of three verses) that have four additional verses.
18.6.2: "<s>indrāya madvane sutam</s>" (The pressed juice for <s>Indra</s> in the intoxicating draught), "<s>indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave</s>" (<s>Indra</s> for slaying <s>Vṛtra</s>), "<s>gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ</s>" (The <s>Gāyatrī</s>-singers sing of you), "<s>na tvā bṛhanto adrayaḥ</s>" (Not even the great stones can match you) — these are four <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.6.3: Those are recited by half-verses.
18.6.4: "<s>itthā hi soma in madaḥ</s>" (Thus indeed, O <s>Soma</s>, in intoxication) — this is a <s>pāṅkta</s> (five-footed) <s>tṛca</s>; that is recited in the <s>Paṅkti</s> manner.
18.6.5: "<s>saṃ ca tve jagmur gira indra pūrvīḥ</s>" (And many hymns have come together to you, O <s>Indra</s>), "<s>ād Aṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vayaḥ</s>" (The <s>Aṅgirases</s> first established the bird) — these are <s>Triṣṭubh</s>-<s>Jagatī</s> <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.6.6: Having recited those with the <s>pacchas</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.7.1: atha.etā.aśītīḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.7.2: mahān.indro.ya.ojasā.ity.etayā.gāyatrīm.aśītim.pratipadyate /
ŚŚS_18.7.3: tāni.pañcadaśa.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.7.4: indra.it.somapā.eka.ity.aṣṭau /
ŚŚS_18.7.5: eva.id.eṣa.tuvi.kūrmir.iti.trīṇi /
ŚŚS_18.7.6: ā.ghā.ye.agnim.indhata.iti.caturdaśa /
ŚŚS_18.7.7: tāni.catvāriṃśat.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.7.8: tat.pūrvam.kapalam /
ŚŚS_18.7.9: atha.uttaram /
ŚŚS_18.7.10: pra.kṛtāny.ṛjīṣiṇa.iti.daśa.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.7.11: apād.u.śipry.andhasa.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_18.7.12: ā.tvā.viśantv.indava.iti.catvāri /
ŚŚS_18.7.13: yad.adya.kac.ca.vtrahann.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_18.7.14: patnīvantaḥ.sutā.ima.iti.catvāri /
ŚŚS_18.7.15: idam.hy.anv.ojasā.uttiṣṭhann.ojasā.saha.abhi.pra.gopatim.iti.trīṇi.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.7.16: teṣām.yat.purastāt.kṛtam.syāt.tad.uddharet /
ŚŚS_18.7.17: yady.u.vai.na.kuryur.ud.eva.haret /
ŚŚS_18.7.18: ya.ānayat.parāvata.iti.daśa.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.7.19: tāni.catvāriṃśat.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.7.20: tad.uttaram.kapalam /
ŚŚS_18.7.21: atha.sūda.dohāḥ /
body.translated_text:
18.7.1: Now he recites these eighty (verses, the <s>Aśīti</s> recitation).
18.7.2: With "<s>mahān indro ya ojasā</s>" (Great is <s>Indra</s> who by his might) he enters the <s>Gāyatrī</s> group of eighty.
18.7.3: Those are fifteen <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.7.4: "<s>indra it somapā ekaḥ</s>" (<s>Indra</s> alone is the <s>Soma</s>-drinker) — eight (verses).
18.7.5: "<s>eva id eṣa tuvikūrmiḥ</s>" (Thus indeed is this one of mighty deeds) — three.
18.7.6: "<s>ā ghā ye agnim indhate</s>" (Those who kindle <s>Agni</s>) — fourteen.
18.7.7: Those are forty <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.7.8: That is the first <s>kapāla</s> (half-section).
18.7.9: Now the second.
18.7.10: "<s>pra kṛtāny ṛjīṣiṇaḥ</s>" (The deeds of the one who holds the <s>ṛjīṣa</s>) — ten <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.7.11: "<s>apād u śipry andhasaḥ</s>" (He drank of the pressed juice, the jaw-adorned one) — five.
18.7.12: "<s>ā tvā viśantv indavaḥ</s>" (May the drops enter you) — four.
18.7.13: "<s>yad adya kac ca vṛtrahann</s>" (Whatever today, O slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>) — five.
18.7.14: "<s>patnīvantaḥ sutā imaḥ</s>" (These pressed juices accompanied by wives) — four.
18.7.15: "<s>idam hy anv ojasā</s>," "<s>uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha</s>," "<s>abhi pra gopatim</s>" — three <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.7.16: Of those, whatever has been previously done, that he should extract.
18.7.17: And even if they do not do so, he should still extract it.
18.7.18: "<s>ya ānayat parāvataḥ</s>" (He who brought from afar) — ten <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.7.19: Those are forty <s>tṛcas</s>.
18.7.20: That is the second <s>kapāla</s>.
18.7.21: Then the <s>sūdadohas</s> verses.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.8.1: yā.indra.bhuja.ābhara.ity.etayā.bārhatīm.aśītim.pratipadyate /
ŚŚS_18.8.2: tā.nava.pratyakṣa.bṛhatyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.8.3: viśve.ta.indra.vīryam.iti.tisraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.8.4: tam.ghem.itthā.namasvina.iti.dve /
ŚŚS_18.8.5: na.sīma.deva.āpad.iti.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.8.6: tā.viṃśatiḥ.pratyakṣa.bṛhatyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.8.7: atha.pragāthāḥ /
ŚŚS_18.8.8: yaḥ.satrāhā.vicarṣaṇir.iti.catvāraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.8.9: mo.ṣu.tvā.vāghataś.cana.iti.catvāra.uddhṛtya.dvipadām /
ŚŚS_18.8.10: ud.in.v.asya.ricyata.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_18.8.11: tat.tvā.yāmi.suvīryam.yukṣvā.hi.vṛtrahantama.iti.dvau.dvau /
ŚŚS_18.8.12: yad.indra.prāg.apāg.udag.iti.sapta /
ŚŚS_18.8.13: ā.vṛṣasva.purūvaso.iti.dvau /
ŚŚS_18.8.14: avipro.vā.yad.avidhad.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_18.8.15: yaḥ.śakro.mṛkṣo.aśvya.iti.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.8.16: teṣām.trīn.ādatte /
ŚŚS_18.8.17: te.catvāriṃśat.pragāthāḥ /
body.translated_text:
18.8.1: With "<s>yā indra bhuja ābhara</s>" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring enjoyment) he enters the <s>Bārhatī</s> group of eighty.
18.8.2: Those are nine <s>pratyakṣa-bṛhatīs</s> (manifest <s>Bṛhatī</s> verses).
18.8.3: "<s>viśve ta indra vīryam</s>" (All your heroic deeds, O <s>Indra</s>) — three.
18.8.4: "<s>taṃ ghem itthā namasvinaḥ</s>" (Him indeed the reverent ones thus) — two.
18.8.5: "<s>na sīm deva āpad</s>" (No calamity from the gods befalls them) — six.
18.8.6: Those are twenty <s>pratyakṣa-bṛhatīs</s>.
18.8.7: Now the <s>pragāthas</s> (chant-pairs).
18.8.8: "<s>yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇiḥ</s>" (He who is the ever-victorious, the discerning one) — four.
18.8.9: "<s>mo ṣu tvā vāghataś cana</s>" (Let not even the chanters hinder you) — four, extracting the <s>dvipada</s> (two-footed verse).
18.8.10: "<s>ud in v asya ricyate</s>" (His surpasses all) — five.
18.8.11: "<s>tat tvā yāmi suvīryam</s>" (I approach you for heroic strength), "<s>yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama</s>" (Yoke up, O greatest slayer of <s>Vṛtra</s>) — two by two.
18.8.12: "<s>yad indra prāg apāg udag</s>" (Whether, O <s>Indra</s>, eastward, westward, or northward) — seven.
18.8.13: "<s>ā vṛṣasva purūvaso</s>" (Rain down, O possessor of much wealth) — two.
18.8.14: "<s>avipro vā yad avidhat</s>" (Or if the unwise one has served) — five.
18.8.15: "<s>yaḥ śakro mṛkṣo aśvyaḥ</s>" (He who is mighty, the purifying one, the horse-winning one) — six.
18.8.16: Of those he takes three.
18.8.17: Those are forty <s>pragāthas</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.9.1: atha.pratyakṣa.bṛhatīḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.9.2: mahe.cana.tvām.adriva.iti.pañcaviṃśatiḥ /
ŚŚS_18.9.3: tāsām.viṃśatim.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.9.4: ni.gavyata.iti.nividdhānīyā /
ŚŚS_18.9.5: tām.pacchaḥ.śastvā.āhūya.nividam.dadhāti /
ŚŚS_18.9.6: tām.paccho.vyavagrāham.śastvā.sama.sūktām /
ŚŚS_18.9.7: uttamena.padena.praṇutya.sa.jātebhir.iti.nividā.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.9.8: tām.pacchaḥ.śastvāa.tha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
18.9.1: Now he recites the <s>pratyakṣa-bṛhatīs</s> (manifest <s>Bṛhatī</s> verses).
18.9.2: "<s>mahe cana tvām adrivaḥ</s>" (Not even for a great one, O lord of the pressing stones) — twenty-five.
18.9.3: Having recited twenty of those, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
18.9.4: "<s>ni gavyata</s>" (Down to the cattle-seeking one) — this is the one into which the <s>nivid</s> (laudatory formula) is to be inserted.
18.9.5: Having recited it with the <s>pacchas</s>, calling out, he inserts the <s>nivid</s>.
18.9.6: Having recited it after the <s>pacchas</s> with the <s>vyavagrāha</s> (separated recitation), completing the <s>sūkta</s>.
18.9.7: With the last <s>pada</s> (foot) leading into it, he recites with the <s>nivid</s> "<s>sa jātebhiḥ</s>" (with the born ones).
18.9.8: Having recited it with the <s>pacchas</s>, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.10.1: atha.pratyakṣa.bṛhatīḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.10.2: yāḥ.pañcaviṃśateḥ.pariśiṣṭās.tābhiḥ.pratipadyate /
ŚŚS_18.10.3: vayam.gha.tvā.sutāvanta.iti.pañcadaśa /
ŚŚS_18.10.4: tā.viṃśatiḥ.pratyakṣa.bṛhatyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.10.5: atha.pragāthāḥ /
ŚŚS_18.10.6: ye.ṣaṇṇām.trayaḥ.pariśiṣṭās.taiḥ.pratipadyate /
ŚŚS_18.10.7: yo.rājā.carṣaṇīnām.iti.trayaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.10.8: tam.vo.dasmam.ṛtīṣaham.ity.ekaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.10.9: ā.no.viśvāsu.havya.iti.trayaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.10.10: tvām.id.ā.hyo.nara.iti.catvāraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.10.11: atha.vālakhilyānām.sūktāni.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.10.12: teṣām.dvau.pragāthā.utsṛjati.indra.nihavam.ca.vaiśvadevam.ca.ā.no.viśve.sajoṣasa.iti /
ŚŚS_18.10.13: te.catvāriṃśat.pragāthāḥ /
body.translated_text:
18.10.1: Now he recites the <s>pratyakṣa-bṛhatīs</s> (manifest <s>Bṛhatī</s> verses).
18.10.2: With the ones remaining from the twenty-five, he commences.
18.10.3: "<s>vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ</s>" (We indeed, having pressed <s>Soma</s>, approach you) — fifteen.
18.10.4: Those are twenty <s>pratyakṣa-bṛhatīs</s>.
18.10.5: Now the <s>pragāthas</s>.
18.10.6: With the three remaining from the six, he commences.
18.10.7: "<s>yo rājā carṣaṇīnām</s>" (He who is the king of peoples) — three.
18.10.8: "<s>taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣaham</s>" (That wondrous one who overcomes seasons for you) — one.
18.10.9: "<s>ā no viśvāsu havya</s>" (To us in all invocations) — three.
18.10.10: "<s>tvām id ā hyo nara</s>" (You alone, O hero, we call day after day) — four.
18.10.11: Then six <s>sūktas</s> (hymns) from the <s>Vālakhilyas</s>.
18.10.12: Of those he omits two <s>pragāthas</s> — the <s>Indra-nihava</s> (invocation of <s>Indra</s>) and the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (hymn to all gods) — namely "<s>ā no viśve sajoṣasaḥ</s>" (May all the gods, united, come to us).
18.10.13: Those are forty <s>pragāthas</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.11.1: atha.pratyakṣa.bṛhatīḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.11.2: matsy.apāyi.te.maho.asmā.asmā.id.andhaso.balam.dhehi.tanūṣu.no.yujāno.haritā.rathe.tava.id.indra.aham.āśasā.amāsu.pakvam.airaya.iyam.yā.nīcy.arkiṇī.pra.te.ratham.mithū.kṛtam.antar.yaccha.jighāṃsatas.tvam.viśvasya.jagata.iti.daśa.eka.pātinyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.11.3: ayam.te.astu.haryata.ā.mandrair.indra.haribhir.iti.sūkte /
ŚŚS_18.11.4: te.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.11.1: Then he recites the manifest <s>Bṛhatī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.11.2: 'Matsy apāyi te maho,' 'Asmā asmā id andhaso,' 'Balam dhehi tanūṣu naḥ,' 'Yujāno haritā rathe,' 'Tava id indra aham āśasā,' 'Amāsu pakvam airaya,' 'Iyam yā nīcy arkiṇī,' 'Pra te ratham mithū kṛtam,' 'Antar yaccha jighāṃsataḥ,' 'Tvam viśvasya jagataḥ' — ten single-<s>pāda</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.11.3: [Then] the hymns 'Ayam te astu haryata' [and] 'Ā mandrair Indra haribhiḥ.'
ŚŚS 18.11.4: Having recited those by half-verses, then [he recites] the <s>sūdadohasam</s> (the well-milking refrain).

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.12.1: indraḥ.suteṣu.someṣv.ity.etayā.auṣṇihīm.aśītim.pratipadyate /
ŚŚS_18.12.2: tāny.ekādaśa.tṛcāni /
ŚŚS_18.12.3: ya.indra.somapātama.ity.ekādaśa.teṣām.ekam.utsṛjati.indram.vṛtrāya.hantava.iti /
ŚŚS_18.12.4: tam.v.abhi.pra.gāyata.iti.catvāri /
ŚŚS_18.12.5: sakhāya.ā.śiṣāmahi.iti.nava /
ŚŚS_18.12.6: ya.eka.id.vidayata.ā.yāhy.adribhiḥ.sutam.iti.dve.tṛce /
ŚŚS_18.12.7: tāni.ṣaṭ.triṃśat.tṛcāni /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.12.1: With 'Indraḥ suteṣu someṣu' he enters into the eighty <s>Auṣṇihī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.12.2: Those are eleven <s>tṛca</s>s (triads).
ŚŚS 18.12.3: 'Ya Indra somapātama' — eleven [verses]; of those he omits one: 'Indram Vṛtrāya hantave.'
ŚŚS 18.12.4: 'Tam v abhi pra gāyata' — four [verses].
ŚŚS 18.12.5: 'Sakhāya ā śiṣāmahi' — nine [verses].
ŚŚS 18.12.6: 'Ya eka id vidayate' [and] 'Ā yāhy adribhiḥ sutam' — two <s>tṛca</s>s.
ŚŚS 18.12.7: Those total thirty-six <s>tṛca</s>s.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.13.1: atha.catuḥ.śatam.gāyatrīḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.13.2: nakir.indra.tvad.uttara.iti.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.13.3: divaś.cid.ghā.duhitaram.iti.caturdaśa /
ŚŚS_18.13.4: ā.tū.na.indra.vṛtrahann.ity.eka.viṃśatiḥ /
ŚŚS_18.13.5: ā.va.indram.krivim.yathā.yad.indra.aham.yathā.tvam.iti.pañcadaśarce /
ŚŚS_18.13.6: pra.saṃrājam.carṣaṇīnām.uttvā.mandantu.stomā.iti.dvādaśarce /
ŚŚS_18.13.7: ā.pra.drava.parāvata.iti.nava /
ŚŚS_18.13.8: iti.catuḥ.śatam.gāyatrīḥ /
ŚŚS_18.13.9: vayam.u.tvām.apūrvyā.ity.aṣṭau.kākubhāḥ.pragāthāḥ /
ŚŚS_18.13.10: indrāya.sāma.gāyata.iti.sarvam /
ŚŚS_18.13.11: tad.ardharcaśaḥ.śastvā.ataḥ.sūda.dohasam /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.13.1: Then he recites four hundred <s>Gāyatrī</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.13.2: 'Nakir Indra tvad uttaraḥ' — six [verses].
ŚŚS 18.13.3: 'Divaś cid ghā duhitaram' — fourteen.
ŚŚS 18.13.4: 'Ā tū na Indra vṛtrahan' — twenty-one.
ŚŚS 18.13.5: 'Ā va Indram kṛvim yathā' [and] 'Yad Indra aham yathā tvam' — in a fifteen-versed [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.13.6: 'Pra saṃrājam carṣaṇīnām' [and] 'Uttvā mandantu stomāḥ' — in a twelve-versed [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.13.7: 'Ā pra drava parāvataḥ' — nine [verses].
ŚŚS 18.13.8: Thus [totaling] four hundred <s>Gāyatrī</s>s.
ŚŚS 18.13.9: 'Vayam u tvām apūrvya' — eight <s>Kakubh</s> <s>pragātha</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.13.10: 'Indrāya sāma gāyata' — the entire [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.13.11: Having recited those by half-verses, then [he recites] the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.14.1: atha.etam.vaśam.ardharcaśaḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.14.2: tvāvataḥ.purūvaso.iti /
ŚŚS_18.14.3: tasya.saptadaśī.jagatī.tām.pacchaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.14.4: atha.ekaviṃśī.dvāviṃśī.caturviṃśī.ca.paṅktayas.tāḥ.paṅkti.śaṃsam /
ŚŚS_18.14.5: śatam.dāse.balbūtha.iti.pañca.padā.tasyai.trīṇi.padāni.samasya.avasyed.dvābhyām.praṇuyāt /
ŚŚS_18.14.6: trayodaśī.ca.triṃśattamī.ca.dvipade.te.pacchaḥ.śastvā.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.14.7: atha.etau.vihṛtāv.ardharcāv.atha.sūda.dohasam /
ŚŚS_18.14.8: sā.tata.eva.utsṛjyate /
ŚŚS_18.14.9: atra.catur.viṃśati.kṛtvaḥ.śastā.bhavati /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.14.1: Then he recites this <s>vaśa</s> (wish) [hymn] by half-verses.
ŚŚS 18.14.2: 'Tvāvataḥ Pūrūvaso.'
ŚŚS 18.14.3: Its seventeenth [verse] is in <s>Jagatī</s> meter — that [is recited as] <s>pacchaḥ</s> (in the after-mode).
ŚŚS 18.14.4: Then the twenty-first, twenty-second, and twenty-fourth are <s>Paṅkti</s> [verses] — those are recited in the <s>Paṅkti</s>-mode.
ŚŚS 18.14.5: 'Śatam dāse balbūthe' — [a verse with] five <s>pādas</s>; of that, joining three <s>pādas</s> together, he should pause, and conclude with two.
ŚŚS 18.14.6: The thirteenth and thirtieth are two-<s>pāda</s> [verses]; having recited those in the after-mode, then [he recites] the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
ŚŚS 18.14.7: Then these two extracted half-verses, then the <s>sūdadohasam</s>.
ŚŚS 18.14.8: That [verse] is then abandoned.
ŚŚS 18.14.9: At this point, the reciter has recited twenty-four times.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.15.1: atha.etā.dvipadāḥ.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.15.2: imā.nu.kam.bhuvanā.sīṣadhāma.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_18.15.3: ā.yāhi.vanasā.saha.iti.catasraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.15.4: eṣa.brahmā.ya.ṛtviya.iti.tisraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.15.5a: pra.va.indrāya.vṛtrahantamāya.viprā.gātham.gāyata.yaj.jujoṣati.|.arcanty.arkam.marutaḥ.svarkā.ā.stobhati.śruto.yuvā.sa.indraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.15.5b: upaprakṣe.madhumati.kṣiyantaḥ.puṣyema.rayim.dhīmahe.ta.indra.|.viśvato.dāvan.viśvato.na.ā.bhara.yam.tvā.śaviṣṭham.īmahe.|.sa.supraṇītī.nṛtamaḥ.svarāḷ.asi.maṃhiṣṭho.vāja.sātaye.|.tvam.hi.rādhasyata.eka.īśiṣe.sanād.amṛkta.ojasā.|.iti.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.15.6: ā.dhūrṣv.asmai.vajram.eko.ayā.vājam.deva.hitam.sanema.iti /
ŚŚS_18.15.7: tā.ekaviṃśatir.dvipadās.tāḥ.pacchaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.15.1: Then he recites these two-<s>pāda</s> (two-footed) [verses].
ŚŚS 18.15.2: 'Imā nu kam bhuvanā sīṣadhāma' — five [verses].
ŚŚS 18.15.3: 'Ā yāhi vanasā saha' — four.
ŚŚS 18.15.4: 'Eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviyaḥ' — three.
ŚŚS 18.15.5a: 'Pra va Indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprā gātham gāyata yaj jujoṣati. Arcanty arkam Marutaḥ svarkāḥ. Ā stobhati śruto yuvā sa Indraḥ.'
ŚŚS 18.15.5b: 'Upaprakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayim dhīmahe ta Indra. Viśvato dāvan viśvato na ā bhara yam tvā śaviṣṭham īmahe. Sa supraṇītī nṛtamaḥ svarāḷ asi maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye. Tvam hi rādhasyata eka īśiṣe sanād amṛkta ojasā.' — six [verses].
ŚŚS 18.15.6: 'Ā dhūrṣv asmai vajram,' 'Eko ayā vājam,' 'Devahitam sanema.'
ŚŚS 18.15.7: Those twenty-one two-<s>pāda</s> [verses] are [recited] in the after-mode.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.16.1: atha.etad.aindrāgnam.sūktam.gāyatrī.śaṃsam.śaṃsati.indra.agnī.yuvam.su.na.iti /
ŚŚS_18.16.2: tasya.dvitīyā.sapta.padā.tasyā.anuṣṭubham.pūrvām.karoti.śaṃsam.gāyatrīm.uttarām /
ŚŚS_18.16.3: triṣṭub.uttamā.tām.pacchaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.16.1: Then he recites this hymn to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> in the <s>Gāyatrī</s> mode: 'Indra-Agnī yuvam su naḥ.'
ŚŚS 18.16.2: Its second [verse] has seven <s>pādas</s>; of that, he makes the first part an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> recitation and the latter part a <s>Gāyatrī</s> recitation.
ŚŚS 18.16.3: The last [verse] is in <s>Triṣṭubh</s> — that [is recited] in the after-mode.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.17.1: atha.etad.āvapanam.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.17.2: tubhya.idam.indra.pari.ṣicyate.madhv.ity.ekā /
ŚŚS_18.17.3: viśvajite.dhana.jite.svar.jita.iti.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.17.4: tāḥ.pacchaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.17.5: svādor.itthā.viṣūvata.iti.pāṅktam.tṛcam.tat.paṅkti.śaṃsam /
ŚŚS_18.17.6: pra.vo.mahe.mahivṛdhe.bharadhvam.iti.vairājam.tṛcam.tad.ardharcaśaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.17.7: praty.asmai.pipīṣata.ity.ānuṣṭubham.tṛcam.tad.ardharcaśaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.17.1: Then he recites this <s>āvapanam</s> (the offering portion).
ŚŚS 18.17.2: 'Tubhyam idam Indra pari ṣicyate madhu' — one [verse].
ŚŚS 18.17.3: 'Viśvajite,' 'Dhanajite,' 'Svarjite' — six [verses].
ŚŚS 18.17.4: Those [are recited] in the after-mode.
ŚŚS 18.17.5: 'Svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ' — a <s>Paṅkti</s> <s>tṛca</s> (triad); that is recited in the <s>Paṅkti</s> mode.
ŚŚS 18.17.6: 'Pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvam' — a <s>Vairāja</s> <s>tṛca</s>; that [is recited] by half-verses.
ŚŚS 18.17.7: 'Praty asmai pipīṣata' — an <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> <s>tṛca</s>; that [is recited] by half-verses.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.18.1: atha.etam.ānuṣṭubham.samāmnāyam.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.18.2: ehi.stomān.abhi.svara.iti.nava /
ŚŚS_18.18.3: indram.viśvā.avīvṛdhann.ity.aṣṭau /
ŚŚS_18.18.4: asāvi.soma.indra.ta.iti.ṣaṭ.|.ā.nas.te.gantu.matsara.iti.catasraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.18.5: matsi.no.vasya.iṣṭaya.iti.pañca /
ŚŚS_18.18.6: yas.te.sādhiṣṭho.avasa.iti.sapta /
ŚŚS_18.18.7: uroṣ.ṭa.indra.rādhasa.iti.dve /
ŚŚS_18.18.8: yad.indra.citra.mehana.iti.cataraḥ /
ŚŚS_18.18.9: yo.rayivo.rayiṃtama.iti.ṣaṭ /
ŚŚS_18.18.10: ā.indra.yāhi.haribhir.iti.pañcadaśa /
ŚŚS_18.18.11: sa.pratnathā.kavivṛdha.iti.tṛcam /
ŚŚS_18.18.12: yaj.jāyathā.apūrvyā.iti.dve /
ŚŚS_18.18.13: ā.tvā.giro.rathīr.iva.iti.sarvam /
ŚŚS_18.18.14: śāsa.itthā.mahān.asi.iti.sarvam /
ŚŚS_18.18.15: tad.ardharcaśaḥ /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.18.1: Then he recites this <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> collection.
ŚŚS 18.18.2: 'Ehi stomān abhi svara' — nine [verses].
ŚŚS 18.18.3: 'Indram viśvā avīvṛdhan' — eight.
ŚŚS 18.18.4: 'Asāvi Soma Indra te' — six. 'Ā nas te gantu matsaraḥ' — four.
ŚŚS 18.18.5: 'Matsi no vasya iṣṭaye' — five.
ŚŚS 18.18.6: 'Yas te sādhiṣṭho avasaḥ' — seven.
ŚŚS 18.18.7: 'Uroṣ ṭa Indra rādhasaḥ' — two.
ŚŚS 18.18.8: 'Yad Indra citra mehana' — four.
ŚŚS 18.18.9: 'Yo rayivo rayiṃtamaḥ' — six.
ŚŚS 18.18.10: 'Ā Indra yāhi haribhiḥ' — fifteen.
ŚŚS 18.18.11: 'Sa pratnathā kavivṛdhaḥ' — one <s>tṛca</s>.
ŚŚS 18.18.12: 'Yaj jāyathā apūrvya' — two [verses].
ŚŚS 18.18.13: 'Ā tvā giro rathīr iva' — the entire [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.18.14: 'Śāsa itthā mahān asi' — the entire [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.18.15: Those [are recited] by half-verses.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.19.1: atha.etam.triṣṭup.śatam.śaṃsati /
ŚŚS_18.19.2: hairaṇya.stūpīyam.ca /
ŚŚS_18.19.3: yāta.ūtīyam.ca /
ŚŚS_18.19.4: sajanīyam.ca /
ŚŚS_18.19.5: adhvaryavo.bharata.indrāya.somam.iti.ca /
ŚŚS_18.19.6: ā.yāhy.arvān.upa.vandhureṣṭhā.yudhmasya.te.vṛṣabhasya.svarāja.iti.sūkte /
ŚŚS_18.19.7: nṛṇām.u.tvā.nṛtamam.gīrbhir.ukthair.iti.tṛcam /
ŚŚS_18.19.8: ā.satyo.yātu.maghavān.ṛjīṣī.iti.sarvam /
ŚŚS_18.19.9: yoniṣ.ṭa.indra.sadane.akāry.ud.u.brahmāṇi.iti.sūkte /
ŚŚS_18.19.10: tatra.purastād.ud.brahmīyasya.pada.anuṣaṅgān.śaṃsati.yo.vyatīṃr.aphāṇayad.ity.etasmiṃs.tṛce.prathamāyā.ardharcam.uktvā.uparamati /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.19.1: Then he recites this hundred of <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [verses].
ŚŚS 18.19.2: The <s>Hairaṇyastūpīya</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.19.3: The <s>Yāta-ūtīya</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.19.4: The <s>Sajanīya</s> [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.19.5: 'Adhvaryavo bharata Indrāya somam.'
ŚŚS 18.19.6: [Then] the hymns 'Ā yāhy arvān upa vandhureṣṭhā' [and] 'Yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarājaḥ.'
ŚŚS 18.19.7: 'Nṛṇām u tvā nṛtamam gīrbhir ukthaiḥ' — one <s>tṛca</s>.
ŚŚS 18.19.8: 'Ā satyo yātu maghavān ṛjīṣī' — the entire [hymn].
ŚŚS 18.19.9: [Then] the hymns 'Yoniṣ ṭa Indra sadane akāri' [and] 'Ud u brahmāṇi.'
ŚŚS 18.19.10: There, before the 'Ud brahmīya' [hymn], he recites the <s>pada-anuṣaṅga</s>s (word-connections): in the <s>tṛca</s> 'Yo vyatīr aphāṇayat,' having spoken the first half-verse of the first [verse], he pauses.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.20.1: atha.prathamāyai.tṛtīyena.padena.dvitīyāyai.prathamam.padam.upasaṃdhāya.praṇauti /
ŚŚS_18.20.2: atha.prathamāyā.uttamena.padena.dvitīyāyai.dvitīyam.padam.upasaṃdhāya.avasyati /
ŚŚS_18.20.3: atha.dvitīyāyai.tṛtīyena.padena.uttamāyai.pathamam.padam.upasaṃdhāya.praṇauti /
ŚŚS_18.20.4: atha.dvitīyāyā.uttamena.padena.uttamāyai.dvitīyam.padam.upasaṃdhāya.avasyati /
ŚŚS_18.20.5: atha.ardharcaśaḥ.pariśiṣṭas.tena.praṇauti /
ŚŚS_18.20.6: atho.ud.brahmīyasya.uttamām.pariśiṣya.āhvayate /
ŚŚS_18.20.7: triḥ.śastayā.paridadhāti /
ŚŚS_18.20.8: paridhāya.uktha.vīryam.japaty.aikāhikam.pūrvam.māhāvratikam.uttaram.mahad.asi.yaśo.asi.bhargo.asi.bhogo.asi.bhuñjad.asi.mama.bhogāya.bhava.iti /
body.translated_text:
ŚŚS 18.20.1: Then, joining the third <s>pāda</s> of the first [verse] with the first <s>pāda</s> of the second, he intones the <s>praṇava</s> (<s>oṃ</s>).
ŚŚS 18.20.2: Then, joining the last <s>pāda</s> of the first [verse] with the second <s>pāda</s> of the second, he concludes.
ŚŚS 18.20.3: Then, joining the third <s>pāda</s> of the second [verse] with the first <s>pāda</s> of the last, he intones the <s>praṇava</s>.
ŚŚS 18.20.4: Then, joining the last <s>pāda</s> of the second [verse] with the second <s>pāda</s> of the last, he concludes.
ŚŚS 18.20.5: Then, by half-verses, what remains — with that he intones the <s>praṇava</s>.
ŚŚS 18.20.6: Also, having concluded the last [verse] of the 'Ud brahmīya' [hymn], he calls out.
ŚŚS 18.20.7: With the thrice-recited [verse], he encloses.
ŚŚS 18.20.8: Having enclosed, he mutters the <s>ukthavīrya</s> (strength of the uktha): first the one for the <s>ekāhika</s> (one-day rite), then the one for the <s>Mahāvrata</s>: 'You are great, you are glory, you are splendor, you are enjoyment, you are the enjoyer — be for my enjoyment.'

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.21.1: tad.etat.sakṛt.śastāyām.sūda.dohasi.yāvat.śastram.upasarjanyām.saṃkhyāyamānāyām.ṛte.tūṣṇīm.śaṃsam.bṛhatī.sahasram.sampadyate /
ŚŚS_18.21.2: trir.eva.āhvayate /
ŚŚS_18.21.3: stotriye.nividi.paridhānīyāyai /
ŚŚS_18.21.4: samānau.yājyā /
ŚŚS_18.21.5: ananuvaṣaṭ.kṛta.eva.preṅkham.śrathnanti /
ŚŚS_18.21.6: sagraham.eva.āyantam.prān.upāvarohati /
ŚŚS_18.21.7: pratyak.preṅkha.phalakam.apohati /
ŚŚS_18.21.8: parāmṛśan.graham.japati.yad.imam.prajayam.prājaiṣam.tam.anvasāni.iti /
ŚŚS_18.21.9: adhvarya.upahavam.iṣṭvā.bhakṣayaty.ojase.tvā.iti /
ŚŚS_18.21.10: vaiśvakarmaṇo.atigrāhyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.21.11: tasya.bhakṣa.upa.mā.yantu.majjayaḥ.sanīlā.upa.mā.jakṣur.upa.mā.manīṣā.priyām.aham.tanvam.paśyamāno.mayi.ramo.devānām.ojase.tvā.iti /
ŚŚS_18.21.12: atha.camasān.bhakṣayanti.devo.asi.narā.śaṃsa.iti /
ŚŚS_18.21.13: klṛptam.mādhyaṃdinam.savanam /
body.translated_text:
18.21.1: When recited once in the <s>Sūda-dohas</s> (milking at the cooking), however long the recitation [takes] in the subordinate enumeration, [counting] the silent (<s>tūṣṇīm</s>) [recitations] and the <s>Bṛhatī</s> measure, it amounts to a thousand.
18.21.2: He invites three times only.
18.21.3: For the <s>stotriya</s>, <s>nivid</s>, and <s>paridhānīyā</s> (concluding verse).
18.21.4: The <s>yājyā</s> (offering verses) are the same.
18.21.5: Without an <s>anuvaṣaṭkāra</s> (subsidiary exclamation), they tie the swing (<s>preṅkha</s>).
18.21.6: He descends along with the cup (<s>graha</s>) as it arrives.
18.21.7: He pushes the swing-plank backward.
18.21.8: Touching the cup, he mutters: "May I follow this offspring-giving [cup] along with offspring."
18.21.9: Having made the <s>Adhvaryu</s>'s invitation (<s>upahava</s>), he partakes [saying]: "For strength, you!"
18.21.10: There is an <s>Atigrāhya</s> (special cup) for <s>Viśvakarman</s>.
18.21.11: Its partaking [mantra is]: "May the marrow-juices come to me, may the dark-blue ones, may the eyes, may the thoughts. Seeing my own dear body, may I delight. For the strength of the gods, you!"
18.21.12: Then they partake of the cups [saying]: "You are a god, O <s>Narāśaṃsa</s>."
18.21.13: The midday pressing is thus completed.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.22.1: atha.ata.tṛtīya.savanam /
ŚŚS_18.22.2: tat.savitur.vṛṇīmahe.adyā.no.deva.savitar.iti.tṛcau.pratipad.anucarau.vaiśvadevasya /
ŚŚS_18.22.3: eṣa.eva.nitya.ekāha.ātānaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.22.4: tad.devasya.savitur.vāryam.mahad.iti.sāvitram /
ŚŚS_18.22.5: te.hi.dyāvā.pṛthivī.viśva.śambhuvā.iti.dyāvā.pṛthivīyam /
ŚŚS_18.22.6: kim.u.śreṣṭhaḥ.kim.yaviṣṭho.na.ājagann.ity.ārbhavam /
ŚŚS_18.22.7: asya.vāmasya.palitasya.hotur.iti.salilam.vaiśvadevam.tasyāḥ.samudrā.adhi.vi.kṣaranti.samānam.etad.udakam.ity.ete.ardharcaśaḥ.aṃsati.paccha.itarāḥ /
ŚŚS_18.22.8: tat.śastvā.ā.no.bhadrīye.nividam.dadhāti /
ŚŚS_18.22.9: pañca.janīyā.paridhānīyā /
ŚŚS_18.22.10: iti.nvā.u.vaiśvadevam /
body.translated_text:
18.22.1: Now henceforth, the third pressing.
18.22.2: "<s>Tat Savituḥ vṛṇīmahe</s>" (We choose that of <s>Savitṛ</s>) and "<s>Adyā no deva Savitar</s>" (Today, O divine <s>Savitṛ</s>) — these two are the <s>pratipad</s> (opening) and <s>anucara</s> (following) [verses] of the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [recitation].
18.22.3: This is the regular one-day (<s>ekāha</s>) pattern (<s>ātāna</s>).
18.22.4: "<s>Tad devasya Savituḥ vāryam mahad</s>" (That great desirable [gift] of divine <s>Savitṛ</s>) — the <s>Sāvitra</s> [section].
18.22.5: "<s>Te hi Dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuvā</s>" (For they, Heaven and Earth, are universally beneficent) — the <s>Dyāvāpṛthivīya</s> (heaven-and-earth section).
18.22.6: "<s>Kim u śreṣṭhaḥ kim yaviṣṭho na ājagan</s>" (Who best, who youngest has come to us?) — the <s>Ārbhava</s>.
18.22.7: "<s>Asya vāmasya palitasya hotuḥ</s>" (Of this lovely grey-haired <s>Hotṛ</s>) — the <s>Salila</s> (water) <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>. Of that: "<s>Samudrā adhi vikṣaranti</s>" (From the oceans they flow forth) and "<s>Samānam etad udakam</s>" (This water is the same) — these half-verses are in the <s>aṃśa</s> (share) [section]; the rest follows.
18.22.8: Having recited that, he places the <s>nivid</s> after "<s>Ā no bhadrīye</s>."
18.22.9: The <s>Pañcajanīyā</s> is the <s>paridhānīyā</s> (concluding verse).
18.22.10: Thus the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [recitation].

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.23.1: atha.ata.āgni.mārutam /
ŚŚS_18.23.2: vaiśvānarāya.pṛthu.pājase.vipa.iti.vaiśvānarīyam /
ŚŚS_18.23.3: prayajyavo.maruto.bhrāja.dṛṣṭaya.iti.mārutam /
ŚŚS_18.23.4: te.yadi.yajñāyajñīyam.agniṣṭoma.sāma.kuryus.tasya.uktau.stotriya.anurūpau /
ŚŚS_18.23.5: tayor.diṣṭam.śastram /
ŚŚS_18.23.6: yady.u.vā.iḷāṃdam.(?).agne.tava.śravo.vaya.iti.stotriyas.tṛco.ata.eva.uttaraḥ.sūkta.anurūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.23.7: yady.u.sarvasmin.ṣaḷarce.stuvīran.na.agnim.na.svavṛktibhir.ity.etasya.ṣaḷ.anurūpam.kurvīta /
ŚŚS_18.23.8: ardharcaśaḥ.śastram /
ŚŚS_18.23.9: yady.u.vā.aticchandahsu.kuryur.agnim.hotāram.manye.dāsvantam.iti.stotriyas.tṛco.ata.eva.uttaraḥ.sūkta.anurūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.23.10: yā.saptamī.sūktasya.tām.tṛtīyām.karoti.so.anurūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.23.11: ayam.jāyata.manuṣo.dharīmaṇi.iti.vā.stotriyas.tṛco.ata.eva.uttaraḥ.sūkta.anurūpaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.23.12: vicaturam.śastram /
ŚŚS_18.23.13: na.atra.yajñāyajñīyasya.yonim.anuśaṃset /
ŚŚS_18.23.14: baḷ.itthā.tad.vapuṣe.dhāyi.darśatam.iti.jāta.vedasīyam /
ŚŚS_18.23.15: ity.āgni.māruta.sūktāni /
ŚŚS_18.23.16: ity.etasya.ahnaḥ.sūktāni /
ŚŚS_18.23.17: tad.agniṣṭomaḥ.saṃtiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_18.23.18: vasanty.etām.rātrīm /
body.translated_text:
18.23.1: Now henceforth, the <s>Āgnimāruta</s> [recitation].
18.23.2: "<s>Vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase vipa</s>" (For <s>Vaiśvānara</s> of broad luster, the inspired one) — the <s>Vaiśvānarīya</s> [section].
18.23.3: "<s>Prayajyavo Maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ</s>" (The <s>Maruts</s>, worthy of prior worship, with blazing spears) — the <s>Māruta</s> [section].
18.23.4: If they should make the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> as the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>-<s>sāman</s>, its <s>uktha</s> (recitation) has [corresponding] <s>stotriya</s> and <s>anurūpa</s> [verses].
18.23.5: Its recitation (<s>śastra</s>) is directed [toward them].
18.23.6: Or if [they use] "<s>Agne tava śravo vayaḥ</s>" (O <s>Agni</s>, your fame [is our] vitality) — the <s>stotriya</s> triplet; from the same [hymn], the next <s>sūkta</s> is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
18.23.7: Or if they should chant in the entire six-versed [hymn], one should make a six-[versed] <s>anurūpa</s> from "<s>Na Agnim na svavṛktibhiḥ</s>" (Not <s>Agni</s>, not by their own praises).
18.23.8: Half-verse recitation.
18.23.9: Or if they should make [the chant] in the <s>Atichandas</s> (extra-metres), "<s>Agnim hotāram manye dāsvantam</s>" (I consider <s>Agni</s> the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the generous one) — the <s>stotriya</s> triplet; from the same [hymn], the next <s>sūkta</s> is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
18.23.10: The seventh [verse] of the <s>sūkta</s> — that he makes the third; that is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
18.23.11: Or "<s>Ayam jāyata manuṣo dharīmaṇi</s>" (This one was born in the abode of man) — the <s>stotriya</s> triplet; from the same [hymn], the next <s>sūkta</s> is the <s>anurūpa</s>.
18.23.12: Four-versed recitation.
18.23.13: Here one should not follow the pattern (<s>yoni</s>) of the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s>.
18.23.14: "<s>Baḷ itthā tad vapuṣe dhāyi darśatam</s>" (Indeed, that was established visibly for beauty) — the <s>Jātavedaseya</s>.
18.23.15: Thus the <s>Āgnimāruta</s> hymns.
18.23.16: Thus the hymns of this day.
18.23.17: That concludes the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.
18.23.18: They spend this night.

body.text:
ŚŚS_18.24.1: atha.prātar.udayanīyam.atirātram.upayanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.2: ya.eva.asau.prāyaṇīyaḥ.sa.udayanīyaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.24.3: tatra.sarvān.karasnān.sambādhya.preṣyati.maitrāvaruṇaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.24.4: te.prathama.māsam.dīkṣita.vasanāni.vā.vasate /
ŚŚS_18.24.5: tāni.nava.rātrāya.nidadhati /
ŚŚS_18.24.6: uttamāya.ca.māsāya /
ŚŚS_18.24.7: atha.itarān.māsān.ajināni.vā.ārdra.vasanāni.vā.vasate /
ŚŚS_18.24.8: tasmin.hi.saṃsthita.karmāṇi.kriyante /
ŚŚS_18.24.9: na.parasmā.ahno.vasatīvarīr.gṛhṇanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.10: na.atipraiṣam.āha /
