ŚŚS_18.24.12: yanty.avabhṛtham /
ŚŚS_18.24.13: kriyate.avabhṛtha.karma /
ŚŚS_18.24.14: te.yadi.yajña.agārair.bhokṣyamāṇā.bhavanty.ādadhata.eva.preṅkha.miśram /
ŚŚS_18.24.15: yady.u.dhakṣyanto.atra.eva.syāt /
ŚŚS_18.24.16: prajñāto.avabhṛtaḥ /
ŚŚS_18.24.17: prajñātā.udayanīyā /
ŚŚS_18.24.18: prajñātā.anūbandhyā /
ŚŚS_18.24.19: tasyai.vapāyām.saṃsthitāyām.dakṣiṇa.ardha.apara.ardhād.vedeḥ.kiṃcit.pariśritya.tasminn.upaviśya.keśa.śmaśrūṇi.vāpayanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.20: sarvāṇi.ca.romāṇi.nakhāni.nikṛntayante /
ŚŚS_18.24.21: snānti /
ŚŚS_18.24.22: alam.kurvanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.23: uṣṇīṣān.paryasyantyā.keśānām.saṃjananāt /
ŚŚS_18.24.24: pariśeṣam.anūbandhyāyai.saṃsthāpayanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.25: hṛdaya.śūla.antā.saṃtiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_18.24.26: tasyām.saṃsthitāyām.yathā.samprakīrṇam.agnīn.samāropya.antareṇa.cātvālautkarā.upaniṣkrāmanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.27: uttarata.udghāta.avokṣite.agny.āyatanāni.kṛtvā.gomayena.upalipya.mathitvā.agnīn.vihṛtya.praṇītāḥ.praṇīya.pūrṇa.āhutīr.hutvā.pṛthag.udavasānīyābhir.yajante.ya.āhita.agnayo.bhavanti /
ŚŚS_18.24.28: atha.ye.anāhita.agnayo.gṛhapatim.eva.ta.upāsate /
ŚŚS_18.24.29: sa.kāmam.eva.pṛṣṭha.śamanīyena.yajeta /
ŚŚS_18.24.30: kāmam.na.yajeta /
ŚŚS_18.24.31: yadi.tu.yajeta.eta.eva.asya.satriṇa.ṛtvijaḥ.syuḥ /
ŚŚS_18.24.32: tebhyas.tad.dadyād.yad.deyam.syāt /
ŚŚS_18.24.33: atra.saṃvatsaraḥ.saṃtiṣṭhate /
ŚŚS_18.24.34: atha.ato.hotrāṇām.eva.mīmāṃsā.|.tasya.atas.tasya.ataḥ /
body.translated_text:
18.24.1: Then in the morning they approach the <s>Udayanīya</s> (concluding) <s>Atirātra</s>.
18.24.2: That which was the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (opening rite), that is the <s>Udayanīya</s>.
18.24.3: There, having pressed together all the forearms, the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> sends [them] forth.
18.24.4: During the first month, they wear consecration garments, or he wears [them].
18.24.5: They set those aside for the nine-night [period].
18.24.6: And for the last month.
18.24.7: During the other months, he wears antelope skins or damp garments.
18.24.8: For in that [period], the concluding rites are performed.
18.24.9: They do not recite the <s>Vasatīvarī</s> [litany] beyond the [current] day.
18.24.10: He does not pronounce the <s>Atipraiṣa</s> (special directive).
18.24.11: They offer with the <s>Samiṣṭayajus</s> formulae.
18.24.12: They go for the concluding bath (<s>avabhṛtha</s>).
18.24.13: The <s>avabhṛtha</s> ritual is performed.
18.24.14: If they intend to enjoy [the remains] in the sacrificial hall, they take [these] mixed with the swing (<s>preṅkha</s>) [material].
18.24.15: But if they intend to burn [them], it should be right there.
18.24.16: The <s>avabhṛtha</s> is recognized (<s>prajñāta</s>).
18.24.17: The <s>Udayanīyā</s> [<s>iṣṭi</s>] is recognized.
18.24.18: The <s>Anūbandhyā</s> [cow] is recognized.
18.24.19: When its omentum (<s>vapā</s>) has been concluded, having cut off a portion from the southern half of the altar's western half, having sat down on it, they shave the hair and beard.
18.24.20: And they trim all body hair and nails.
18.24.21: They bathe.
18.24.22: They adorn themselves.
18.24.23: With the turban (<s>uṣṇīṣa</s>) wrapping around, from the growth of the hair.
18.24.24: The remainder they conclude with the <s>Anūbandhyā</s> [cow].
18.24.25: [The rite] concludes with the heart-spit.
18.24.26: When that is concluded, having placed all the fires upon [each other] as is customary, they depart between the <s>Cātvāla</s> (pit) and <s>Utkara</s> (heap).
18.24.27: Having made fire-seats to the north, in the excavated area, having smeared [them] with cow-dung, having churned [new fire], having distributed the fires, having led forth the <s>Praṇītā</s> waters, having offered the <s>Pūrṇāhutis</s> (full oblations), they sacrifice separately with the <s>Udavasānīyā</s> (concluding) [<s>iṣṭis</s>] — those who are <s>Āhitāgnis</s> (who maintain sacred fires).
18.24.28: Those who are not <s>Āhitāgnis</s> worship the <s>Gṛhapati</s> (householder fire) alone.
18.24.29: He may optionally sacrifice with the <s>Pṛṣṭhaśamanīya</s>.
18.24.30: Or he may not sacrifice.
18.24.31: But if he does sacrifice, these very <s>Sattra</s> (session) priests should serve as his ritual priests (<s>ṛtvij</s>).
18.24.32: He should give them whatever is to be given.
18.24.33: Here the year(-long rite) is concluded.
18.24.34: Now henceforth is the investigation (<s>mīmāṃsā</s>) of the <s>Hotra</s> [recitations] only. Of that, hence; of that, hence.
